rollCalls.title: nursing facilities; records; surveys; timelines
rollCalls.summary: Modifies Department of Health Services (DHS) oversight and investigative procedures for nursing care institutions, including personnel record access and complaint investigations.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: department of education; reporting requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to review statutory reporting requirements on public schools and ADE to identify requirements that are duplicative, expired or otherwise obsolete. Requires ADE, by December 1, 2026, to submit a report as outlined that includes a summary of the review and recommendations for legislative action to repeal or modify duplicative, expired or obsolete requirements. Repeals the outlined requirements on ADE on July 1, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowners' associations; shade structures
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a homeowners' association (HOA) from prohibiting the backyard instillation or use of a shade structure.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; leases; housing development
rollCalls.summary: Amends Laws 2014, Chapter 259, which established trampoline court regulations, to designate the legislation as Ty's Law .
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: advanced mathematics courses; student enrollment
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district and charter school to enroll a student in grades six through eight in an advanced mathematics course for the student's next mathematics course if the student's parent does not object and the student meets at least one eligibility requirement as outlined. Outlines parental communication requirements for students who enroll in an advanced mathematics course as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: emissions; reduction credits; counties
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county to claim concurrent jurisdiction over components of a portable source and mobile sources within the county jurisdiction for the sole purpose of issuing, revising or enforcing a permit for emission reduction credits (ERCs).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: public cold plunge; rules; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Excludes single-user public or semipublic cold plunges from rules adopted by the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) governing water pollution in public or semipublic swimming pools and bathing places.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: prisoners; transition program
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to grant a onetime, 90-day extension for an eligible inmate to continue receiving transition services if the inmate meets certain eligibility requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: DUI; alternative treatment
rollCalls.summary: Removes the requirement that a person who is subject to a driver license revocation for multiple driving under the influence (DUI) offenses must complete 45 days of the license revocation period prior to applying for a special ignition interlock restricted driver license (SIIRDL).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: family court; address confidentiality
rollCalls.summary: Outlines protection requirements for an Address Confidentiality Program (ACP) participant in any marital and domestic relation matter and requires the court to seal an ACP participant's residential address and use a substitute address. Prescribes criminal penalties for obtaining or disclosing information protected by the ACP for the purpose of harassment, stalking or domestic violence.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; special education; access
rollCalls.summary: Outlines procedures for the parent of a pupil who resides in an unorganized territory to request a Child Find screening, special education evaluation or enrollment in the adjoining school district that is geographically closest to the pupil's residence. Modifies the procedures relating to the issuance of certificates of educational convenience (CECs), including application, enrollment and dispute resolutions.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: PFAS; firefighting foam; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2029, prohibits a person, local government or state agency from discharging or using class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals for any purpose, unless required by federal regulation.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: mental illness; prisoners; diagnosis; treatment.
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Study Committee on Inmate Mental Health Services (Study Committee) and prescribes membership and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance; bona fide associations; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements to qualify as a bona fide association. Specifies that a statewide chamber of commerce and statewide business league that meets specified criteria is not prohibited from operating a self-funded multiple employer welfare arrangement (MEWA). Requires, subject to available monies, the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to conduct a feasibility study on state employee and public school district employee health insurance plans in Arizona and outlines requirements for the feasibility study.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: commerce authority; trade offices
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the requirement for the Arizona Commerce Authority (ACA) to establish and supervise trade offices is subject to legislative appropriation, rather than the direction of the ACA Board of Directors (ACA Board).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: utilities; high load factor customers
rollCalls.summary: Requires public power entities and public service corporations in Arizona to file semiannual reports relating to new extra high load factor customers and outlines exemptions, rulemaking and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: local regulation; prohibition; unmanned aircraft
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the prohibition on unmanned aircraft regulations by a city, town or county.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: Native American language; instruction; certification
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, if the State Board of Education (SBE), a school district or a charter school includes a requirement that students receive instruction in a world language for high school graduation, the SBE, school district or charter school must allow students to satisfy the requirement by demonstrating proficiency in a Native American language. Specifies that a school district or charter school is not required to offer a Native American language course.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: traffic schools; instructors; fingerprint clearance
rollCalls.summary: Requires, effective January 1, 2027, instructors who are employed by or under contract with a traffic survival school to provide the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) with a standard fingerprint clearance card. Allows a person whose fingerprint clearance card application is pending within the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to be granted a temporary work authorization by the relevant agency while the person's application is being processed if outlined conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: court-ordered treatment; judicial review
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the judicial review process for persons receiving court-ordered mental health treatment, including procedures for requesting review, notice and reporting requirements, timelines for court action, rights to counsel and standards for continued treatment.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; counties; development fees
rollCalls.summary: Modifies municipal development fee requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal improvement districts; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Allows real property owners to petition the Arizona Finance Authority (AFA), until June 30, 2036, to establish a state affordability infrastructure district (district) that is managed by a district board comprised of real property owners in the district and allows a district to issue and sell bonds and levy taxes and assessments. Outlines procedures for district formation petitions, elections, financing, public hearings, governance, powers, dissolution, property disclosures and public infrastructure project review.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: rural hospitals; radiation protection grants
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $3 million in FY 2027 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Department of Health Services (DHS) to establish a grant program to assist rural hospitals with the costs of installing radiation protection systems in cardiac catheterization procedure rooms.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance; aggregate report; amount
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $100 to $200, the amount an in-state individual may contribute before the contributor's identifying information must be included in campaign finance reports.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting; equipment; internet; custody; violation
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes various security requirements for vote recording equipment and tabulating equipment that is certified for use in elections in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gender transition procedures; informed consent
rollCalls.summary: Establishes statutory criteria for determining when a person commits an act of defamation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; dual enrollment; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires, as a condition of licensure for outlined behavioral health facilities, each applicant, licensee and owner to be a U.S. citizen or a lawful permanent resident of the United States and have a valid Level I fingerprint clearance card (FPCC).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health; hearings; audiovisual technology
rollCalls.summary: Modifies procedures related to court-ordered mental health evaluation and treatment, including the use of virtual hearings and testimony, and establishes requirements for coordination of care between mental health treatment agencies and secure behavioral health residential facilities (SBHRFs).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: correctional officers; supplemental contributions
rollCalls.summary: Allows a Correction Officer Retirement Plan (CORP) employer to make supplemental contribution incentive payments to specified employees who are hired on or after July 1, 2018 (Tier 3 CORP members). Outlines criteria for the supplemental contributions, including setting a $5,000 maximum per person, per year, and requiring the contributions to occur at specified intervals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: solar energy; inspection; contractors
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements relating to the installation and inspection of solar energy devices. Outlines requirements for distributed energy generation system agreements and disclosure requirements for sales presentations or documents relating to a distributed energy generation system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: board of directors; commerce authority.
rollCalls.summary: Applies the strict compliance standard of review to initiatives and referendum for cities, towns and counties and subjects petition circulators to additional requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water quality; testing; on-site
rollCalls.summary: Allows a city or a town with a population between 1,000 and 9,999 persons, for aquifer protection permits issued to the city or town, to test bacteriological samples on-site with approved testing equipment. Prohibits the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) from requiring a community water system that is located in a county with a population of 400,000 persons or fewer and that serves 25 or fewer service connections to maintain a minimum storage capacity that is larger than 1,000 gallons.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cargo theft task force
rollCalls.summary: Establishes, subject to legislative appropriation, the Cargo Theft Task Force (Task Force) to combat cargo theft and related offenses and prescribes membership and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquor; policies; procedures
rollCalls.summary: Makes various changes related to the liquor regulatory statutes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: malicious delay; enforcement; penalty
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality or county from maliciously delaying the statutory licensing time frames for single-family residential construction. Allows the Attorney General (AG) to enforce the prohibition on maliciously delaying a response and subjects a municipality or county to a civil penalty of $5,000 per violation. Grants an expedited judicial review of a claim to a plaintiff who files a malicious delay claim in the superior court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful alert; arrests
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of unlawful alerting of another person to avoid arrest , which a person commits by knowingly communicating information to another specific person with intent to hinder, delay or prevent the lawful arrest of the other specific person.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health care institutions; licensing; complaints
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) and the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to coordinate to review each agency's monitoring and compliance functions to identify areas of overlap related to health care institution licensing standards. Establishes minimum qualifications and training requirements for behavioral health technicians (BHTs) and prescribes BHT scope of practice, supervision and duties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: special plate; police foundation
rollCalls.summary: Effective July 1, 2027, establishes a timeshare salesperson license and outlines licensure requirements and qualifications.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful occupants; forcible entry; detainer
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the qualifying conditions which constitute a forcible detainer for the unlawful possession of outlined property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADOT; revisions.
rollCalls.summary: Outlines revisions to various transportation requirements, including requirements relating to high occupancy vehicle lanes (HOV lanes), driver licenses and primitive roads. Establishes 23 special license plates and corresponding funds. Requires contracts between law enforcement agencies and businesses that use camera systems to identify motor vehicles to contain provisions to prohibit the business from selling or disseminating data collected by the camera system to third parties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: substance use disorder treatment; committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Substance Use Disorder Treatment Standards and Oversight Study Committee (Study Committee) to assess substance use disorder specialty care programs and governance, identify gaps in access and implementation, establish standards and investigate funding needs to implement recommended reforms. Outlines Study Committee membership, duties and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: chiropractic board; complaints; training; authority
rollCalls.summary: Outlines various actions that constitute unprofessional conduct for the purpose of disciplining a doctor of chiropractic (DC). Modifies the powers and duties of the Arizona Board of Chiropractic Examiners (Board) and the Executive Director of the Board (Executive Director) when investigating and reviewing complaints of unprofessional conduct.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firefighters; occupational disease; cancers
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to July 1, 2021, clarifies the conditions presumed to have arisen out of employment as a peace officer, firefighter or fire investigator for the purposes of workers' compensation coverage.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health facilities; anonymous complaints; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Establishes timelines for Department of Health Services (DHS) licensure of health care institutions and for review and submittal of third-party accreditation survey results for certification. Authorizes DHS to set initial licensure inspection fees by rule.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADOT; primitive roads; designation
rollCalls.summary: Adds employers and associations with at least 500 employees or members and who are applying for authorization to operate as an authorized third-party driver license provider to the list of entities who are exempt from submitting the prescribed bond with the application for authorization.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: disciplinary action; appeal; superior court
rollCalls.summary: Requires an employer that fails to reinstate a law enforcement officer whose termination is determined to be without just cause by both an initial and a subsequent appeal to pay all taxable costs and reasonable attorney and expert fees incurred by the officer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Arizona trail fund
rollCalls.summary: Grants a resident of a long-term care facility or the resident's authorized representative the right to conduct electronic monitoring of the resident's room and establishes requirements relating to terms and conditions of use.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: quitclaim deeds; notaries; county recorder
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements for utility charges at mobile home parks.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ballots; categories; count
rollCalls.summary: Outlines complaint procedures for when the Arizona Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) receives a complaint for a recognized dental school.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; intake hotline; multiple reports
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to assign investigations involving four or more reports of abuse or neglect in a 12-month period to more experienced personnel and to notify the dependency court of DCS hotline reports involving children subject to a dependency action.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: stem cells; birth tissue; therapy
rollCalls.summary: Establishes regulations governing the use of stem cell and regenerative therapies that are not approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax laws; interpretation; application; hearing
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to notify the Legislature of a proposed interpretation or application of tax law that will adversely affect taxpayers before the new interpretation or application is adopted and requires ADOR to provide testimony regarding the interpretation or application, if the Legislature holds a hearing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agricultural property; inspections; notice.
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a planned community (HOA) board from taking action on an item under consideration during the closed portion of a meeting.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public safety employees; counseling; wellness
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes wellness programs for law enforcement agency (LEA) employees and crisis response services programs for public safety employees, outlines requirements for the programs and protects specified activities and communications from disclosure, except as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cities; towns; counties; posting; website
rollCalls.summary: Allows a city, town or county to satisfy any statutory requirements for advertising, publishing or printing by posting the public notice on the official website of the city, town or county and the official website of a newspaper that is qualified to publish public notices.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: real property conveyances; formal requirements
rollCalls.summary: As passed the Senate, S.B. 1254 prohibited a deed or conveyance of real property from being accepted for recording, unless the grantee’s acceptance is evidenced by the grantee's signature or by a separate certificate or resolution of acceptance. The House of Representatives adopted a strike-everything amendment that does the following: Purpose Makes various changes relating to the regulatory statutes governing the Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; interoperable communications; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district and charter school that receives monies from the state or a local law enforcement agency (LEA) for interoperable communications to establish and maintain interoperable communications capabilities that include specified mechanisms to notify and communicate with local LEAs during a school emergency. Outlines reporting requirements on public schools and the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) relating to the requirement to maintain interoperable communications capabilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ALTCS; providers; change of ownership
rollCalls.summary: Outlines change of ownership procedures for licensed skilled nursing facilities and assisted living facilities to continue processing claims for services rendered to Arizona Long-Term Care System (ALTCS) members.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; intake hotline; case history
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) central intake hotline to generate a single report that includes the entire history of a child and the child's siblings who have been the subject of prior hotline calls or DCS investigations for use in determining if a new allegation meets report criteria and requires DCS to assign investigations involving repeated reports of abuse or neglect by the same caregiver to an experienced or forensically trained child safety specialist.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign spending; personal security
rollCalls.summary: Adds requirements for construction contracts entered into by a revitalization district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; veterans; tuition deferment
rollCalls.summary: Removes the $100,000 cap on restitution that may be awarded as a result of causing serious physical injury or death by a moving violation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADE; special education; parent complaints
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Division of Special Education (Division) within the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to assist individuals who file a complaint alleging that a school district or charter school has violated federal or state law relating to children with disabilities. Requires ADE to adopt policies and procedures for complaints filed with the Division as outlined and post all state complaint investigative reports on ADE's website 90 days after completing an investigation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: radiation protection systems; medical procedures
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits hospitals that perform cardiac catheterization procedures involving real-time x-ray imaging from requiring health professionals to wear lead aprons during those procedures if the procedure room is equipped with a radiation protection system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: underground facilities; excavations; notification
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements under the Underground Facilities Statutes for excavators and underground facilities operators to coordinate the location and marking of underground facilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: storm related insurance claims
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an adjuster and a contractor from soliciting services while a loss-producing event or emergency response is active and prohibits a contractor from advertising to pay, promising to pay or paying a policyholder's insurance deductible.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assisted living facilities; referral agents
rollCalls.summary: Adds disclosure and insurance requirements for assisted living referral agencies .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: artificial intelligence; content verification
rollCalls.summary: Effective February 2, 2027, requires certain providers of generative artificial intelligence (AI) systems to include provenance data in specified media that is created or materially altered by the system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county abatement liens; notice; priority
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that, until October 1, 2028, the sale of a real property tax lien or foreclosure of the right to redeem does not extinguish a lien for an assessment levied against the property for a county's cost of the removal of rubbish, filth, debris or dilapidated buildings that constitute a hazard to public health and safety.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: drones; entertainment districts; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person from intentionally operating a civil unmanned aircraft within 5,280 feet of or above a ticketed entertainment event, except as specified, and classifies a violation as a class 1 misdemeanor. Exempts a city, town, county or state employee acting in the employee's official capacity from the state preemption on the unlawful operation of an unmanned aircraft.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: EMS reciprocity; compact.
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact (Compact), allowing emergency medical service (EMS) personnel, such as emergency medical technicians (EMTs), advanced emergency medical technicians (AEMTs) and paramedics, in participating states to obtain licensure in any other Compact state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona space commission; board; membership
rollCalls.summary: Requires a municipality to develop a reimbursement process for a telecommunication's utility facility relocation cost and provide public notice of any voter-approved municipal bond project at least 30 days before a request to relocate the telecommunications utility's facility.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: disposition; remains; authorization; legal decision-making
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements relating to the duty for funeral and disposition arrangements of a minor decedent.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: service of process; evaluation agencies
rollCalls.summary: Allows the court, in proceedings for court-ordered evaluation or court-ordered treatment, to authorize an employee of a screening or evaluation agency to personally serve required petitions, notices and related documents on a proposed patient who is admitted to a screening or evaluation agency at the time the petition is filed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: personal identifying information; disclosure; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Department of Health Services (DHS) from selling or disclosing personal identifying information of a licensee or certificate holder, including an emergency medical care technician (EMCT), for commercial purposes, unless specified conditions apply
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: aggravated assault; utility workers
rollCalls.summary: Adds outlined on-duty utility workers as protected persons in the criminal classification of aggravated assault .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public pensions; proxy voting
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that adds pilots employed by law enforcement agencies (LEAs) to the first responders who qualify for the state death benefit. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: radiologic technologists; radiologist assistants
rollCalls.summary: Modifies Department of Health Services (DHS) standards regarding radiologic technologists and radiologic assistants, including radiologic technology school approvals, certification requirements and supervision requirements.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: firearms transactions; merchant codes; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Second Amendment Financial Privacy Act (Act) which preempts a government entity from keeping a record of privately-owned firearms or firearm owners, prohibits a merchant category code from distinguishing firearm retailers from other retailers and requires the Attorney General (AG) or county attorney to enforce the Act as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: election procedures manual; consultation
rollCalls.summary: Includes county recorders and the chairpersons and ranking members of the committees with jurisdiction over election matters in the House of Representatives and the Senate under the list of persons whom the Secretary of State (SOS) must consult before prescribing the elections instructions and procedures manual (EPM).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax assessment; destroyed property
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to September 14, 2024, expands the county assessor's authority to prorate the value of destroyed property for property tax purposes by removing the statutory definition of destroyed . Specifies that only a property destroyed by a verifiable accident, including fire, flood or an act of God, may retain its property classification for five years or until a change in use occurs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medicaid; dental benefit study committee
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a health insurer that issues, amends or renews a subscription contract from imposing a reimbursement rate for a certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA) that differs from the reimbursement rate for a physician.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: roadable aircraft; registration; license plates
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, establishes registration and licensing requirements for roadable aircraft.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: supreme court; attorney licensing
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Supreme Court to license attorneys in Arizona and adopt rules for licensing attorneys and prohibits the Arizona Supreme Court from requiring an attorney to be a member of any organization to become or remain a licensed attorney in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: military compatibility permit zoning
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes outdoor advertising signs to be placed on a property that is located in a high noise or accident potential zone within a military airport or district and has been approved through a public hearing and granted a military compatibility permit for commercial or industrial uses.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: GPLET; abatement; limitation
rollCalls.summary: Limits the revenues that may be abated during the government property lease excise tax (GPLET) abatement period by prohibiting GPLET revenue designated for school districts from being abated.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state agencies; guidance; website
rollCalls.summary: Requires a state agency to post on the state agency's website all guidance that the state agency creates or receives from a federal agency.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public records; review standard
rollCalls.summary: Deems that the court standard of review for a question of a denial of access to public records, including whether any exception to disclosure applies, is de novo.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: peace officer certification; alternative pathway
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an alternative pathway for peace officer certification for U.S. veterans who are former military police and prescribes requirements for the alternative pathway and eligible applicants.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical examiners; authorized persons
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a licensed physician who is trained, rather than board-certified, in forensic pathology to supervise autopsies and related functions performed by medical students or residents and fellows in pathology training.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: federal tax credit; authorization; scholarships
rollCalls.summary: Declares the state's election to participate in the federal tax credit for individuals who make qualified contributions to scholarship granting organizations (SGOs) and outlines SGO certification and administration requirements
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS caseworkers; schools; required disclosures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school, on request by a Department of Child Safety (DCS) caseworker, to identify any person who has withdrawn a pupil from the school and any school that has requested a pupil's education records, and to provide the DCS caseworker any other requested information or records relating to a pupil who was enrolled at the school. Prohibits a public or private school from prohibiting any school employee, contractor or volunteer from speaking to a DCS caseworker who is investigating an allegation of abuse or neglect.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: uniform assignment; benefit of creditors
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Uniform Assignment for Benefit of Creditors Act that governs the use of an assignment for benefit of creditors, which is a method for an assignor to transfer control of its assets to an assignee who disposes of the assets and distributes proceeds to creditors according to an order of priority.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: deeds; identification; forgery; notice; notaries
rollCalls.summary: Modifies statutes relating to deeds evidencing a transfer of title to real property, including requirements addressing recordings, notifications and forgeries.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; named claimants
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates monies from various funds to named claimants in FY 2026.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: accommodation schools; high school equivalency
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a county school superintendent to offer high school equivalency (HSE) preparation instruction through an accommodation school to students in grades 11 or 12, rather than only grade 12. Requires a student to be at least 16 years old to participate in HSE preparation instruction through an accommodation school as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: traumatic event counseling
rollCalls.summary: Eliminates the delayed repeal dates on traumatic event counseling for peace officers, firefighters, 911 dispatchers and public safety employees and includes crime scene and digital forensics technicians as public safety employees .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: exactions; individualized determinations; appeal
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality or county from imposing an exaction on an applicant for any proposed project to use or develop real property without a written notice to the applicant of any required exaction. Allows an applicant to request an individualized determination for the required exaction prior to an appeal.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dangerous crimes against children; probation
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the early termination or modification of a period of probation that is imposed in a conviction for a dangerous crime against children (DCAC) on or after January 1, 2027.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: certified public accountants; certification; alternative
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, outlines alternative qualification requirements for an applicant to obtain certification as a certified public accountant (CPA). Modifies the powers and duties of the Arizona State Board of Accountancy (Board).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assisted living homes; occupancy; zoning
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality or county from adopting, enforcing or maintaining any ordinance or other regulation regarding occupancy caps for assisted living homes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: lactation care providers; certification
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that repeals Dr. Cesar Estrada Chavez Day as a state holiday.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; critical infrastructure information
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that authorizes, until December 31, 2031, placement of dangerous and incompetent defendants at the Arizona State Hospital (ASH) when there are no beds available in a secure state mental health facility in Arizona. Establishes the Study Committee on Secure State Mental Health Facilities (Study Committee) to make recommendations on the long-term feasibility of secure state mental health facilities or other care models and outlines Study Committee membership, duties and authorities.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: special plate; Arizona space commission
rollCalls.summary: Establishes an Arizona Space Commission (Commission) special plate and deposits special plate donations in the Space Exploration and Aeronautics Research Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assisted living centers; occupants
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that outlines occupancy requirements for individuals living with a resident in an assisted living center or home and who do not receive supervisory, personal or directed care services.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; memorandum of understanding; tribes
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to make efforts on an annual basis to enter into a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with each Indian Tribe in Arizona that does not have an MOU and outlines the required contents of an MOU.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance adjuster license; eligibility
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes adjuster licensure requirements for a salaried employee of an insurer or managing general agent who held an active designated home state license in another state before January 1, 2026.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax corrections act of 2026
rollCalls.summary: Corrects errors and obsolete language, addresses blending problems and provides clarifying changes to tax statutes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: optometrists; eye exams; prescriptions
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes standards for optometrists conducting eye examinations and prescribing eyeglass prescriptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: aggravated harassment; lifetime injunctions
rollCalls.summary: Adds felony aggravated harassment involving domestic violence to the list of offenses for which a victim may request a lifetime injunction against the convicted defendant.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: worker's compensation; notice; fraud; commission
rollCalls.summary: Includes requirements for insurers relating to a zero estimated exposure policy .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: candidate committees; posthumous closure
rollCalls.summary: Deems that a candidate committee has the intention to terminate after the death of the candidate and outlines an order of succession for the candidate committee treasurer if the deceased candidate was acting as treasurer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: housing; zoning; historic neighborhoods
rollCalls.summary: Includes historic areas in the list of exemptions from duplex, triplex, fourplex and townhome (middle housing) development requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: civil rights advisory board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Civil Rights Advisory Board (Board) for four years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pilot program; sexual abuse prevention
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Child Sexual Abuse and Assault Awareness and Prevention Pilot Program (Pilot Program) in the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) until December 31, 2028.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Charlie Kirk highway
rollCalls.summary: Designates Loop 202 as the Charlie Kirk Loop 202 and requires the designation to be included on official records, documentation and signage.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health instruction requirement; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Removes the requirement for mental health instruction to incorporate the multiple dimensions of health. Repeals, on January 1, 2037, the statutory requirements on the State Board of Education (SBE) to require all health education instruction to include mental health instruction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; DHS; pregnancy resource centers
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $3,000,000 from the state General Fund (GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Department of Health Services for the support of pregnancy resource centers and stipulates that monies may not be distributed to clinics and doctors that provide abortions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; retirement; elected officials
rollCalls.summary: Allows an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member who is an elected official and who attains a normal retirement date to retire at any time without resigning from the member's elected position. Requires an ASRS employer to pay the alternate contribution rate on behalf of an ASRS member who retires from ASRS without terminating employment and on behalf of an elected official who retires from ASRS without resigning from the member's elected position.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeless services; office; board
rollCalls.summary: Creates the Office of Homeless Services, the Arizona Homeless Services Board and the Property Loss Homelessness Compensation Fund to assist in providing homeless services in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona-Sonora trade commission
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona-Sonora Trade Commission (Commission). Lists the Commission's membership, duties and reporting requirements. Repeals the Commission on July 1, 2031.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal improvement districts; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Allows real property owners to petition the Arizona Finance Authority (AFA), until June 30, 2036, to establish a state affordability infrastructure district (district) that is managed by a district board comprised of real property owners in the district and allows a district to issue and sell bonds and levy taxes and assessments. Outlines procedures for district formation petitions, elections, financing, public hearings, governance, powers, dissolution, property disclosures and public infrastructure project review.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful camping; stock; wildlife; access
rollCalls.summary: Strikes a condition relating to the location of a campsite that, if met, would make said campsite unlawful.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vacation rentals; short-term rentals; occupancy
rollCalls.summary: Includes additional regulations that cities, towns and counties (local governments) may enforce regarding vacation and short-term rentals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tourism improvement areas; municipalities; counties
rollCalls.summary: Allows a municipality or county governing body (governing body) to establish a tourism improvement area, approve lodging business assessments on specified lodging businesses within the area and contract with a destination marketing organization to manage the area and its activities. Outlines procedures for tourism improvement area formation petitions, public hearings, management, plans and activities, assessments, amendments and dissolution.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health coverage; diabetes; monitor; supplies
rollCalls.summary: Updates the list of equipment and supplies that health benefit plans must cover for diabetes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state contracts; foreign adversary; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Protection Procurement Act which prohibits a company domiciled in and controlled or majority owned by the People's Republic of China from contracting with a state agency for electronic or information technology, requires a prospective company to certify that the company is not domiciled in China or reselling electronic or information technology from a Chinese company to a state agency and outlines penalties for submitting a false certification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: RV parks; mobile homes; education
rollCalls.summary: Establishes education requirement for park managers of a recreational vehicle park.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental insurers; dental practice; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a dental insurer, or a holding company of a dental insurer, from holding ownership in a business organization that offers public professional services regulated by the Arizona Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; board meetings; expenditures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board (governing board) to hold governing board meetings at a public facility in the school district and provide public access to meeting materials and recordings as outlined. Authorizes a governing board member to remove an item from a consent agenda at any time before the governing board votes on the consent agenda. Prescribes requirements on a governing board regarding the approval of out-of-state travel for school employees and governing board members.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; commerce authority; nuclear; study
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $100,000 from the state General Fund (GF) in Fiscal Year (FY) 2027 to the Arizona Commerce Authority (ACA) to study the economic benefits of small modular reactors and data centers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: replacement units; certificates; environmental compatibility
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a utility to replace an existing electrical generating plant or construct a new plant without a new certificate of environmental compatibility under certain conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internationally trained physicians; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Requires applicants who attended a foreign school of medicine, successfully completed all formal graduation requirements and satisfied all requirements of Pathway One through the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and meets to be granted a provisional medical license if the applicant meets all other applicable criteria.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; special education; access
rollCalls.summary: Outlines procedures for the parent of a pupil who resides in an unorganized territory to request a Child Find screening, special education evaluation or enrollment in the adjoining school district that is geographically closest to the pupil's residence. Modifies the procedures relating to the issuance of certificates of educational convenience (CECs), including application, enrollment and dispute resolutions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: chronic felony offenders; juveniles
rollCalls.summary: Revises the definition of chronic felony offender to include only convictions for class 1, 2 or 3 felonies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: juvenile restoration; rights; firearms; civil
rollCalls.summary: Lowers thresholds for the juvenile restoration of firearm rights subsequent to a juvenile felony criminal conviction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prostitution; assessment; anti-human trafficking fund
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the elements necessary to commit prostitution and establishes an assessment of $200 to be levied on each person who is convicted of prostitution for paying, agreeing or offering to pay for sexual conduct. Requires the assessment to be deposited in the Anti-Human Trafficking Grant Fund (Fund) and used to provide services to victims of sex trafficking.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: license; driver; nonoperating; medical indicia
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, requires the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to use a medical indicator, rather than a medical code, to identify a licensee who has an advanced health care directive that must be reaffirmed upon renewal. Adds a civilian bystander to the persons immune from liability for identifying a patient and allows a medical indicator to be relied on for the identification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cities and towns; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county school superintendent to annually reduce the primary school district taxes levied if the total ending cash balances are greater than the current year's budget balances. Also requires, the assessed valuation to be included in the written estimate for the amount of monies required by each school district for the ensuing school year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: installation license; insurance; rules
rollCalls.summary: Adds a proof of insurance requirement for manufactured or mobile home installers licensed with the Arizona Department of Housing (ADOH). Removes certain rulemaking requirements of the Board of Manufactured Housing (Board).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electoral college; support
rollCalls.summary: Asserts the importance of the Electoral College in presidential elections.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; counties; development fees
rollCalls.summary: Modifies municipal development fee requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: justice courts; administration; due process
rollCalls.summary: Establishes due process requirements and judicial review for administrative actions that materially affect a Justice of the Peace’s statutory authority and clarifies the boundaries of permissible administrative supervision. Imposes legislative reporting, fiscal impact disclosure and funding conditions on court-issued administrative orders affecting local courts and counties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: writ of restitution; criminal trespass
rollCalls.summary: Subjects a defendant to criminal trespass in the first degree , rather than criminal trespass in the third degree , when the defendant is lawfully served with a writ of restitution for forcible entry and detainer or forcible detainer, and the defendant remains in or returns to the property for which the writ of restitution is issued as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: bullion depository; establishment
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Bullion Depository (Depository), administered by the Arizona State Treasurer (Treasurer). Outlines the Treasurer's powers, duties and reporting requirements. Recognizes gold and silver specie as legal tender.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: bronze star medal license plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes 24 special license plates and related funds and outlines administrative requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: bullion depository; state monies; treasurer
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Treasurer to invest and reinvest up to 10 percent of state trust and treasury monies in physical gold or silver bullion that is held in a commercial depository that meets specified requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: local government investment pool; treasurer
rollCalls.summary: Directs the State Treasurer to manage the local government investment pool (Pool) by using state employees and allows the Treasurer to enter into a contract with a third party to conduct its fiduciary duties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: arbitration; divorce proceedings; artificial intelligence
rollCalls.summary: Allows parties to a divorce proceeding to use artificial intelligence-assisted arbitration (AI-assisted arbitration) if outlined circumstances are met and prescribes requirements for a binding determination issued in an AI-assisted arbitration. Prohibits a court from ordering a parent's attendance or payment for any type of therapeutic intervention or similar service without the consent of both parents.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vacation rentals; short-term rentals; occupancy
rollCalls.summary: Includes additional regulations that cities, towns and counties (local governments) may enforce regarding vacation and short-term rentals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: controlled substances prescription monitoring program
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements related to the Controlled Substances Prescription Monitoring Program (CSPMP), including reporting, data submission, prescriber utilization, confidentiality and program administration requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: EMS reciprocity; compact
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Emergency Medical Services (EMS) Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact (Compact) to allow EMS personnel to obtain the privilege to practice in other Compact states. Creates the Interstate Commission for EMS Personnel Practice (Commission) and outlines membership, responsibilities and duties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacists; independent testing; treatment
rollCalls.summary: Allows a pharmacist to independently test and treat eligible persons for certain medical conditions. Requires the Arizona State Board of Pharmacy (Board) to develop a statewide written protocol regarding the independent authority and establishes the Independent Testing and Treatment Advisory Committee (Advisory Committee) to assist with developing the state's protocols.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DUI; alternative treatment
rollCalls.summary: Removes the requirement that a person who is subject to a driver license revocation for multiple driving under the influence (DUI) offenses must complete 45 days of the license revocation period prior to applying for a special ignition interlock restricted driver license (SIIRDL).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Interstate 11; environmental; engineering; study
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to formally request from the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) for segmentation of the Interstate 11 project, as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; homeless veterans; shelter services
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $300,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FYs 2027, 2028, 2029, 2030 and 2031 to the Arizona Department of Veterans' Services (ADVS) to distribute grants to eligible emergency shelters that provide aid to homeless veterans and prescribes related reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; mild obstructive sleep apnea
rollCalls.summary: Requires Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) contractors to provide coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of mild obstructive sleep apnea including patient screening and the use of a United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved neuromuscular tongue muscle stimulator that is an FDA-authorized prescription device provided through a durable medical equipment benefit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: decommissioning; solar energy; standards; fund
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements for solar energy power plants relating to financial assurance, liability insurance, the transfer or sale of a solar energy power plant or special use permit, the curing of damage if part of a solar energy power plant is damaged and the decommissioning and site restoration plan for a solar energy power plant. Establishes the Solar Energy Power Plant Site Remediation Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electronic monitoring; health care facilities
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a resident or the resident's authorized representative's (representative) right to conduct electronic monitoring. Outlines notice requirements for conducting electronic monitoring. Establishes roommate consent requirements, facility and signage requirements, responsibilities for installing and maintaining electronic monitoring devices and authority to access recorded images obtained through electronic monitoring.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: family court; admissibility; evidence
rollCalls.summary: Determines that the criminal history of a parent is admissible as evidence in any child welfare, dependency, parent-child relationship termination, guardianship, parenting time or legal decision-making matter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; kinship care placement; requirement
rollCalls.summary: Adds extended family members to the list of persons who qualify as a kinship foster care placement and requires extended family members to be included in all investigations and proceedings related to identifying a kinship foster care placement for a child in the temporary custody of the Department of Child Safety (DCS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: memorial; Don Bolles
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a memorial in Wesley Bolin Plaza to Don Bolles.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: civil terrorism; disorderly conduct; subversion
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, establishes the criminal classifications of civil terrorism and subversion and classifies a violation of either offense as a class 5 felony. Includes civil terrorism in the statutory definition of racketeering .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child support; preborn children
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court order for child support to be retroactive to the date of a positive pregnancy test that is confirmed by a licensed health care professional and limits the child support to the amount of direct medical and pregnancy-related expenses of the mother of the preborn child.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterans; state park fees; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Exempts a veteran or member of the National Guard who is retired or has a service-connected disability from Arizona State Parks admission fees.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: language acquisition grant program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Language Acquisition Grant Program (Grant Program) to provide grants to listening and spoken language providers that provide services to Arizona Early Intervention Programs and Services (AzEIP) eligible infants and toddlers who are deaf or hard of hearing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child care; grant program; fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Child Care Grant Program (Program) and Child Care Infrastructure Fund (Fund) administered by the Department of Economic Security (DES) to provide services to eligible Arizona families with child care needs. Outlines administrative and eligibility requirements for the Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; credit freeze; consumer reporting
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to place a security freeze on a child's record or credit report within 30 days after the child is placed in the care of DCS.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: task order contracts; website; posting
rollCalls.summary: Requires a municipality, county, school district or a state governmental unit that enters into a task order contract with a contractor to conspicuously post the contract on the entity's website.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; retirement; elected officials
rollCalls.summary: Allows an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member who is an elected official and who attains a normal retirement date to retire at any time without resigning from the member's elected position. Requires an ASRS employer to pay the alternate contribution rate on behalf of an ASRS member who retires from ASRS without terminating employment and on behalf of an elected official who retires from ASRS without resigning from the member's elected position.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: judicial foreclosure; excess proceeds sale
rollCalls.summary: Allows an action to foreclose the right to redeem a property tax lien that is filed in the superior court to include a request to determine if a sale of the property to recover excess proceeds (excess proceeds sale) is reasonable. Allows a certificate holder, in addition to the property owner, to request the court to determine if an excess proceeds sale is reasonable at any time before the court's judgment is effective.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: claims against HOAs; filing fees
rollCalls.summary: Sets the filing fee for petitions filed with the Arizona Department of Real Estate (ADRE) for dispute hearings between an owner and a condominium or planned community association.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firearm destruction
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements relating to the enforceability of postnuptial agreements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; uranium monitoring; mine inspector
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $50,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) to monitor uranium contamination. Requires ADEQ to establish a statewide registry and monitoring program for potential uranium contamination in Arizona, and partner with tribal epidemiology centers for implementation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county land commissioner; state lands
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the State Land Commission (Commission) and county land commissioners. Replaces the State Land Commissioner (Commissioner) with the, newly created, Commission. Outlines the duties, authority and operation of the county land commissioners and Commission respectively.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: court-ordered treatment; judicial review
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the judicial review process for persons receiving court-ordered mental health treatment, including procedures for requesting review, notice and reporting requirements, timelines for court action, rights to counsel and standards for continued treatment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterans' court fund; grant program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Veterans' Specialty Court Grant Program (Grant Program) and the Veterans’ Treatment Court Fund (Fund) to provide grants to municipalities and counties to create or expand and enhance existing veterans’ court programs, outlines procedures to identify and assist incarcerated veterans and prescribes related administrative and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child neglect; financial resources; exception
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a parent, guardian or custodian from being considered as abusing or neglecting a child based solely on the inability to provide supervision, food, clothing, shelter or medical care due to a lack of financial resources.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowners' associations; condominiums; actions; meetings
rollCalls.summary: Removes the authority of a condominium or planned community association to take action without a meeting .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: midwives; medication administration; advisory committee
rollCalls.summary: Transfers the regulatory oversight of licensed midwives from the Department of Health Services (DHS) to the Naturopathic Physicians Medical Board (Board). Outlines prescription administration authority and disclosure and reporting requirements for licensed midwives. Establishes the Arizona Midwifery Advisory Committee (Advisory Committee) in the Board.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowners' associations; shade structures
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a homeowners' association (HOA) from prohibiting the backyard instillation or use of a shade structure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ambulance services; certificates of necessity
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes exceptions to the certification requirements for ambulance services, as modified, establishes quarterly reporting requirements for ambulance services, requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to make outlined information available to the public and assesses penalties for noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; AHCCCS; provider increase
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,500,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) for provider increases for home and community-based services providers for the elderly and persons with physical disabilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parenting time; supervision; professional supervisor
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Independent Oversight Committee on the Department of Child Safety (DCS IOC) and outlines membership, duties and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: PFAS; firefighting foam; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2029, prohibits a person, local government or state agency from discharging or using class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS chemicals for any purpose, unless required by federal regulation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental illness; prisoners; diagnosis; treatment.
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Study Committee on Inmate Mental Health Services (Study Committee) and prescribes membership and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technology study committee; assistive technology
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Technology First Study Committee (Study Committee) and outlines membership, duties and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: automatic subscription renewals; contracts; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements relating to automatic renewal contracts.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: social media; online content; minors
rollCalls.summary: Effective one year after the general effective date, prescribes duties for a covered company, developer or social media platform to provide for user age verification and related online content safeguards for the protection of minors. Outlines enforcement and penalties for a violation of the prescribed duties. Establishes the Technology Protection for Minors Grant Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: bullion depository; establishment
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Bullion Depository (Depository), administered by the Arizona State Treasurer (Treasurer). Outlines the Treasurer's powers, duties and reporting requirements. Recognizes gold and silver specie as legal tender.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county seal; authority; sheriff's posse
rollCalls.summary: Expands the procedures and requirements to authorize a person to use, display or otherwise employ a county seal to include the logo, insignia or another visual or textual identifier of the county or county office, as prescribed. Grants the exclusive right to name a posse associated with the county sheriff's office and dissolve a posse that operates under the county sheriff's jurisdiction to each county sheriff.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire code; municipalities; county buildings
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a city or town, under prescribed conditions, to request the Office of the State Fire Marshall (Office) to enter into an intergovernmental agreement with a county to enforce the fire code adopted by the city or town for county-owned buildings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: authorized transporters
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2030, requires an authorized transporter to apprehend and transport persons for mental health services and prohibits a peace officer from transporting persons for mental health services, except as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sentencing enhancements; vulnerable adults
rollCalls.summary: Establishes enhanced sentencing guidelines for serious felony offenses if the victim of the offense is a vulnerable adult.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: candidate petitions; felony disclosure
rollCalls.summary: Requires a health care provider to provide a patient with access to, or copies of, the patient's medical records or payment records within specified timeframes after receiving a written request.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: traffic penalties; appeal; stay
rollCalls.summary: Requires the court to report the stay of enforcement of a judgment for a traffic violation to the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) if an appeal is granted for the judgment and prohibits ADOT from taking any administrative action until the stay is lifted or the judgment is affirmed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: family court; address confidentiality
rollCalls.summary: Outlines protection requirements for an Address Confidentiality Program (ACP) participant in any marital and domestic relation matter and requires the court to seal an ACP participant's residential address and use a substitute address. Prescribes criminal penalties for obtaining or disclosing information protected by the ACP for the purpose of harassment, stalking or domestic violence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: group homes; safety; training; rights
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the rights of foster care children and drug screening requirements of group foster home employees. Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to develop and implement rules for group foster homes and juvenile group homes respectively, relating to employee screening and resident safety.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: employee merit system; dismissal; appeal
rollCalls.summary: Changes the window that an officer or employee in the classified civil service can appeal an order of dismissal, suspension or reduction to 10 business days after the order is presented to them.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: expired opioid antagonists; use
rollCalls.summary: Expands the types of opioid antagonists that may be dispensed and administered.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ignition interlock devices; violation; classification
rollCalls.summary: Increases the penalty for knowingly lending a motor vehicle without an ignition interlock device to a person whose driving privilege is limited or restricted due to a driving under the influence (DUI) violation, when the person whose driving privilege is restricted is involved in a collision that causes serious physical injury or death.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: local regulation; prohibition; unmanned aircraft
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the prohibition on unmanned aircraft regulations by a city, town or county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Native American language; instruction; certification
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, if the State Board of Education (SBE), a school district or a charter school includes a requirement that students receive instruction in a world language for high school graduation, the SBE, school district or charter school must allow students to satisfy the requirement by demonstrating proficiency in a Native American language. Specifies that a school district or charter school is not required to offer a Native American language course.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; stormwater recharge mapping; sites
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $100,000 from the state General Fund (GF) in fiscal year (FY) 2027 to the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) for updated stormwater recharge mapping. Directs ADWR to provide a map of recharge sites that meet certain specifications.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: brackish groundwater recovery program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Brackish Groundwater Recovery Program Fund (Fund). Requires the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA) to administer the Brackish Groundwater Recovery Program and establish minimum criteria for choosing and evaluating outlined projects. Allows monies and other assets in the Long-Term Water Augmentation Fund (LTWAF) to be used for developing one or more brackish groundwater recovery projects that create new sources of potable water within the boundaries of Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: critical infrastructure; foreign adversaries; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Critical Infrastructure Protection Act to prohibit the use of software and communications equipment produced by a Chinese company in critical infrastructure in Arizona, preempts contracts and agreements that would allow for access or control of critical infrastructure in Arizona, prescribes certification, reporting and publishing requirements and outlines related exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADE; school safety; center; programs
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the School Safety Center (Center) within the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) and the School Safety Center Council (Council). Outlines Council membership and duties and requirements on the Center, including administering the School Safety Program (Safety Program). Modifies requirements relating to the Arizona Empowerment Scholarship Account Program (ESA Program), including requirements for qualified school personnel to obtain a fingerprint clearance card (FPCC) and for the State Treasurer to transfer monies out of an ESA that exceeds the maximum prior year carryforward.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: continuation; state land department
rollCalls.summary: Continues, retroactive to July 1, 2026, the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) for four years until July 1, 2030, and prescribes requirements relating to the leasing of state trust lands, duties of the ASLD and ASLD Commissioner (Commissioner), the implementation of the Auditor General's July 2025 performance audit and sunset review recommendations, public hearings, conceptual land use plans and five-year disposition plans.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: crimes; hostility towards victims; sentencing
rollCalls.summary: Establishes enhanced sentencing and classification provisions for certain offenses committed out of hostility toward a victim based on specified identity characteristics such as race, gender or political affiliation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: truth in taxation; bonds; notices
rollCalls.summary: Adds the tax rate and estimated cost associated with each proposed capital improvement for a single-family home valued at $300,000 to the information required to be included in an informational pamphlet for certain budget override and bond elections. Adds the estimated tax impact of an increase in property taxes on a home valued at $300,000 to the information required to be included in a statutorily required Truth in Taxation hearing notice of tax increase (TNT notice).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: TPT; sourcing; business location; receipt
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the location of servers does not determine where an order is received for purposes of sourcing certain transaction privilege tax (TPT) transactions involving tangible personal property and defines business location .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: identifying information; records; confidentiality
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies that an eligible person may request that the general public be prohibited from accessing that person's identifying information. Specifies that the request to redact a person's identifying information does not prohibit access to an eligible person's voter registration record or unredacted records of a county recorder by statutorily authorized parties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electric service providers; energy reliability
rollCalls.summary: Directs an electric distribution utility, on or after January 1, 2030, to ensure 85% of generating capacity required to serve retail load customers consists of reliable resources. Outlines duties of the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) in enforcing the section.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school district governing boards; training
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district governing board (governing board) member to complete a training program relating to school finance within 45 days after the first day of the governing board member's term of office. Outlines requirements for the training program, including instructional requirements and reporting requirements to ensure governing board member compliance. Deems a governing board member who fails to complete the prescribed training program ineligible for election or appointment to the office of governing board member if outlined conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowners' associations; property covenants; disclosures
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the information that a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or a planned community association (HOA) must include in a disclosure packet.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nursing board; regulatory actions; expungement
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes complaint and investigation procedures for the Arizona State Board of Nursing (AZBN). Establishes a process for the AZBN to expunge certain disciplinary actions imposed on a licensee or certificate holder. Expands the definition of unprofessional conduct for the practice of nursing.
