rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; DPS; local border support
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $20,000,000 in FY 2027 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) for local border support that includes funding for capital-related equipment, local law enforcement officer positions and grants to cities, towns and counties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land department; disposition plan
rollCalls.summary: Directs the Arizona State Land Commissioner to complete the five-year disposition plan (Disposition Plan) and conceptual land use plan (Conceptual Plan) for state lands and adopt relevant policies for implementation by June 30, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small modular reactors; zoning; co-location
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirement for a county to adopt or readopt a long-term comprehensive plan and outlines requirements for the siting and development of nuclear generating units in designated nuclear-ready communities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public utilities; plant construction; colocation
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the conditions that allow a utility to construct a new plant without filing for or receiving a certificate of environmental compatibility (certificate).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: urban growth boundaries; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a city, town, county, the State and its agencies from implementing any regulation that imposes urban growth boundaries preventing new development.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: department of economic security; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Department of Economic Security (DES) for four years and modifies various DES programs and services, including Unemployment Insurance (UI) benefits and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). Requires hospitals that accept payment from the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to include on patient admission forms a place to indicate citizenship status and prescribes quarterly reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land use; highest; best
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona State Land Commissioner (Commissioner) to prioritize the sale of state lands that are subject to an underperforming commercial lease if the lessee provides notice to the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) that the lessee is willing and prepared to purchase the parcel in fee simple consistent with outlined requirements. Prescribes requirements relating to the sale of state lands that are subject to an underperforming commercial lease.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; department of veterans' services
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $500,000 in FY 2027 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Arizona Department of Veterans' Services (ADVS) to partner with an educational institution in Yavapai County to provide veterans' programs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electronic signatures; nomination petitions
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Secretary of State (SOS) to provide for nomination petitions for outlined local governing boards to be signed using E-Qual and requires candidates seeking office to designate alignment with a recognized political party, or lack thereof, within the E-Qual system before using the system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public bodies; executive sessions; agenda
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public body from placing any proposal that imposes or increases a tax or fee on a consent agenda. Requires any matter that is discussed in executive session that requires a final vote to be placed on the regular agenda.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: social credit; use; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state from requiring a bank or financial institution to use a social credit score when evaluating whether to lend money to a customer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: registrar of contractors; administrative recovery
rollCalls.summary: Repeals the statute governing the pathway for a dental assistant to practice as an oral preventative assistant.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: utility; resource plan; commission review
rollCalls.summary: Outlines an integrated resource plan (plan) and requires an electric public service corporation submit the plan to Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) every 3 years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: renewable energy equipment; valuation; depreciation
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the methodology to determine the full cash value (FCV) of renewable energy and storage equipment for property tax purposes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: qualified facilities; tax credit; amount
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, adds a fourth option for the amount of the Credit for Qualified Facilities which is $25,000 per qualified job created in a rural location, if the total qualified investment is less than $2 billion.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; eligibility; verification; SNAP; contractors
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $3,450,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) for the School Safety Interoperability Fund (Interoperability Fund). Outlines distributions that ADOA may make to county sheriff offices in FY 2027 from the Interoperability Fund. Requires each public school to test the school safety program at least twice annually to ensure functionality.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; counties; development fees
rollCalls.summary: Modifies municipal development fee requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: photo enforcement systems; prohibition.
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily prohibits a local authority or state agency from using a photo enforcement system to identify violators of speed restrictions or traffic control devices, unless specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ballot measures; circulators; revenue; disclosure
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily applies the strict compliance standard of review to initiatives and referendum for cities, towns and counties and subjects petition circulators to additional requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; comprehensive claims audit
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, requires the Director of the Joint Legislative Budget Committee (JLBC) to contract with a qualified audit vendor to coordinate with the U.S. Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) to conduct a comprehensive claim-level audit of Arizona's Medicaid program administered by the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mining; mineral; museum; state history
rollCalls.summary: Requires the University of Arizona (U of A), in coordination with the Mining, Mineral and Natural Resources Education Museum Advisory Council (Council), to promote the history of Arizona and the importance of the Five C's.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: income tax; refunds; veterans' organizations
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to provide a space on the individual income tax return form in which a taxpayer may voluntarily contribute to a 501(c)(19) veterans' organization. Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Veterans' Services (ADVS) to establish a separate subaccount within the Veterans' Donations Fund (Fund) to collect the taxpayer contributions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sex offenders; electronic monitoring
rollCalls.summary: Requires the court to place any registered sex offender who does not have an address or a permanent place of residence on the global position system or electronic monitoring until one is acquired.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful masking; violation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a sentencing enhancement that requires a person who is convicted of any offense that was committed while wearing a mask with the intent to conceal the person's identity to be sentenced for the next higher class of offense than that for which the person is charged.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: motorcycles; reckless driving
rollCalls.summary: Classifies operating a motorcycle between the lanes of traffic or to overtake and pass a vehicle in the same lane as reckless driving, which is a class 2 misdemeanor, except when authorized.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pilot program; sexual abuse prevention
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Child Sexual Abuse and Assault Awareness and Prevention Pilot Program (Pilot Program) in the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) until December 31, 2028.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DPS; legal representation; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $6,400,000 from the Consumer Protection-Consumer Fraud Revolving Fund in FY 2026 to the Department of Public Safety (DPS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative session; adjournment
rollCalls.summary: A constitutional amendment that requires the Legislature to adjourn sine die by April 30 of each year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: celebrate life month
rollCalls.summary: States that the Legislature proclaims June 2026 as Celebrate Life Month in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: minimum wage; exception; homeless
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally prohibits a school district from using public monies and resources to support a labor organization's operations or perform labor organization activities during working hours beginning January 1, 2028. Prohibits a school district employee from distributing any communications in a manner that consumes public resources on a labor organization's behalf beginning January 1, 2028.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elected officials; salary; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally prohibits the state from confiscating monies from any scholarship account of a student who is a child of a military family if outlined conditions are met. Stipulates that, if a law or measure approved by the voters on or after November 1, 2026, violates the prohibition, the entire law or measure is void. Designates this resolution as the Military Families College Savings and Scholarship Protection Act .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical mandates; right to refuse
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally recognizes the right to refuse medical mandates and prohibits a government entity from mandating any individual to receive or administer any medical treatment as a condition of employment, education or exercising any right or benefit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county sheriffs; expressing support
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's support for and recognition of county sheriffs in Arizona and encourages all Arizonans to support and appreciate their county sheriffs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: exceptional events; air quality; wildfires
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) to submit an exceptional event demonstration to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) if a wildfire that is larger than 25,000 acres occurs on federally managed land and the attributable smoke or land damage affects Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: educational institutions; interference; disruption
rollCalls.summary: Classifies, as a class 1 misdemeanor, rather than a class 6 felony, interference with or disruption of an educational institution for persons younger than 18 years old who threaten to cause physical injury or damage to property as outlined. Redefines interference with or disruption of .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water supply development; definition; snowpack
rollCalls.summary: Adds to the definition of water supply development to allow the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA) to fund or finance snowpack augmentation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water conservation grant fund; education
rollCalls.summary: Removes education and research programs from the eligible uses of monies in the Water Conservation Grant Fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public educational institutions; adoption information
rollCalls.summary: Requires a public educational institution to provide information relating to current adoption practices in the United States to students if an employee discusses or dispenses contraception or discusses or provides testing for sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) or sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Adds instructional requirements relating to adoption that each school district and charter school must include in the school district's or charter school's sex education curricula.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: solar radiation management; prohibition; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person from intentionally injecting, releasing or dispensing or causing the injection, release or dispensation of any material within Arizona for solar radiation management, which is the modification or attempted modification of atmospheric reflectivity that modifies the amount or intensity of sunlight that reaches the Earth.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: orders of protection; process servers
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) from imposing more restrictive utilization controls on prescription non-opioid drugs used to treat moderate to severe pain than on prescription opioid or narcotic drugs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: management plan; water loss; percent
rollCalls.summary: Mandates the Arizona Department of Water Resources Director require an entity that has been designated as having as assured water supply in an initial active management area that receives Central Arizona Project water to limit lost and unaccounted for water to less than 10 percent of the entity's total quantity of water that enters their distribution system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: educational facilities; abortion; prohibited activities
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public educational institution from encouraging or facilitating an abortion and prohibits a public school from allowing an abortion provider to provide health education instruction or distribute any health education materials from the abortion provider. Allows the Superintendent of Public Instruction (SPI), if outlined circumstances are met, to withhold a public school's apportionment of Basic State Aid for a violation of the prescribed prohibition on allowing an abortion provider to provide health education instruction or materials.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; independent correctional oversight office.
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,500,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Corrections Oversight Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; well depth
rollCalls.summary: Increases factors to be determined by the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) Director in determining depth to water as it relates to determining assured water supply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small land subdivision; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county board of supervisors (county BOS) to adopt ordinances and regulations that allow small land subdivisions of 6 to 10 lots or parcels for parcels that are two acres or more in size and not subject to an assured water supply requirement or a mandatory adequate water supply requirement. Requires an applicant for small land subdivisions to submit a small land subdivision report and notice. Prescribes disclosure requirements for small land subdivisions and civil penalties for violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small land subdivision; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county board of supervisors (county BOS) to adopt ordinances and regulations that allow small land subdivisions of 6 to 10 lots or parcels for parcels that are two acres or more in size and not subject to an assured water supply requirement or a mandatory adequate water supply requirement. Requires an applicant for small land subdivisions to submit a small land subdivision report and notice. Prescribes disclosure requirements for small land subdivisions and civil penalties for violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: domestic water improvement districts; hauling
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county improvement district (district) that is formed in a subsequent active management area (AMA) or in a groundwater transportation basin or subbasin, for the purpose of delivering water through water hauling, to exercise the power of eminent domain only for the limited purpose of acquiring or otherwise securing a site in the subsequent AMA or groundwater transportation basin or subbasin for the construction of and legal access to a single well and a standpipe to produce water and make water available at the site for delivery through water hauling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water improvements program; water hauling
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements of a water improvements program by allowing persons to make gifts, grants or donations for the purpose of providing financial assistance to qualified owners of residential real property for water hauling, water delivery and by allowing a county with a water improvements program to use the collections from groundwater transportation fees only for qualified owners of residential property who reside within the groundwater transportation basin.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADOA; personnel; financial systems
rollCalls.summary: Directs the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) Director to consult with the Legislature's budget units to accommodate the Legislature's personnel and financial policies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: PSPRS; investments.
rollCalls.summary: Provides Public safety Personal Retirement System (PRSPRS) may not hold more than 5% voting stock of any publicly traded corporation that the PSPRS board administers or is owned by the system and other plans that the board administers, except that this limitation does not apply to membership interests in limited liability companies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: continuation; state land department
rollCalls.summary: Continues, retroactive to July 1, 2026, the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) for four years until July 1, 2030, and prescribes requirements relating to the leasing of state trust lands, duties of the ASLD and ASLD Commissioner (Commissioner), the implementation of the Auditor General's July 2025 performance audit and sunset review recommendations, public hearings, conceptual land use plans and five-year disposition plans.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: licensed health aides; rules
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona State Board of Nursing (AZBN) to adopt rules to implement the prescribed scope of practice for licensed health aides.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: criminal records sealed; petty offense
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person convicted of a petty offense to petition the court to seal the person's records of the offense immediately after completing all nonmonetary terms and conditions of the person's sentence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firefighters; occupational disease; adenocarcinoma
rollCalls.summary: Makes clarifying changes regarding the occupational disease classification for peace officers and firefighters.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: evictions; satisfaction of judgments
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements that apply when a landlord fails to respond to a motion to compel satisfaction of a judgment following an eviction action.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical interventions; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits business entities, ticket issuers, schools and state, county and local government entities or officials from requiring a person to receive or use a medical intervention or discriminating against a person based on whether the person has received or used a medical intervention.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical interventions; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits business entities, ticket issuers, schools and state, county and local government entities or officials from requiring a person to receive or use a medical intervention or discriminating against a person based on whether the person has received or used a medical intervention.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: testimony; disciplinary action; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Preempts an agency, employer or political subdivision of the state from prohibiting or obstructing and from taking any retaliatory action against an employee for testifying in a proceeding relating to the appeal of a disciplinary action.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: teachers academy; community college students
rollCalls.summary: Increases the maximum number of academic years, from two to four, and semesters, from four to eight, that a community college student may participate in the Arizona Teachers Academy (Academy). Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurers covering firefighters; rate deviation
rollCalls.summary: Allows an insurer covering firefighters and fire investigators to file one uniform percentage deviation only if the insurer is not reimbursed for claims from the Municipal Firefighter Cancer Reimbursement Fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: distributions; transportation projects; Pinal county
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a onetime individual income tax rebate for Arizona taxpayers whose primary residence was located in Pinal County during TYs 2018 through 2024. Requires the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to pay the rebates between October 15, 2027, and November 15, 2027, from the monies remaining in the escrow account managed by the Pinal Regional Transportation Authority. Prescribes the rebate amount and administrative procedures.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: private towing carriers; regulation; rates
rollCalls.summary: Requires counties, cities and towns to adopt standard fees and charges for towing from private properties by private towing carriers based on the market standards or the Department of Public Safety (DPS) tow service agreement as outlined. Prescribes requirements relating to towing from private properties by private towing carriers and requirements relating to the release of an impounded motor vehicle from a private towing carrier. Establishes the Heavy-Duty Truck Towing Study Committee (Study Committee) and outlines Study Committee membership and duties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; school district boards
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits any school district or charter school teacher from striking or engaging in an organized work stoppage against the school district or charter school. Requires the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to reduce the Base Support Level (BSL) of a school district or charter school if a teacher's strike or organized work stoppage occurs in violation of the prohibition.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: line siting; factors; total environment
rollCalls.summary: Expands the factors to be considered in issuing a Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (CEC) to include the total character of an area.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: line siting; factors; offtakers
rollCalls.summary: Expands determining factors for issuing a Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (CEC) to include the speculativeness of the proposed transmission line or plant as identified by the existence of known offtakers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: abortion-inducing drugs; violations; classifications
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes penalties for violations of the prohibition against providing abortion-inducing drugs via courier, delivery or mail service, and classifies ordering an abortion-inducing drug through the mail as a class 1 misdemeanor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: neighborhood electric vehicles; VLT; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of motor vehicle , for the purposes of the alternative fuel vehicle license tax (VLT), to exclude golf carts and neighborhood electric vehicles.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; weapons detection systems; administration
rollCalls.summary: Allows, if a school district or charter school has a weapons detection system, the school district governing board (governing board) or charter school governing body (governing body) to authorize the school district superintendent or highest-ranking charter school officer to modify the weapons detection system without prior approval. Requires a school district superintendent or the highest-ranking charter school officer to report each modification within 24 hours after the modification is made.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; superintendent; employment contracts
rollCalls.summary: Limits the employment term of a superintendent to one year if the superintendent has not been employed by the school district as a superintendent for at least three consecutive years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADOT; revisions
rollCalls.summary: Revises various transportation requirements, including requirements relating to high occupancy vehicle lanes (HOV lanes), driver licenses and primitive roads.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: kratom products; narcotic drugs
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements relating to kratom product regulation. Adds any quantity of various synthetic mitragyna speciosa compounds and any compound containing at least 800 ppm of 7-hydroxymytragynine to the statutory list of narcotic drugs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: advanced mathematics courses; student enrollment
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district and charter school to enroll a student in grades six through eight in an advanced mathematics course for the student's next mathematics course if the student's parent does not object and the student meets at least one eligibility requirement as outlined. Outlines parental communication requirements for students who enroll in an advanced mathematics course as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: land department; audit; recommendations; checklist
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Land Commissioner to implement all recommendations in the July 2025 performance audit and sunset review of the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona commission on student outcomes
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Commission on Student Outcomes (Commission) to review and recommend improvements to the K-12 education system. Appropriates a total of $5,000,000 from the Classroom Site Fund (CSF) in FYs 2027 through 2031 to the Commission.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: apprenticeships; registration; certificate
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the definition for apprenticeship within the Department of Economic Security (DES) statutes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; clubs; organizations; parental consent
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public school from allowing any student in grades six, seven or eight to participate in or join a student club or organization without first obtaining written parental permission. Outlines requirements for communication with parents when requesting parental permission for a student's participation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: utility relocation; funding; bonds
rollCalls.summary: Instructs a municipality to provide public notice of any voter-approved municipal bond project and to develop a relocation reimbursement process regarding telecommunications utility relocation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: procurement; professionals; construction services
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a cooperative agreement used to procure a single contract for job-order-contracting construction services, modifies the request for proposal process regarding construction-manager-at-risk procurement, authorizes and defines progressive design-build procurement, and expands the definition of horizontal construction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nursing board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Department of Economic Security (DES), the Arizona State Board of Nursing, the Arizona Board of Occupational Therapy Examiners, the Arizona Regulatory Board of Physician Assistants and the Arizona State Board of Pharmacy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: occupational therapy board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Board of Occupational Therapy Examiners (Board) for four years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physician assistants; board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Regulatory Board of Physician Assistants (Board) for four years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacy board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona State Board of Pharmacy (Board) for six years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacy board; renewals; ownership change
rollCalls.summary: Modifies pharmacy regulations by revising licensing, renewal and continuing education requirements, expanding permissible delivery locations for prescriptions and establishing requirements for continued operation of a pharmacy during a change of ownership.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative subpoena; perjury; refusal; contempt
rollCalls.summary: Allows a legislative committee to hold a witness in contempt for neglecting to obey a legislative subpoena, if an order of contempt is issued for failure to comply with the subpoena after the witness is given an opportunity for a hearing to present evidence as to why the witness is not in contempt.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: trade offices study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Study Committee on Trade Offices (Study Committee). Lists the Study Committee's membership and outlines its duties. Repeals the Study Committee on September 30, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: felony conviction; sentence completion; designation
rollCalls.summary: Allows the court to designate a class 4, 5 or 6 felony conviction as a class 1 misdemeanor conviction if outlined conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land use; highest; best
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona State Land Commissioner (Commissioner) to prioritize the sale of state lands that are subject to an underperforming commercial lease if the lessee provides notice to the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) that the lessee is willing and prepared to purchase the parcel in fee simple consistent with outlined requirements. Prescribes requirements relating to the sale of state lands that are subject to an underperforming commercial lease.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: international organizations; government resources; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state's agencies, political subdivisions and employees from enforcing or implementing international organization mandates or using state resources to assist in their enforcement or implementation. Prohibits institutions of higher education from collaborating with outlined entities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: corporation commission; utilities; amortization; tariffs
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes disclosure requirements for the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) and public service corporations if a regulatory asset is included in rate base or otherwise reflected in the rates based on a test year or historical balance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: federal nullification; Mexican wolf; reintroduction
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state, any agency or political subdivision of Arizona and any employee of Arizona or an agency or political subdivision of Arizona acting in the employee's official capacity from using any personnel or financial resources to enforce, administer or cooperate with the Mexican Wolf Reintroduction Program under the Endangered Species Act.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cell-cultured protein; sale; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the sale of cell-cultured protein for human consumption.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: annexation of territory; procedures
rollCalls.summary: Allows a city or town to waive the 30-day waiting period and public hearing requirement for a proposed annexation where the property owner who proposes the annexation encompasses 100 percent of the property to be annexed. Modifies public hearing notice requirements for a proposed annexation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small modular reactors; zoning; approval
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits county ordinances from restricting the use of land for the construction of a small modular reactor (SMR) if, prior to the construction, the SMR provides evidence of adherence to outlined federal site permits and design certifications to the corresponding county board of supervisors (county BOS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Arizona geological survey; study
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates an unspecified amount from the state General Fund (GF) in FY 2027 to the University of Arizona for distribution to the Arizona Geological Survey to conduct a mineral and metal study relating to materials for nuclear energy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: lawful presence; public programs; verification
rollCalls.summary: Requires the citizenship of an applicant for voter registration, a driver or nonoperating identification license or the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to be verified by using the Systematic Alien Verification for Entitlements (SAVE) Program, outlines procedures and penalties for compliance and prescribes quarterly reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: statewide cybersecurity encryption system; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the state to implement a statewide cybersecurity system that uses post-quantum encryption for each state agency that processes outlined information.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: obstructing governmental operations; lawful arrest
rollCalls.summary: Expands the criminal classification of obstructing governmental operations to include knowingly obstructing, impairing or hindering the making of a lawful arrest by using or threatening to use violence or physical force and classifies a violation as a class 5 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fetal and prenatal development; instruction
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Board of Education (SBE) to adopt age-appropriate academic standards in the area of science that require prescribed instruction on fetal and prenatal human development.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mandatory reporting; violent threats; minors
rollCalls.summary: Expands mandatory reporting requirements to include violent threats by minors.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: notary public; examination; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes disclosure requirements relating to public hearings for municipal zoning matters.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; national guard
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to store an inmate's medical records electronically and allows ADCRR to dispose of any physical copies of an inmate's medical records if the medical records are stored electronically.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: residence of sex offenders; regulation
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person who is registered as a level two or three sex offender from residing in the same single-family dwelling as another registered sex offender, unless certain exceptions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: competitive sealed bidding; questions; answers
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a person or organization that files a referendum petition with a city or town to file a written notice of withdrawal of the referendum petition before the measure qualifies for the ballot.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign committees; termination statements; contributions
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that, retroactive to July 6, 2016, modifies procedures relating to the accrual and assessment of penalties for untimely filing of campaign finance reports when a committee files a termination statement as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; membership
rollCalls.summary: Requires one of the six licensed dentists on the State Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) to be an actively practicing oral and maxillofacial surgeon.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: traffic schools; instructors; fingerprint clearance
rollCalls.summary: Requires, effective January 1, 2027, instructors who are employed by or under contract with a traffic survival school to provide the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) with a standard fingerprint clearance card. Allows a person whose fingerprint clearance card application is pending within the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to be granted a temporary work authorization by the relevant agency while the person's application is being processed if outlined conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firefighter cancer registry
rollCalls.summary: Outlines official law enforcement purposes for which a law enforcement agency (LEA) may use a government mass surveillance network, including an automated license plate reader (surveillance network). Prescribes requirements relating to the use of a surveillance network, including training, data management and authorization by the qualified electors of a local government jurisdiction before deployment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: renewable energy equipment; valuation; depreciation
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the methodology to determine the full cash value (FCV) of renewable energy and storage equipment for property tax purposes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: housing; contractors; bonds; taxes
rollCalls.summary: Allows municipalities to administer a workforce housing project expedited plan and permitting process and exempts such projects from the State's portion of the prime contracting sales tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mandatory rounding method; cash transactions
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure effective March 12, 2026, that requires sellers to apply the Swedish rounding method in cash transactions if one-cent coins are not available or utilized at a point of sale.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gasoline formulations; air quality
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) and the Associate Director of the Weights and Measures Services Division of the Arizona Department of Agriculture (Associate Director), notwithstanding the state implementation plan and if the U.S. Energy Information Administration's short-term energy outlook identifies supply issues for gasoline or crude oil, to collaborate to submit an emergency fuel formulation waiver to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) for the period between March 1 and October 31 of each year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: driver license; enhanced; mobile; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to continue to make driver and nonoperating identification licenses available that are not compliant with the federal REAL ID Act of 2005 (REAL ID Act). Outlines prohibitions and restrictions on ADOT from collecting, retaining and storing certain information when issuing a driver or nonoperating identification license.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fraudulent schemes; artifices; jurisdiction
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, in a prosecution for fraudulent schemes or artifices, the state is not required to establish that all of the unlawful acts occurred in Arizona or within a single city, town, county or local jurisdiction of Arizona, and that it is not a defense that not all of the unlawful acts occurred in Arizona or within political subdivisions of Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state lands; solar score; maps
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) to suspend the use of solar scores or other similar solar evaluators and develop a mining resource scoring map and a housing resource scoring map every 10 years, or earlier if determined by the ASLD Commissioner (Commissioner).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: credit unions; certificates; powers; committee
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes response times for the Deputy Director of the Financial Institutions Division within the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (Deputy Director) when receiving a completed request for a proposed credit union bylaws amendment, name change or change in principal place of business or branch within Arizona. Requires a state-chartered credit union to submit a request to the Deputy Director to exercise rights, powers and privileges of an out-of-state credit union.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: department of environmental quality; programs
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements for the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) relating to the Solid Waste Fee Fund and the Lead Acid Battery Disposal, Open Burning Permitting and Used Oil Programs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: domestic relations; domestic violence
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that revises the statutory requirements that apply to a legal decision-making or parenting time matter or a modification of a legal decision-making or parenting time matter when there is an allegation of domestic violence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DIFI; certificates of insurance
rollCalls.summary: Defines certificate of insurance and establishes regulations for a certificate of insurance. Prohibits a certificate of insurance from misrepresenting an insurance policy and allows the Director of the Department of Financial Institutions (Director) to investigate and act on any violation of the prohibition.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; universities; admissions
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's support for efforts by public schools to ensure that each student participates in a minimum of 60 minutes of physical activity each school day and to display the Dietary Guidelines for Americans in an accessible school location.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: for-sale housing; development; groundwater replenishment
rollCalls.summary: Declares that the members of the Legislature support the building of for-sale housing developments outside the service area of designated providers if the development is enrolled in the Central Arizona Groundwater Replenishment District (CAGRD) and replenishes groundwater as required by the Phoenix, Pinal and Tucson active management area (AMA) assured water supply rules.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Colorado River; seven-state agreement
rollCalls.summary: Declares that the Members of the Legislature support a mutual , seven-state agreement that benefits all Basin States and protects the major population centers and industries in Arizona that are vital to national security, economy and food supply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: preferential treatment; discrimination; prohibited acts
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally prohibits the state from compelling or spending public monies on promoting or giving preferential treatment to or discriminating against any individual on the basis of race or ethnicity.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: supporting geothermal energy
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's support for the development of a geothermal permitting roadmap, the alignment of existing agency rules related to geothermal development and innovative next-generation energy resource development.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; counties; recycling; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a conservative grassroots network special plate and the Conservative Grassroots Network Special Plate Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fuel formulations; modeling; study; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) to evaluate using the most recent air emissions modeling approved by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), outlined gasoline blends and appropriates $100,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to ADEQ for the evaluation. Requires the Associate Director of the Weights and Measures Services Division (Associate Director) of the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) to conduct the outlined fuel blend feasibility study and appropriates $100,000 from the state GF in FY 2027 to AZDA for the study.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: budget procedures; late filing penalty
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes penalties for an organization's failure to submit accurate and complete financial statements to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to comply with federal single audit requirements and deadlines. Caps the total penalty assessed in any fiscal year at $8,000,000 or at one percent of the organization's state General Fund (GF) appropriation for the fiscal year in which the penalty is assessed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: land divisions; disclosure affidavit; recording
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the information required for an affidavit of disclosure for selling certain parcels of land.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: statewide assessment; written form; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a school district or charter school to administer the statewide assessment in the form of a written test on approval by a majority vote of the school district governing board or charter school governing body.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: abandonment; concealment of body; classification
rollCalls.summary: Increases penalties for abandoning or concealing a dead human body if the offense is committed with the intent to conceal a crime or if the offender causes the death of the person.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: radiologic technologists; radiologist assistants
rollCalls.summary: Modifies Department of Health Services (DHS) standards regarding radiologic technologists and radiologic assistants, including radiologic technology school approvals, certification requirements and supervision requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: brackish groundwater recovery program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Brackish Groundwater Recovery Program Fund (Fund). Requires the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA) to administer the Brackish Groundwater Recovery Program and establish minimum criteria for choosing and evaluating outlined projects. Allows monies and other assets in the Long-Term Water Augmentation Fund (LTWAF) to be used for developing one or more brackish groundwater recovery projects that create new sources of potable water within the boundaries of Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: special plate; centennial; fleet discount
rollCalls.summary: Lowers the registration and renewal fee for the Arizona Centennial Special Plate for vehicles registered in a registered fleet.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school safety; employee certification; policies
rollCalls.summary: Creates the Save Our Children School Safety Program (Program) and Save Our Children School Safety Program Fund (Fund) within the Arizona Department of Education (ADE). Allows an eligible school to adopt policies to authorize employees to carry a concealed firearm on school grounds if prescribed notification, training and certification and confidentiality requirements are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: childhood cancer research; commission
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Childhood Cancer and Rare Childhood Disease Research Commission (Commission) consisting of monies allocated from the Childhood Cancer and Rare Childhood Disease Research Fund (Fund). Outlines Commission grant qualifications and membership.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vaccination mandates; masks; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits governmental entities from imposing a mask, face covering or vaccination requirement on any Arizona resident.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transportation tax; deposit; county board
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that allocates any undistributed or nonrefunded revenues collected from a county transportation excise tax to the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) for transportation projects in the county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: natural resource conservation board; fund
rollCalls.summary: Caps the annual distribution by the Arizona Natural Resource Conservation Board (Board) to each Natural Resource Conservation District (NRCD) with an established education center at $10,000 and requires the Board, rather than the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD), to disburse annual donations in the Environmental Special Plate Fund for environmental education programs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal public libraries; annual report
rollCalls.summary: Revises the date by which a city or town (municipality's) Library Trustees must complete their annual report.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: petition; waiver; fuel formulations
rollCalls.summary: Conditional on the U.S. EPA's approval of the proposed modifications to the gasoline fuel blend requirements for Area A as part of the state implementation plan for air quality by July 1, 2027, allows any registered supplier or oxygenate blender to petition both the President of the Senate and Speaker of the House of Representatives (House) to request a waiver for all registered suppliers or oxygenate blenders from compliance with statutorily prescribed fuel reformulation requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: deer; taking; landowner permits
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Game and Fish Department (AZGFD) to issue landowner permits for deer hunting on private lands.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: game and fish commission; membership.
rollCalls.summary: Requires at least one member of the Arizona Game and Fish Commission be a cattleman or a rancher.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health facilities; licensure; complaints; investigations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the criteria under which the Department of Health Services (DHS) may deny a health care institution license or change of ownership. Establishes requirements and procedures for DHS complaint investigations, compliance inspections and the issuance and dispute of statements of deficiencies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: emergency medicine; study committee
rollCalls.summary: Creates the Study Committee on Emergency Medicine (Study Committee) and outlines membership, duties and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowners' associations; lawns; drought
rollCalls.summary: States that a condominium owners' association or planned community homeowners' association is prohibited from requiring the overseeding or watering of lawns during a declared drought.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nursing facilities; records; surveys; timelines
rollCalls.summary: Modifies Department of Health Services (DHS) oversight and investigative procedures for nursing care institutions, including personnel record access and complaint investigations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful camping; stock; wildlife; access
rollCalls.summary: Strikes a condition relating to the location of a campsite that, if met, would make said campsite unlawful.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; dementia care; telementoring program
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $300,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FYs 2027, 2028 and 2029 to the Department of Health Services (DHS) to provide a grant to a qualified organization to implement a dementia care telementoring program to disseminate information to health care providers statewide regarding dementia care and best practices.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; braille transcription program
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $300,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) for the Braille Transcription Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: produce incentive program; annual appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,000,000 in FY 2027, and each fiscal year after, from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Department of Economic Security (DES) to implement the Produce Incentive Program (Program).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: processing arrestees; veteran status
rollCalls.summary: Requires the court to inquire as to a person's veteran status at the person's initial appearance hearing and to notify the prosecuting agency if the person is a veteran. Requires the prosecuting agency to consider referring the person to the veterans' court, other treatment court or diversion program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parents' bill of rights; remedies
rollCalls.summary: Adds, to the Parents' Bill of Rights, the right to consent and be informed if any school employee facilitates or implements any form of social transitioning for a minor child and the right to request, review and access a minor child's complete educational record. Sets minimum liability requirements and remedies if a governmental entity or institution, or employees or officials of such entities, engage in specified actions that violate the Parents' Bill of Rights.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; agricultural real property
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the class 2 property subclassification that consists of real property and improvements includes property used as agricultural real property, rather than property used for agricultural purposes. Requires property classified as agricultural real property, rather than land used for agricultural purposes, to be valued using only the income approach to value without any allowance for urban or market influences.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school attendance requirements; religious purposes
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates a school district governing board (governing board) or charter school governing body (governing body) policy must allow students to be excused for religious purposes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public nuisance; renewable energy; exceptions
rollCalls.summary: Classifies certain renewable energy projects within four miles of a residential property as a public nuisance. Provides exemptions for classification as a public nuisance for specified renewable energy projects.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: certificate; environmental compatibility; factors
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Power Plant and Transmission Line Siting Committee to evaluate an application for a proposed transmission line by considering all referenced factors if the factors pertain to an electric generating unit that is related to the proposed transmission line.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; auditor general; 2028-2029
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,385,900 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2029 to the Auditor General (OAG) for county treasurer procedural reviews.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; leases; housing development
rollCalls.summary: Amends Laws 2014, Chapter 259, which established trampoline court regulations, to designate the legislation as Ty's Law .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; lease agreements; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Modifies a school district governing board's (governing board's) authority to enter into a lease for or purchase school property, including by requiring school district elector approval to enter a lease that is for a period of at least 10, rather than 20, years and prohibiting the purchase of a school site that is located outside of a school district's geographic boundaries. Narrows the eligibility for a tax exemption for educational and library property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school district superintendents; performance-based pay
rollCalls.summary: Establishes requirements a school district governing board (governing board) must follow in order to award a superintendent performance-based pay. Prescribes civil penalties if performance-based pay requirements are not met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: excessive speed; speed inhibiting device
rollCalls.summary: Effective July 1, 2027, allows a court to order the installation of a speed inhibiting device on the motor vehicle of a person whose driver license or operating privilege has been suspended for an outlined violation in lieu of the suspension and on request of a person, outlines requirements for submitting proof of installation, the certification of devices, administrative rules and procedures and penalties for violations and noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; major incident task forces
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $600,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Criminal Justice Commission (ACJC) to distribute, and requires the FY 2026 appropriation of $600,000 to ACJC for the major incident regional law enforcement task force to be distributed, evenly to the sheriffs' offices of the original five Major Incident Division task forces, as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land department; disposition plan
rollCalls.summary: Directs the Arizona State Land Commissioner to complete the five-year disposition plan (Disposition Plan) and conceptual land use plan (Conceptual Plan) for state lands and adopt relevant policies for implementation by June 30, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: emissions; reduction credits; counties
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county to claim concurrent jurisdiction over components of a portable source and mobile sources within the county jurisdiction for the sole purpose of issuing, revising or enforcing a permit for emission reduction credits (ERCs).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: podiatric licensure compact
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact (Compact) to allow podiatric physicians to obtain licensure in other Compact States. Creates the Interstate Podiatric Medical Licensure Compact Commission (Interstate Commission) and outlines membership, authorities and responsibilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public cold plunge; rules; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Excludes single-user public or semipublic cold plunges from rules adopted by the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) governing water pollution in public or semipublic swimming pools and bathing places.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prisoners; transition program
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to grant a onetime, 90-day extension for an eligible inmate to continue receiving transition services if the inmate meets certain eligibility requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial driver license; English proficiency
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the list of additional knowledge examinations that an original applicant for a commercial driver license (CDL) must take by including an English proficiency examination.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: motor carriers; English proficiency
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to enforce the federal English language proficiency requirements for commercial motor vehicle drivers and appropriates $400,000 from the Arizona Highway Patrol Fund (Fund) in FY 2027 to DPS for commercial motor vehicle inspector training.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance; reimbursement rates; nurse anesthetist
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits health care insurers that issue, amend or renew a contract or policy from imposing a reimbursement rate for Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetists (CRNA) services that differ from the reimbursement rates for licensed physicians.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: comprehensive plans; data centers; nuclear
rollCalls.summary: Alters a county's comprehensive plan to include small modular reactors (SMR) and data centers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small modular reactors; zoning; co-location
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirement for a county to adopt or readopt a long-term comprehensive plan and outlines requirements for the siting and development of nuclear generating units in designated nuclear-ready communities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public utilities; plant construction; colocation
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the conditions that allow a utility to construct a new plant without filing for or receiving a certificate of environmental compatibility (certificate).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: business property; theft; penalties; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Declares the imposition of an ordinance, rule or regulation that penalizes a business for the theft of the movable property of the business to be a matter of statewide concern and preempts further regulation by a municipality or county. Allows the Attorney General (AG) or any business to bring an action regarding the prohibited regulation of the theft of movable property and entitles a business that prevails to reasonable attorney fees and costs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona's education savings plan; revisions
rollCalls.summary: Expands the definitions of qualified higher education expenses and qualified withdrawal to conform to the U.S. Internal Revenue Code for purposes of the AZ529, Arizona's Education Savings Plan (AZ529 Plan). Allows AZ529 Plan account monies to be transferred or rolled over to an Achieving a Better Life Experience account or Roth Individual Retirement Account, if certain requirements are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; records; noncompliance; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes training requirements, school district superintendent penalties and bond and override election restrictions for a school district that fails to correct a uniform system of financial records (USFR) deficiency within specified timeframes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: building renewal grants; procurement practices
rollCalls.summary: Caps the maximum amount of an individual job order for job-order-contracting for construction services at $1,000,000 for any project that receives Building Renewal Grant Fund (BRG Fund) monies and is not an emergency. Requires Division of School Facilities (Division) Staff to verify that requirements are not artificially divided or fragmented to constitute a job order that satisfies the $1,000,000 limitation and whether a projected submitted for BRG Fund monies is an emergency as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: certificate; environmental compatibility; zoning; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits counties from preventing, restricting or regulating the use of land or improvements for the construction or operation of electric generating units that have received a Certificate of Environmental Compatibility (Certificate) from the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) and allows utilities to replace existing plants or construct new plants adjacent to current sites without a new Certificate if outlined conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: revitalization districts; construction contracts
rollCalls.summary: Delineates requirements for contracts entered into by a revitalization district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: right to hunt; fish; harvest
rollCalls.summary: Declares that the citizens of Arizona have the right to lawfully hunt, fish and harvest wildlife and prohibits the Arizona Game and Fish Commission (Commission) from enacting or adopting any rule or policy that unreasonably restricts hunting, fishing and harvesting wildlife or the use of traditional means and methods.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homelessness; data; performance audit; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,250,000 from the Housing Trust Fund in FY 2027 to the Auditor General (OAG) for a special audit on programs and services for individuals experiencing homelessness.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeless services; office; board
rollCalls.summary: Creates the Office of Homeless Services, the Arizona Homeless Services Board and the Property Loss Homelessness Compensation Fund to assist in providing homeless services in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: antisemitism; public schools; prohibition; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes prohibitions on public schools, public school personnel, higher education institutions and higher education institution personnel relating to the teaching or promotion of antisemitism or anti-Semitic conduct, acts and processes (antisemitism or anti-Semitic conduct). Outlines reporting procedures, disciplinary requirements and legal remedies for violations of the prohibitions on antisemitism and anti-Semitic conduct and compliance requirements for higher education institutions. Designates this legislation as the Antisemitism in Education Act .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful exposure; minors; drag show
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of unlawful exposure to an adult oriented performance and classifies a violation as a class 4 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: artificial intelligence; state agencies; rules
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for budget units to identify opportunities for the use of artificial intelligence (AI) system solutions and reduce barriers to AI system innovation. Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to submit a report on the implementation and effectiveness of AI systems by budget units by December 1 of each year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health boards; licensure decisions; investigation
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes procedures for a health care profession regulatory board (health board) when making a licensing decision that is detrimental to a health professional's continued practice.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parents' rights; guardianship; notice; attestation
rollCalls.summary: Adds to t he rights of a parent, guardian or custodian under investigation for an allegation of abuse or neglect by the Department of Child Safety (DCS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: manslaughter; online advice; encouragement
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the manslaughter criminal classification applies to a person who is at least 18 years old and who intentionally provides advice or encouragement, through a directed communication, that a minor uses to die by suicide with the knowledge that the minor intends to die by suicide.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homebuyer assistance programs; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Outlines eligibility requirements for receiving first-time homebuyer or downpayment assistance offered by Arizona or an Arizona agency.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physicians; surgical centers; call coverage
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, classifies, as unprofessional conduct, the failure of an allopathic or osteopathic physician who performs surgeries at an outpatient surgical center to provide an updated call-coverage plan .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commerce authority; gas; prices; prioritization
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Commerce Authority (ACA) to use available resources to improve motor fuel and gasoline resilience in Arizona, study and develop recommendations relating to the outlined oil and gas topics and submit a report of the study to Legislative Leadership and the Governor, as outlined. Establishes the Fuel Resiliency Task Force (Task Force) in the ACA.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: industrial commission; wages; adjudication
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA) to investigate and adjudicate matters related to overtime wage pay violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona competes fund; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Extends the Arizona Competes Fund and grant program for four years, until July 1, 2030, and specifies that the Arizona Competes Fund is subject to legislative appropriation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: board of directors; commerce authority
rollCalls.summary: Expands the Arizona Commerce Authority's (ACA) Board of Directors (Board) to include the Chairpersons and the ranking minority members of the Senate Finance Committee and of the House of Representatives International Trade Committee .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commerce authority; board of directors
rollCalls.summary: Expands the Arizona Commerce Authority's (ACA) Board of Directors (Board) to include the Chairpersons and the raking minority party members of the Senate Finance Committee and of the House of Representatives International Trade Committee. Subjects the ACA trade offices to legislation appropriation and adds a reporting requirement for the ACA. Continues the Arizona Competes Program (Program) until July 1, 2030.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; department of veterans' services
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $500,000 in FY 2027 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Arizona Department of Veterans' Services (ADVS) to partner with an educational institution in Yavapai County to provide veterans' programs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: shooting range; closure; conditions
rollCalls.summary: Adds, to the statutorily prescribed conditions that allow the Arizona Game and Fish Commission (Commission) to close a shooting range, that the Legislature must adopt a joint resolution approving the closure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: computer science proficiency; state seal
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Superintendent of Public Instruction (SPI) to establish a State Seal of Computer Science Proficiency Program (Proficiency Program) to recognize students who graduate from high school and attain a high level of proficiency in computer science. Outlines Proficiency Program implementation and administrative requirements on the SPI, the State Board of Education (SBE) and school district governing boards (governing boards) or charter school governing bodies (governing bodies) relating to the Proficiency Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: community supervision; rehabilitation; costs
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to require as a condition of community supervision that a prisoner pay the reasonable costs associated with the prisoner's participation in a rehabilitation program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: international criminal court; government resources
rollCalls.summary: Prevents specified Arizona entities from assisting or using assets to assist the International Criminal Court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: driver license instruction permit; age
rollCalls.summary: Effective December 1, 2026, lowers the age at which a person is eligible for an instruction permit for a class D, G or M license from 15 years and 6 months to 15 years old. Increases the number of driving practice hours that a permittee must complete before applying for a class G or M license when the person is between 16 and 18 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sample ballots; mailing date
rollCalls.summary: Requires a county board of supervisors (county BOS) to mail printed mailer-type sample ballots for both primary and general elections at least 14 days before an election, rather than 11 days before an election, in counties that do not contain a United States Postal Service (USPS) Processing and Distribution Center.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: statewide assessment; testing window; revisions
rollCalls.summary: Delays the date by which a local education agency (LEA) must receive statewide assessment test scores and data to May 26. Prohibits the statewide assessment testing window for students in grades three through eight from beginning before the second week of April during the school year and removes the authority for the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to adjust the testing window for the statewide assessment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; brackish groundwater; feasibility study
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $100,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) for a required feasibility study of potential brackish groundwater desalination project sites.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gender transition; minors; prohibitions.
rollCalls.summary: Effective April 1, 2027, prohibits physicians or other health professionals from providing a gender transition procedure to a person under 18 years old and prohibits public monies, public health care facilities or public employees from being utilized for gender transition procedures.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: irrigation non-expansion areas; withdrawal; maximum
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a maximum annual groundwater withdrawal limit for irrigation use from non-exempt wells in Irrigation Non-Expansion Areas (INAs). Allows a person to substitute irrigated acres or replace non-exempt wells for irrigation uses in subsequent INAs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agricultural property; classification; inspection
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a county assessor from reclassifying or conducting an on-site inspection of agricultural property for three years after a property owner prevails in a property tax appeal, unless there is a change in use or ownership, a property split or a taxable improvement and allows a county assessor, during the three-year exemption period, to assess the applicable property tax on a previously unreported taxable improvement if the county assessor classifies the improvement as agricultural property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agricultural property; inspections; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) and each county assessor to provide advance notice of specified property inspections and provide inspection reports to property owners. Exempts specified agricultural property from on-site inspections in consecutive years, with exceptions. Allows a county assessor, during the year following the year in which an on-site inspection is conducted, to assess the applicable property tax on a previously unreported taxable improvement if the county assessor classifies the improvement as agricultural property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: distracted driving; penalties; motorcycles
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the civil penalties associated with a violation of the prohibition against using portable wireless communication and standalone electronic devices while operating a motor vehicle.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school governing bodies; meetings; prayer
rollCalls.summary: Mandates the deliberative governing body of a public school or public educational institution (deliberative governing body) allow a deliberative governing body member to provide an invocation for a meeting.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: special plate; conservative grassroots network
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a conservative grassroots network special plate and the Conservative Grassroots Network Special Plate Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mobile food vendors; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a city or town from requiring a mobile food vendor to obtain a local regulatory permit or license. Removes the specification that statewide licensing standards for a mobile food vendor do not preclude a city or town from requiring a license that includes a background check or identification of the mobile food vendor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: livestock compensation fund; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $250,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Livestock Compensation Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading
