rollCalls.title: predatory animals; definition
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of predatory animals to include bears, cougars and mountain lions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Mexican wolves; landowner permits; rules
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Game and Fish Department (AZGFD) issue a landowner a permit for the taking of Mexican wolves in specified areas. Allows AZGFD to adopt rules to establish a voluntary compensated incentive program for the trapping of Mexican wolves.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: attorney general; nuisance action; damages
rollCalls.summary: Subjects the Attorney General (AG) to liability for damages to an injured defendant in a public nuisance action or a consumer fraud action that meets outlined criteria.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public nuisance action; consent requirement
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that the Attorney General (AG) may only bring an action in superior court to abate, enjoin or prevent activity that is considered a public nuisance with the consent of the county board of supervisors (county BOS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: attorney general; nuisance action; defamation
rollCalls.summary: Designates the Attorney General as liable for defamation per se if the Attorney General (AG) brings an action relating to public nuisance to court that is found to have no reasonable basis and that meets certain criteria.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: land ownership; hostile entities; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person from selling, leasing or conveying an interest in real property to a person from or acting on behalf of designated hostile entities and prescribes mechanisms for regulation and enforcement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance; modeling organizations; predictive models
rollCalls.summary: Renames advisory organizations as model and data organizations and applies the advisory organizations statutory authorities and requirements to model and data organizations. Removes the authority of the Director of the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) to examine these organizations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; waivers; American Indians; services
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to annually apply for a federal waiver to authorize Medicaid payments for certain services provided to American Indian and Alaska Native (AI/AN) members through Indian Health Service (IHS) facilities or other facilities operated by tribes or tribal organizations under the Indian Self-Determination and Education Assistance Act (638 facilities) that were eliminated or reduced during or after September 2010.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fetal death; funeral homes
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements relating to the final disposition of human remains.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: criminal damage; trespassing; critical facilities
rollCalls.summary: Classifies interfering with or preventing the performance of a normal function of any utility infrastructure or property, or the intended course or path of any utility service, as aggravated criminal damage .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: aviation surveillance technology; fees; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the calculation, generation or collection of fees from an aircraft owner or operator based on information that is collected or broadcast by an automatic dependent surveillance-broadcast system (ADS-B system).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state trust land; subleases; approval
rollCalls.summary: Outlines processes for the sublease of State Trust lands for agricultural, commercial and homesite purposes. Requires a grazing lessee apply for and receive written permission from the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) to sublease.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial river outfitters; limited liability
rollCalls.summary: Grants commercial river outfitters immunity from certain claims if the corresponding claims are contractually waived in a liability release.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: artificial intelligence service; disclosures; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Effective October 1, 2027, prescribes requirements and prohibitions that an operator of a publicly available conversational artificial intelligence (AI) service must comply with, including requirements relating to the use of a conversational AI service by minor account holders.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: patriotic youth groups; school access.
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a public school principal (principal) to allow representatives from a recognized patriotic youth group to address students during regular school hours in the first quarter of an academic school year. Allows a principal to accept materials provided by the patriotic youth group for distribution to students and prohibits a public school from discriminating against, or denying access to, any patriotic youth group that wishes to conduct a meeting.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; elections; term limits
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes term limits for the office of school district governing board (governing board) member for school districts with a student count of at least 250.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; bonds; financial advisors
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board (governing board), before calling an election to issue school district bonds, to hire an independent municipal advisor on a contingency fee basis to assist the governing board with the election and any issuance of school district bonds, with certain exceptions. Outlines requirements and duties for an independent municipal advisor who is hired by a school district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: warranties; leased vehicles; lessee; definition
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of consumer , under the Arizona Motor Vehicle Warranties Act, to include a lessee of a motor vehicle.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: traffic violation; judge; signature; requirement
rollCalls.summary: Requires a civil traffic violation or misdemeanor criminal offense that is generated by a photo enforcement system to be signed by the mayor of the municipality in which the violation or offense occurred .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; real estate transactions; prohibitions
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $40,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) for the School Safety Program (Program). Directs ADE to prioritize distributions of the appropriated monies for Program proposals for school resource officers (SROs) or school safety officers (SSOs).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school facilities oversight board; members
rollCalls.summary: Modifies eligibility requirements for the School Facilities Oversight Board (SFOB) members who are a registered professional engineer and a registered professional architect by specifying that such members' business may not include school construction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: watercraft; insurance requirements; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Requires a watercraft owner who provides a watercraft for rent or charter in Arizona at least four times in a calendar year, a boat livery owner who provides a watercraft for hire on a waterway in Arizona and a peer-to-peer watercraft sharing program (sharing program) to maintain a liability insurance policy and prescribes coverage requirements for the policy. Classifies a watercraft owner's or boat livery owner's failure to adhere to the insurance requirements as a class 3 misdemeanor or a class 1 misdemeanor, if the watercraft is involved in an accident in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: motor fuel tax holiday
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) to collaborate with the Associate Director of the Weights and Measures Services Division of the Arizona Department of Agriculture (Associate Director) to submit a fuel formulation waiver request for Area A and Area C for a 20-day waiver period to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fuel formulations; biennial review
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) conduct a biennial review of available and potentially available fuel formulations for use under federal air quality standards.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: department of veterans' services; study
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that establishes that images and recordings that depict a deceased minor or child abuse are not subject to public records disclosure, with outlined exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: food products; labeling; cultivated cells
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes the labeling requirements for a food product that is derived from cultivated cells.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax returns; late filing; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 1, 2026, prohibits a late filing penalty from being assessed on a taxpayer if the taxpayer's income tax liability is zero.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; commingling
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR), for the purpose of determining whether sufficient groundwater, surface water or effluent of adequate quality will be continuously available to satisfy the water needs of the proposed use, to consider only the proposed source or sources of the supply dedicated to the proposed use regardless of whether the water is distributed through a water delivery system that is commingled with other sources of water supply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DWR; application; administrative completeness
rollCalls.summary: Allows the court to order a person who is indigent and experiencing homelessness to perform mandatory community restitution in lieu of paying the $20 assessment that is collected for certain violations and deposited into the Judicial Collection Enhancement Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: grandfathered right; Willcox AMA; extension
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 8, 2025, extends the time period, from no later than 15 months to no later than 27 months after the date of the designation of the Willcox Active Management Area (AMA), in which a person claiming the right to withdraw or receive and use groundwater in the Willcox AMA pursuant to a grandfathered right must apply for a certificate of grandfathered right with the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: felony murder; unborn child
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that causing the death of an unborn child in the course of, furtherance of or immediate flight from an offense is considered first degree felony murder.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: radiation therapy; rural counties
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to allow the use of a particle accelerator to treat human diseases under general supervision in counties with a population of fewer than 400,000 persons or at critical access hospitals, if specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; employment contracts; publication
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district governing board (governing board) to submit to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) a copy of the employment contract for each superintendent, assistant superintendent, associate superintendent (district superintendent) or chief financial officer (CFO) employed by the school district as outlined. Directs ADE to create a searchable online database that contains specified information from each submitted employment contract. Outlines posting and reporting requirements on ADE and each governing board.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: reclamation plans; aggregate mining; notice
rollCalls.summary: Specifies, retroactive to September 16, 2024, that the statutorily prescribed notice of proposed aggregate mining unit requirement applies only to new proposed reclamation plans for aggregate mining operations that are submitted on or after September 16, 2024, and may be satisfied by providing outlined public notice.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; long-term disability
rollCalls.summary: Allows an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member to continue receiving long term disability (LTD) benefits after 24 months of being unable to perform work duties while under the direct care of a physician and also receiving LTD benefits, regardless of whether the 24 months occur within a five-year period.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; eligibility waiver
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person to waive participation in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) if the person becomes eligible for participation after turning 65 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; certificate; model
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to review the merits of a certificate of assured water supply and issue a new written determination of action if prescribed conditions apply and using outlined models as criteria. Requires a certificate of assured water supply issued pursuant to outlined requirements to relate back as if issued in calendar year 2023 for the purposes of an application for designation of assured water supply under outlined rules adopted by ADWR.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county water augmentation authorities; bond
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a county water augmentation authority (authority) to issue revenue bonds, hold public hearings relating to the issuance of revenue bonds and enter into loan repayment agreements with the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: supply and demand; assessment; groundwater
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (Director) to include outlined data in each five-year supply and demand assessment for each groundwater basin.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: driver license examination; motorcycle awareness
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $12,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) and $36,000,000 in Medicaid Expenditure Authority in FYs 2027 through 2031 to the Department of Economic Security (DES) for reimbursement rate increases.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public service corporation; rates; intervenor
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Residential Utility Consumer Office (RUCO) to intervene in a public service corporation rate case if the impact of the public service corporation's proposed rate increase to residential customers is 100 percent or more.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: motorcycle registration requirements; safety fund
rollCalls.summary: Adds scholarships for motorcycle driver education programs as an allowable use of Motorcycle Safety Fund monies. Allows the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to renew a registration for a motorcycle only if at least one of the registered owners of the motorcycle is licensed to legally operate a motorcycle in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual material; consent; synthetic depiction
rollCalls.summary: Requires commercial entities that publish or distribute sexual material on the internet to obtain age and consent verification from individuals depicted in the material. Subjects commercial entities that do not obtain such verification to civil liability for damages.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liability; diversity; equity; inclusion laws
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person whose rights are violated to commence a civil action against a covered entity that violates a state or federal law prohibiting a diversity, equity and inclusion policy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: air ambulance services
rollCalls.summary: Defines air ambulance and conforms statutes relating to the regulation of ambulances to include air ambulances.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: video content; minors; employment; compensation
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements for content creators who include a minor in video content.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elder abuse; registry; attorney general
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Prosecuting Attorney's Advisory Council (Council) to develop a statewide training curriculum on Arizona mandatory reporting laws. Mandates that a person filing an action under Adult Protective Services must submit a report to the Attorney General (AG) within two years of submitting the initial notice. Outlines procedures for the AG when reports are not submitted.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: salvage vehicles; abandoned; insurance claim
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a salvage auction dealer to provide notice to a salvage vehicle owner or lienholder when an insurance company does not obtain the vehicle's certificate of title due to an insurance claim being denied, lack of policy coverage or lack of cooperation from the salvage vehicle owner. Deems the salvage vehicle an abandoned vehicle if the vehicle is not picked up and fees are not paid within 30 days of the required notice and assigns the salvage vehicle’s certificate of title to the salvage auction dealer in that circumstance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterinary medical examining board; continuation..
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona State Veterinary Medical Examining Board for eight years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona geological survey; analysis; division
rollCalls.summary: Transfers the Resource Analysis Division of the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) from the ASLD to the Arizona Geological Survey and requires the State Geologist to collaborate with the ASLD to fulfill the duties of the Resource Analysis Division of the Arizona Geological Survey and advise the ASLD on request.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: courts; fees; assessments
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the court from assessing fees relating to the appointment of a public defender or court appointed counsel, jury fees for criminal cases or appellant filing fees on criminal defendants.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: financial assurance; reclamation; escrow; trusts
rollCalls.summary: Adds cash deposits with a third-party escrow or trust account to the list of statutorily prescribed allowable financial assurance mechanisms for owners and operators of exploration operations, mining units and aggregate mining units who create surface disturbances.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal corporations; water supply; rates
rollCalls.summary: Restricts certain municipal corporations from charging residents who live outside the boundaries of a municipality from being charged a higher rate for water than residents living within the boundaries of the municipality.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land; commissioner-initiated sales
rollCalls.summary: Requires rules adopted by the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) relating to the sale of state lands by the ASLD Commissioner's (Commissioner's) own initiative to establish a procedure and criteria that the Commissioner must use for determining whether to initiate the sale of state lands.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; superintendents; benefits; restrictions
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements relating to career technical education district (CTED) governance, including the information that must be included in a CTED intergovernmental agreement (IGA) or written contract and the apportionment of average daily membership (ADM) for a satellite campus career technical education (CTE) course or program. Outlines requirements on a CTE board relating to the monitoring of CTED expenditures. Prohibits a school district from carrying forward more than 25 percent of any CTED monies received for CTE purposes, except as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: artificial intelligence; statewide education program
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Artificial Intelligence Program (Program) in the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to offer an Artificial Intelligence Education Course (AI Course) each summer to Arizona residents throughout the state. Outlines administrative requirements for the Program, including requirements on the Office of Economic Opportunity (OEO) to develop curriculum for the AI Course as specified. Designates this legislation as the Getting Arizona Ready for AI Act .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: artificial intelligence; privileged communications
rollCalls.summary: Establishes that a person's communication with artificial intelligence is considered to be privileged if the communication would have been privileged had it taken place with a human professional.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: coerced abortion; abortion-inducing drugs
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of coerced abortion , which a person commits by knowingly administering an abortion-inducing drug to a pregnant woman without her consent with intent to cause an abortion. Classifies a violation as a class 2 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: auditor general; state lands; audit
rollCalls.summary: Directs the Auditor General to conduct a special audit of the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) and outlines items for the special audit to examine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona space commission; strategic plan
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that modifies the Arizona Space Commission (ASC) Board of Directors (board) membership term limits and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: certified public accountants; certification; alternative.
rollCalls.summary: Makes revisions to Certified Public Accountants (CPA) statutes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; ESA administration
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,600,000 and 12 Full Time Equivalent (FTE) positions from the state General Fund (GF) in FY 2027 to the Department of Education (ADE) to administer the Arizona Empowerment Scholarship Account (ESA) program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: supplemental appropriation; ESA administration
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,000,000 and 12 Full Time Equivalent (FTE) positions from the state General Fund (GF) as a supplemental in FY 2026 to the Department of Education (ADE) to administer the Arizona Empowerment Scholarship Account (ESA) program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public monies; genetic sequencing; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the expenditure of public monies to pay for genetic sequencing procedures performed using a device produced by a company domiciled in a foreign adversary or by a company owned or substantially controlled by a company domiciled in a foreign adversary.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parenting time; expert testimony; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements for expert witness testimony and evidence that may be allowed in a parenting time proceeding where a parent is alleged to have committed domestic violence or abuse.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: leaves of absence; military training
rollCalls.summary: Expands the leave of absence from employment granted to a public officer or employee or a member of the National Guard or U.S. Armed Forces Reserves to encompass all days during which the officer, employee or member is under competent military orders for active duty or training.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual extortion; classification
rollCalls.summary: Classifies sexual extortion as a class 2 felony, rather than a class 3 felony, if the offender is at least 18 years old and knows or should have known that the victim is 15, 16 or 17 years old. Requires the sentence for sexual extortion in this circumstance to run consecutively to any other sentence imposed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance; bona fide associations; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements to qualify as a bona fide association. Specifies that a statewide chamber of commerce and statewide business league that meets specified criteria is not prohibited from operating a self-funded multiple employer welfare arrangement (MEWA). Requires, subject to available monies, the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to conduct a feasibility study on state employee and public school district employee health insurance plans in Arizona and outlines requirements for the feasibility study.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commerce authority; trade offices
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the requirement for the Arizona Commerce Authority (ACA) to establish and supervise trade offices is subject to legislative appropriation, rather than the direction of the ACA Board of Directors (ACA Board).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: utilities; high load factor customers
rollCalls.summary: Requires public power entities and public service corporations in Arizona to file semiannual reports relating to new extra high load factor customers and outlines exemptions, rulemaking and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: rural affordable housing; tax credits
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Rural Development and Housing Tax Credit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: accumulated sick leave; payments
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $4,750,000 from the Arizona Highway Patrol Fund (Fund) in FY 2026 to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) and exempts DPS from the statutory prohibition against state agencies employing legal counsel until December 31, 2026.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater withdrawal fee; Pinal AMA.
rollCalls.summary: Extends the Pinal active management areas (AMA) exemption from the groundwater withdrawal fee for water banking by four years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: timeshare salespersons; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Adds alternative pathways for a person to become certified as a veterinary technician.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: constitutional convention; faithless delegates
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a constitutional delegate, including penalties for a faithless constitutional convention delegate and prescribing an oath of office that a delegate must take before accepting appointment. Requires any approved amendment to the U.S. Constitution to be ratified by a bill and approved by the Governor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater transportation fee; website; posting
rollCalls.summary: Requires contractors with the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to reimburse noncontracting providers for laboratory services under specified conditions and prohibits contractors from imposing restrictions or taking retaliatory actions relating to noncontracting provider referrals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater transportation fee; counties; fund
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that groundwater transportation fee collections are considered general county monies and allows a county that establishes a water improvements program to designate an amount or percentage of the fees received to be used under the water improvements program only for qualified owners of residential property who reside within the groundwater basin or subbasin from which the groundwater was withdrawn and transported away.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land oversight board; establishment
rollCalls.summary: Creates the State Land Oversight Board (Board) and prescribes its duties, membership, operation and jurisdiction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacy board; civil penalties.
rollCalls.summary: Caps certain civil penalties that the Arizona State Board of Pharmacy (ASPB) may issue upon a licensee or permittee within a six-month period.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dangerous crimes against children; probation.
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the early termination or modification of a period of probation that is imposed in a conviction for a dangerous crime against children (DCAC).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: CAP water; state land; allocation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD), within 120 days of the general effective date, to initiate a public stakeholder process to adopt a procedure for allocating outlined Central Arizona Project (CAP) water that is currently allocated to the ASLD to parcels of state trust land that may be sold or leased.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: interscholastic; intramural athletics; biological sex
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily requires each athletic association that sponsors an interscholastic or intramural sport to designate each sport based on the sex of participating athletes beginning January 1, 2027. Prohibits, beginning January 1, 2027, a school or athletic association from authorizing an individual to use a provided restroom, locker room or other private space integral to athletic engagement that is not designated for the individual's sex. Designates this legislation as the Protecting Girls' Sports in Arizona Act .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting centers; precinct voting
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily prohibits, beginning July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2030, a municipality or county from increasing a tax, fee or utility rate or imposing a new tax classification or expanding the tax base.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legitimacy; Judea and Samaria; recognition
rollCalls.summary: States that the Legislature recognizes the historical, biblical and legal legitimacy of the regions of Judea and Samaria and rejects the term West Bank .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; premium payment
rollCalls.summary: Defines active employee group health and accident insurance program for the purposes of clarifying which individuals are entitled to receive a health insurance premium subsidy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tourism advisory council; representation
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the representation for the Tourism Advisory Council (Council) by adding La Paz County to an area that currently consists of Mohave and Yuma County.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; investigations; interviews; recording
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS), if federal grant funding for recording child safety interviews is enacted, to record, by audio or video, any interview conducted with a child who is the subject of an investigation and to apply for federal funding grants to support implementation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: McMullen Valley; eligible entities; groundwater
rollCalls.summary: Allows an eligible entity that owns historically irrigated acres in the McMullen Valley Groundwater Basin to withdraw groundwater from the land for transportation to a location and for prescribed purposes. Prescribes requirements relating to water improvements programs, the statutorily prescribed land division disclosure affidavit, groundwater transportation fees and county improvement districts (districts).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: TPT; exemption; textbook rental
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the gross income derived from renting required college textbooks from a bookstore from the transaction privilege tax (TPT) personal property rental classification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fines; fees; assessments; restitution; nonpayment
rollCalls.summary: Modifies procedures and requirements relating to enforcement of default payments by a defendant of certain court-ordered monetary obligations. Allows the court to enter a civil determination for nonpayment of monetary obligations and prohibits the court from issuing an arrest warrant for a defendant who fails to appear at a hearing on nonpayment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax errors; electronic communications
rollCalls.summary: Allows a tax officer to accept an electronic response to a notice of proposed property tax correction or notice of claim from a taxpayer and to provide related communications electronically, unless the communication is required to be served by certified mail.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: department of education; reporting requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to review statutory reporting requirements on public schools and ADE to identify requirements that are duplicative, expired or otherwise obsolete. Requires ADE, by December 1, 2026, to submit a report as outlined that includes a summary of the review and recommendations for legislative action to repeal or modify duplicative, expired or obsolete requirements. Repeals the outlined requirements on ADE on July 1, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: name change petition; sex offenders
rollCalls.summary: Outlines additional requirements for individuals required to register as sex offenders who apply for a change of name.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; critical infrastructure information
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that authorizes, until December 31, 2031, placement of dangerous and incompetent defendants at the Arizona State Hospital (ASH) when there are no beds available in a secure state mental health facility in Arizona. Establishes the Study Committee on Secure State Mental Health Facilities (Study Committee) to make recommendations on the long-term feasibility of secure state mental health facilities or other care models and outlines Study Committee membership, duties and authorities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appraisal management companies; definition
rollCalls.summary: Modifies, under the occupations and professions statutes, the definition of appraisal management company .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; lactation care; breastfeeding
rollCalls.summary: Requires contractors with the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), subject to approval by the U.S. Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS), to provide breastfeeding and lactation care services to members. Establishes a voluntary state certification for a lactation care provider (LCP) under the Department of Health Services (DHS) and an LCP Community Advisory Committee (Advisory Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Buffalo Soldiers Arizona territory monument
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Legislative Council to provide for the placement of a memorial dedicated to the commemoration of Buffalo Soldiers in the Wesley Bolin Plaza.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: lactation care providers; certification
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that repeals Dr. Cesar Estrada Chavez Day as a state holiday.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: forgivable financial assistance; cesspool remediation
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes counties to apply for and receive financial assistance from the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA) for the remediation, closure or replacement of cesspools that present a demonstrated risk to surface water, groundwater or public health.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mobile home parks; submetering; fees
rollCalls.summary: Revises the charges made by a mobile home park landlord for utilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physician assistants; licensure compact
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Physician Assistant Licensure Compact (Compact), allowing physician assistants (PAs) in participating states to obtain licensure in any other Compact state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; allowed purchases; waiver
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Department of Economic Security (Director) to request a waiver from the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) granting the authority to restrict the purchase of specified noneligible foods using Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; enrollment verification; presumptive eligibility
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, establishes enrollment verification requirements for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to confirm member eligibility and standards for qualified hospitals to make presumptive eligibility determinations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; TANF; public welfare; verification
rollCalls.summary: Establishes evaluation and fraud detection requirements for the Department of Economic Security (DES) to confirm eligibility for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unemployment benefits; requirements; disqualifications; determinations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements that an unemployed individual must meet to be eligible for Unemployment Insurance (UI) benefits. Requires the Department of Economic Security (DES) to cross-check the validity of UI benefit claims against prescribed data sets and allows DES to refer issues of fraud for prosecution.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hospitals; patient immigration status; reporting
rollCalls.summary: Requires hospitals that accept payment from the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to include on patient admission forms a place to indicate citizenship status and prescribes quarterly reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: budget unit; vacant positions; reporting
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to collect a list of all vacant full-time equivalent positions (FTEs) that have been vacant for at least 150 days and requires each budget unit to eliminate the vacant positions each fiscal year, with outlined exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; mandatory employment and training..
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Economic Security (DES) to require able-bodied adults under 60 years old who are receiving Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits to participate in a mandatory employment and training program, as prescribed by federal law, unless the recipient meets criteria for exemption.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; work requirement waivers; exemptions.
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Department of Economic Security (DES) from seeking, applying for, accepting or renewing any waiver of work requirement under the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) for able-bodied adults without dependents unless it is required by federal law or authorized by state law. Prohibits DES from exercising the option to provide exemptions from the SNAP work requirement unless authorized by state law.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physician assistants; licensure compact
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Physician Assistant Licensure Compact (Compact), allowing physician assistants (PAs) in participating states to obtain licensure in any other Compact state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; error rate; forensic audit
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Economic Security, by December 30, 2030, to reduce the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) payment error rate to no more than three percent. Establishes reporting requirements and procedures for corrective action by the Auditor General.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; allowed purchases; waiver
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Department of Economic Security (Director) to request a waiver from the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) granting the authority to restrict the purchase of specified noneligible foods using Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: conformity; internal revenue code; deductions
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 1, 2025, conforms Arizona tax statutes to the U.S. Internal Revenue Code (U.S. IRC) as of January 1, 2026, to reflect changes adopted by the U.S. Congress during 2025. Establishes individual income tax subtractions for tips, overtime compensation, seniors and vehicle loan interest and modifies individual income tax deductions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water conservation grant fund; disclosure
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes disclosure requirements for an eligible entity applying for a grant from the Water Conservation Grant Fund (Fund) that receives water from a multi-county water conservation district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: drive by shooting; immediate area
rollCalls.summary: Establishes that discharging a weapon from a motor vehicle includes discharging a weapon from the immediate area of the vehicle.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax exemption; disability; determination
rollCalls.summary: Adds a U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) determination letter to the items that may be used to certify a person's disability for the purposes of determining eligibility for a property tax exemption.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: venue; employee conflict; superior court
rollCalls.summary: Grants a party to a civil action pending in the superior court the right to a change of venue when a party to the action is an employee of the judicial branch or the clerk of the superior court in the county where the action is pending and specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: trafficking weapons or explosives
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person who is convicted of trafficking three or more weapons or explosives in one or multiple offenses from being eligible for suspension of sentence, probation, pardon or release on any basis until the sentence is served.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: digital goods; seller's requirements; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Outlines unlawful advertising practices for digital goods. Provides for enforcement of the digital goods advertising requirements in accordance with the Arizona Consumer Fraud Act.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fentanyl; possession; sale; amount; sentencing
rollCalls.summary: Reduces, from 200 grams to 100 grams, the amount of fentanyl that must be involved in specified offenses for enhanced criminal sentencing ranges to apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona beef council; continuation..
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Beef Council for eight years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: agency; chief medical officer; license
rollCalls.summary: Requires any person serving as a chief medical officer for a state agency to possess an active license to practice medicine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: qualified marketplace contractors; employment
rollCalls.summary: Specifies the requirements for termination of a contract between a qualified marketplace contractor and a qualified marketplace platform.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fitness program; school report cards
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona School Fitness Program (Fitness Program) in the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to recognize public schools that elect to participate in a nationally recognized physical fitness test or event.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: citizenship; identification; contributions; early voting
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally requires all voters to show valid government issued proof of identity before casting a ballot and requires all voters to be provided with the option to tabulate their ballot onsite.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school libraries; professional associations; prohibitions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public school library from using public monies to pay a professional association that promotes, supports and advocates for libraries, librarians and information services. Designates this legislation as the Library Freedom Act .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; exemption; veterans
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure effective February 12, 2026 , that exempts the primary residence, rather than the property, of a veteran with a service-connected disability whose U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) disability rating is 100 percent from the full amount of property tax and requires the primary residence, if owned jointly by an eligible veteran and their spouse, to be treated as if owned solely by the veteran.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: congressional term limits; convention
rollCalls.summary: Establishes that Arizona is calling for an Article V Convention to propose a Constitutional amendment to the United States (US) Constitution, to add term limits to Congress.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: financial surveillance fund; insurer examinations
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 1, 2026, increases the maximum annual assessment amounts that the Director of the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) may collect from a domestic insurer for financial surveillance purposes. Contains requirements for enactment and becomes effective on signature of the Governor (Proposition 108).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: board of technical registration; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies the qualifications for registration as a professional engineer, architect, land surveyor or landscape architect with the Arizona State Board of Technical Registration (AZBTR) through reciprocity or endorsement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firefighters; employment status
rollCalls.summary: Defines firefighter for the purposes of workers' compensation coverage while traveling directly to or from work as a firefighter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; July primary; curing; observers
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that moves the date of the primary election from the first Tuesday in August to the second to last Tuesday in July in any year in which a general or special election is held. Adjusts election administration timeframes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: annual probation review; prehearing; notification
rollCalls.summary: Adds prehearings for probation reviews of certain probationers to the probation hearings for which notification must be provided to specified individuals.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Colorado River litigation fund
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2027 to the Colorado River Litigation Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: noncustodial federal monies; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2028, authorizes the Legislature to appropriate noncustodial federal monies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internal revenue code; conformity; deductions
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 1, 2025, conforms Arizona tax statutes to the U.S. Internal Revenue Code (U.S. IRC) as of January 1, 2026, to reflect changes adopted by the U.S. Congress during 2025. Establishes individual income tax subtractions, modifies individual income tax deductions and increases the Dependent Tax Credit. Declares the state's election to participate in the federal tax credit for individuals who make qualified contributions to school granting organizations (SGOs) and outlines SGO certification and administration requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: city election; transaction privilege tax
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the City of Winslow to hold a special election for the purpose of levying a transaction privilege tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sheriffs; constables; service; mileage; fees
rollCalls.summary: Increases the cap, from $5 to $10, for a fee for a writ issued on behalf of a justice of the peace and modifies the calculation of a constable's mileage to begin at the office of the precinct the constable serves, rather than the office originating the civil action. Contains requirements for enactment and becomes effective on signature of the Governor (Proposition 108).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: graduation; children with disabilities
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes an Individualized Education Program (IEP) team to determine that a student may benefit from special education and services until the end of the school year in which the student turns 22 years old. Prohibits the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) from imposing a penalty or withholding monies from a school for providing special education and services to a high school student for more than four years if the IEP extends the student's graduation date beyond four years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: permanency placement; grandparent; priority
rollCalls.summary: Beginning January 1, 2026, establishes a claimant's ability to bring an action against the state for an erroneous conviction, with outlined procedures for the processing of the claim and entitlements to the claimant if the claim is granted.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: independent corrections ombudsman; auditor general
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Office of the Independent Corrections Ombudsman (Office) within the Ombudsman-Citizens Aide to monitor inmate health and safety and investigate related complaints.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal housing; preapproved design
rollCalls.summary: Requires municipalities to establish standard preapproved housing design plans or a preapproved housing design plan program, as prescribed. Modifies municipal annexation requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transitional housing; reentry programs; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a regulatory system for the licensing and operation of transitional housing facilities to provide temporary living arrangements and basic living necessities to individuals transitioning from incarceration to independent living.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; general appropriations act
rollCalls.summary: Makes session law changes relating to general appropriations necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; amusements
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to amusements necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: capital outlay; 2025-2026; appropriations
rollCalls.summary: Makes session law changes relating to capital outlay necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; commerce
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to commerce necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; criminal justice
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to criminal justice necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; environment
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to the environment necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; health care
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to health care necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; higher education
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to higher education necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; human services
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to human services necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; K-12 education
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to K-12 education necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; local government
rollCalls.summary: Makes session law changes relating to local government necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: management; state buildings; 2025-2026
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to the management of state buildings necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; revenue
rollCalls.summary: Makes session law changes relating to revenue necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; state budget implementation
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to budget implementation necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: 2025-2026; taxation; omnibus
rollCalls.summary: Extends, until June 30, 2029, the specified purposes for which a public school may use monies contributed for the purposes of the Public School Extracurricular Activity Fees Tax Credit. Increases, effective January 1, 2026, the business personal property tax exemption to $500,000. Exempts the property of a veteran with a service-connected disability whose U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) disability rating is 100 percent, or the veteran's surviving spouse, from the full amount of property tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transportation; 2025-2026
rollCalls.summary: Makes statutory and session law changes relating to transportation necessary to implement the FY 2026 state budget.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: photo enforcement systems; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily prohibits a local authority or state agency from using a photo enforcement system to identify violators of speed restrictions or traffic control devices.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: expenditure limit; school districts; 2025-2026
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes school districts in FY 2026 to spend local revenues in excess of the aggregate expenditure limitation (AEL).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: expenditure limitation; school districts; 2026-2027
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes school districts in FY 2027 to spend local revenues in excess of the aggregate expenditure limitation (AEL).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: land division; applicant submissions; review
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to review the merits of a certificate of assured water supply and issue a new written determination of action if prescribed conditions apply and using outlined models as criteria. Requires a certificate of assured water supply issued pursuant to outlined requirements to relate back as if issued in calendar year 2023 for the purposes of an application for designation of assured water supply under outlined rules adopted by ADWR.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health examiners board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Governor's Regulatory Review Council (GRRC), the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI), the Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners, the Arizona Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX), the Arizona Board of Osteopathic Examiners in Medicine and Surgery and the Arizona Board of Respiratory Care Examiners . Modifies GRRC membership and appointment requirements and outlines requirements for GRRC meetings.

rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; on-farm irrigation efficiency fund
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Dentist and Dental Hygienist Compact (Compact), permitting dentists and dental hygienists licensed in a participating state to obtain licensure in any other Compact state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: off-highway vehicles; weight
rollCalls.summary: Allows a 30-day temporary general use registration (temporary registration) to be issued to a nonresident who owns an off-highway vehicle (OHV) titled in another state and continues the Arizona OHV Study Committee (Study Committee) for two years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; obesity treatment; study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Obesity Treatment Study Committee (Study Committee) to study the cost, potential savings, effectiveness, health outcomes and value of expanding coverage under the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to include comprehensive treatment for people living with obesity. Outlines Study Committee membership, duties and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school facilities oversight board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Allows each member of a school district governing board (governing board) to access all information and records that are maintained by a school district for the purpose of carrying out the governing board's official functions and duties. Outlines requirements for an administrator, official or records custodian of a school district relating to the provision of information and records to a governing board member.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: land divisions; disclosure affidavit; recording
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements for and contents of an affidavit of disclosure (affidavit) for the sale of parcels of land in an unincorporated area.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: long-term RVs; cooling; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that allows a tenant of a recreational vehicle (RV), that is a motor home, park trailer or travel trailer, to install reasonably necessary commercial cooling methods on the tenant's RV.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: claims; prior authorization; conduct
rollCalls.summary: Effective July 1, 2026, requires a medical director, before a health care insurer may deny a claim or issue a direct denial of a prior authorization, to individually review any denial that involves medical necessity and prohibits the medical director from relying solely on recommendations derived from any other source during the prior authorization denial or claim denial review.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: marijuana; advertising; restrictions
rollCalls.summary: Establishes guidelines and restrictions for the advertising of marijuana, marijuana products and paraphernalia. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; electricity; power authority
rollCalls.summary: Requires public power entities and electric utilities to prepare a biennial wildfire mitigation plan, as prescribed, and outlines wildfire mitigation plan review and approval requirements. Prescribes liability for causing wildfires in any cause of action for negligence against a public power entity or electric utility that is related to wildfire.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement; defunding; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a city or town (municipality) from reducing the annual operating budget for a law enforcement agency by any amount below the previous year's budget. Outlines requirements for the State Treasurer to withhold state shared monies from a municipality upon notification of an operating budget reduction. Declares that the regulation of funding of a municipality's law enforcement agency is a matter of statewide concern.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: settlement agreements; report; approval
rollCalls.summary: Requires a city, town or county (local government) to submit a settlement agreement report to outlined parties for review before entering into the settlement agreement.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: advisory committee; subcommittee; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Exempts, from open meeting law, the exchange of communications among a quorum of a three-member advisory committee or subcommittee that involves a discussion or deliberation concerning a matter before the advisory committee or subcommittee.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: elevator contractors; elevator mechanics; regulation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to take a majority vote at a public meeting and publish the ACC's position online before the ACC, ACC staff or any registered lobbyist on behalf of the ACC may advocate for or against any legislation, regulation or rule. Requires the Attorney General (AG), at the request of the Legislature to investigate a violation of the requirement that the ACC publicly vote before advocating on any legislation, regulation or rule. Subjects the ACC or a commissioner to a $500 penalty for each instance of noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: parental alienation; testimony; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a court from ordering a party to pay for any type of therapy, treatment or counseling program designed to improve or maintain the parent-child or parent-parent relationship, including court-ordered behavioral intervention, in any legal decision-making or parenting time proceeding.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; assured water supply
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Cochise County Board of Supervisors (BOS), by July 2, 2026, to vote to place a question on the 2026 general election ballot for the residents of Cochise County that reside within the Willcox Groundwater Basin on whether to establish a domestic water improvement district.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: notaries; businesses; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, if an entity does not provide the option to notarize documents without charge or cost, then individuals seeking notarization may use any authorized notarial officer.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: rare disease advisory council
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Rare Disease Advisory Council (RDAC) within the Department of Health Services (DHS) to provide guidance and recommendations on the needs of individuals living with a rare disease. Outlines RDAC membership, powers and responsibilities.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: cryptocurrency kiosk; license; fraud prevention
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements and limitations for a cryptocurrency kiosk operator (operator) doing business in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: written request; property locators
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a locator to register with the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to provide recovery services to the apparent owner of unclaimed property. Establishes the Locator Registration Fund consisting of monies received from locator registration and renewal fees. Reduces the cap on the fee a locator may charge for recovering unclaimed property.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: temporary non-expansion area
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the process for the designation of a temporary non-expansion area (TNA) in any location that is not included in an active management area (AMA) or an irrigation non-expansion area (INA) by an outlined petition to the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources by at least one-half of the number of irrigation users and at least 10 percent of the registered voters residing within the boundaries of the groundwater basin or subbasin specified in the petition. Outlines groundwater rights for people within the TNA.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: aggravated assault; accomplices; classification
rollCalls.summary: Expands the criminal classification of aggravated assault .
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance complaints; resolution
rollCalls.summary: Deems a campaign finance violation complaint dismissed if the complaint is not resolved or ruled on by the filing officer within 180 days and the deadline for resolving or ruling is not extended.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; kinship care placement; requirement
rollCalls.summary: Adds extended family members to the list of persons who qualify as a kinship foster care placement and requires extended family members to be included in all investigations and proceedings related to identifying a kinship foster care placement for a child in the temporary custody of the Department of Child Safety (DCS).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: indistinguishable; visual depiction; definition.
rollCalls.summary: Modifies certain definitions relating to the sexual exploitation of children criminal classification to account for images created or modified by means of computer software, artificial intelligence or other digital editing tools.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: silver alert; criteria; notification
rollCalls.summary: Renames the silver alert as the seek and find alert, expands the alert to include missing persons with cognitive disabilities, prohibits the denial or delay of an alert and requires law enforcement agencies (LEAs) to develop and conduct training on the Seek and Find Alert Notification System (System).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: railroad grade crossing; on-track equipment
rollCalls.summary: Applies railroad crossing regulations to other on-track equipment .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; voting centers; polling places
rollCalls.summary: Requires voting centers to be established in addition to, rather than in place of, specifically designated polling places. Requires a state, county, city, town or school district office and schools within a school district (district schools) with a gymnasium to provide sufficient space for use as a polling place and requires district schools to close on an election day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unclaimed property; department of revenue
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Cochise County Board of Supervisors (BOS) or the Graham County BOS to vote to place on the 2026 general election ballot a question of whether to designate the portion of the San Simon Valley Groundwater Subbasin that is located in Cochise County or Graham County as an irrigation non-expansion area (INA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: patient rights; health care services
rollCalls.summary: Grants patients specified rights when receiving care from a healthcare professional in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: youth charity special plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a youth charity special plate and the Youth Charity Special Plate Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state agencies; payments; cryptocurrency
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, authorizes a state agency to enter into an agreement with a cryptocurrency service provider to accept cryptocurrency as a payment method for any amount due to the state agency or the state. Allows tax payments to be made in cryptocurrency if the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) enters into an agreement with a cryptocurrency service provider to accept cryptocurrency as a payment method.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state agencies; payments; cryptocurrency
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, authorizes a state agency to enter into an agreement with a cryptocurrency service provider to accept cryptocurrency as a payment method for any amount due to the state agency or the state. Allows tax payments to be made in cryptocurrency if the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) enters into an agreement with a cryptocurrency service provider to accept cryptocurrency as a payment method.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registration; temporary absence
rollCalls.summary: Removes the eligibility of certain U.S. citizens who have never resided within the United States to register to vote and cast a vote in Arizona by using the federal write-in early ballot.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting; equipment; internet; custody; violation
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes various security requirements for vote recording equipment and tabulating equipment that is certified for use in elections in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; bonds; overrides; ballots
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes required ballot language for elections related to a school district budget override continuation or a school district's authority to continue issuing and selling bonds that states the estimated average secondary property tax reduction if voters reject the override or bond proposal.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: central bank digital currency; ban
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits federally recognized central bank digital currency (CBDC) from being the subject or medium of payment of any contract, security or other similar instrument in Arizona and excludes CBDC from the definition of legal tender for the purposes of all Arizona Revised Statutes, including the Uniform Commercial Code.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early ballot drop off; identification
rollCalls.summary: Outlines identification and attestation requirements for voters and voters' agents who drop off one or more voted early ballots at a polling location, voting center or emergency voting center and classifies a knowing violation of the outlined attestation and identification requirements as a class 5 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater model; receipt; written findings
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to provide notification of receipt within five days and an outlined written response within 60 days to applicants who submit alternative groundwater models.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firearms transactions; merchant codes; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Second Amendment Financial Privacy Act (Act) which preempts a government entity from keeping a record of privately owned firearms or firearm, prohibits a merchant category code from distinguishing firearm retailers from other retailers and requires the Attorney General (AG) or county attorney to enforce the Act, as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: jail facilities excise tax; extension
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a county that levies a jail facilities excise tax by resolution adopted before the expiration of the tax (Maricopa County) to extend the tax for up to 20 years, if approved by qualified voters before January 1, 2028.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health profession regulatory boards; membership
rollCalls.summary: Restructures the statutory membership of certain health profession regulatory boards (health board). Establishes the Health Board Oversight Council (Council) and outlines its powers and duties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hospitals; patient immigration status; reporting
rollCalls.summary: Requires hospitals that accept payment from the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to include on patient admission forms a place to indicate citizenship status and prescribes quarterly reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: PSPRS; part-time employment
rollCalls.summary: Allows, beginning July 1, 2026, part-time municipal police officers, state highway patrol officers and county sheriffs and deputies who are engaged to work as patrol officers and who meet other specified requirements to participate in the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) and receive credited service for the part time service, if the employer has chosen to allow part-time employees to participate and the part-time work is for a maximum period of six years due to specified qualifying events.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fraudulent voice recordings
rollCalls.summary: Classifies, as criminal impersonation subject to a class 5 felony, using a computer generated voice recording, image or video of another person with intent to defraud other persons.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: false documents; recording; violations
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from a class 1 misdemeanor to a class 4 felony, the penalty for knowingly filing a forged or groundless, materially misstated or otherwise invalid document with the county recorder asserting a person's claim to real property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state broadband office; transfer; ADOA
rollCalls.summary: Transfers authority of the State Broadband Office (Office) from the Arizona Commerce Authority (ACA) to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS information; central registry; exceptions
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to provide all DCS and central registry information to the Board of Fingerprinting (Board) for purposes of determining central registry exceptions. Subjects any person who knowingly discloses confidential DCS or central registry information to a class 5 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subsequent AMAs; groundwater portability
rollCalls.summary: Allows an owner of an irrigation grandfathered right (IGFR), in a subsequent active management area (AMA), to use, sell, transfer or lease the IGFR and the water duty that was associated with those acres. Allows a person that receives a sold, leased or transferred associated water duty to use the associated water duty anywhere in the subsequent AMA for irrigation use and to further convey the associated water duty.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative appointments; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Removes membership requirements for certain members of outlined public bodies who are appointed by the Speaker of the House of Representatives (House) and the President of the Senate.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: broadband service district authority; formation
rollCalls.summary: Allows a group of individuals, businesses or organizations in a county with a population between 200,000 and 210,000 to form a broadband service district authority (authority) and prescribes the powers and duties of an authority.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: model city tax code; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires a municipality that proposes an ordinance to adopt or repeal a model or local option in the Model City Tax Code (MCTC) to notify all affected taxpayers before the proposed ordinance is approved or rejected, with exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: JPs; constables; signatures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a nomination petition for a candidate for justice of the peace or constable, in a county with a population of fewer than 1,000,000 persons, to receive either 300 signatures or at least one percent of the number of qualified signers in the precinct, rather than requiring the candidates to receive at least one percent of qualified signers in the precinct.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative subpoena; refusal; contempt
rollCalls.summary: Allows a legislative committee to hold a witness in contempt for neglecting to obey a legislative subpoena if an order of contempt is issued by the committee chairperson for failure to comply with the subpoena after the witness is given an opportunity for a hearing to present evidence as to why the witness is not in contempt. Requires all testimony produced pursuant to legislative proceedings to be sworn testimony under penalty of perjury.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: pronouns; biological sex; school policies
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a school district or charter school employee or independent contractor from, without parental permission, knowingly referring to a student under 18 years old by a pronoun that differs from the pronoun that aligns with the person's biological sex or a first name that is not listed in school records. Precludes a school district or charter school from requiring an employee or independent contractor to use a pronoun that differs from a person's biological sex if doing so is contrary to their convictions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; restrooms; reasonable accommodations
rollCalls.summary: Requires a public school to provide access to a single-occupancy or employee restroom or changing facility to a person who is unwilling or unable to use a multi-occupancy restroom or changing facility designated for the person's sex or multi-occupancy sleeping quarters. Grants a private cause of action, against the public school, to a person who encounters a person of the opposite sex in specified areas. Designates this legislation as the Arizona Accommodations for All Children Act (Act).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prohibited weapons; muffling device; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Removes a device that is designed, made or adapted to muffle the report of a firearm from the definition of prohibited weapon .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading
