rollCalls.title: disruption; educational institution; concealed weapon
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the governing board of any university, college or community college from prohibiting the possession of a concealed weapon by a concealed weapon permit holder, or the lawful transportation or storage of a firearm.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public resources; influencing elections; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that a resident may initiate a suit for a city's, town's, county's or school district's violation of the prohibition on the use of public resources to influence an election and requires civil penalties collected by the court to be paid to the resident.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADWR; hydrology reports
rollCalls.summary: Requires a city or town, county, state agency and the state (public entity) or an independent contractor of a public entity to comply with all federal laws, rules, regulations or orders that relate to immigration and deportation and cooperate with outlined federal immigration authorities. Outlines penalties for a public entity or independent contractor that violates prescribed federal immigration and deportation compliance requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: business; discrimination prohibition; social criteria
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a financial institution, insurer or credit reporting agency from discriminating against any person based on a political affiliation or other social credit, environmental, social or governmental score or similar values-based or impact criteria.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: China; public funds; divestment
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits publicly managed funds from holding certain investments in the People's Republic of China or in companies owned or controlled by, or domiciled within, the People's Republic of China or other specified Chinese entities. Requires publicly managed funds to immediately divest from the prohibited companies, with exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADOA; Marana prison; lease
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to lease the Marana Prison Site to the U.S. Government or a private contractor of the U.S. Government for $1 per year to house individuals held for immigration violations and outlines requirements for the agreement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: advanced air mobility infrastructure
rollCalls.summary: Requires, beginning September 1, 2026, the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to develop or upgrade a statewide aviation plan for advanced air mobility infrastructure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: election officer certification training; yearly
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that an election officer's certificate, which must be issued by the Secretary of State before June 1 or January 1 as prescribed, expires on or by December 31 in the year after the general election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: driver licenses; reciprocity; foreign military
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to waive the examination for and issue a driver license to an active duty member of the armed forces of specified foreign countries under outlined conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physical therapists; disability placards
rollCalls.summary: Allows a physical therapist to certify that a person has a physical disability on an application for a disability placard or special plate with an international symbol of access.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: defensive driving schools; fees.
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits, beginning December 31, 2028, the state, a state agency or a state agency's independent contractor from operating an unmanned aircraft that is manufactured or assembled by a company domiciled in the People's Republic of China for collecting data concerning any restricted critical infrastructure unless the unmanned aircraft is equipped with outlined software to prevent the extraction of intelligence data by a covered foreign entity.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: attorney discipline investigations; costs
rollCalls.summary: Allows an attorney who prevails in an attorney discipline matter to file a claim against the State Bar of Arizona (SBA), if the attorney has suffered damage to their reputation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: helium exploration; aquifer protection permit
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county improvement district (District) that is formed in a subsequent active management area (AMA), for the purpose of delivering water through water hauling, to exercise the power of eminent domain only for the limited purpose of acquiring or otherwise securing a site in the subsequent AMA for the construction of and legal access to a single well and a standpipe to produce water and make water available at the site for delivery through water hauling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: initiatives; existing laws; impact statement
rollCalls.summary: Requires initiative descriptions to include a list of statutes that are likely to conflict with or be impacted by the proposed measure with a brief summary of how the statutes may conflict.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; additional judges
rollCalls.summary: Directs a school district governing board (governing board) to adopt definitions for bullying, cyberbullying, harassment and intimidation as prescribed for the governing board's policy and procedures to prohibit harassing, intimidating and bullying.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water use; prohibition; landscaping
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality that is located in an initial active management area (AMA) from adopting or enforcing any requirement that establishes, directly or indirectly, outlined turf and plant installation requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowner's associations; address lights
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or planned community association (HOA) from prohibiting a lighted home address device as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cities and towns; primary elections
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that a resolution of any election contest must occur before declaring, as elected, a candidate for a new term in the office of mayor or city council who received a majority of all votes cast at the primary election , if the office is currently being served by appointment .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water technology study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Water Technology Study Committee (Study Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gender transition procedures; provider liability
rollCalls.summary: Imposes civil liability on health care professionals or physicians relating to gender transition or detransition procedures provided to minors.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: second degree murder; presumptive sentence
rollCalls.summary: Increases the presumptive prison sentence for a person who commits second degree murder, from 16 to 20 calendar years, if the person has no prior convictions of second degree murder or outlined felonies, and, from 20 to 25 calendar years, if the person has a prior conviction of second degree murder or an outlined felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: narcotic drugs; definition
rollCalls.summary: Adds various drugs to the statutory definition of narcotic drug .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: students; interscholastic activities; eligibility; costs
rollCalls.summary: Requires a public school to allow eligible private school students to try out for interscholastic activities on behalf of the public school. Prohibits a public school from charging a private school student an interscholastic activity participation fee that exceeds the student's pro rata share of program costs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fentanyl; nine grams
rollCalls.summary: Decreases, from 200 grams to 9 grams, the amount of fentanyl that must be involved in a sale to another person for specific sentencing ranges for fentanyl sales to apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: engineers; alterations; commercial space
rollCalls.summary: Adds to the prescribed practices that are exempt from the Arizona Board of Technical Registration's (AZBTR) compliance requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: motorcycle safety fund continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the deposit of $1 of each motorcycle registration fee into the Motorcycle Safety Fund (Fund), holds Fund monies in trust and immunizes Fund monies from being used for any purpose other than as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: barbering and cosmetology fund; enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Allows a political subdivision entity to procure insurance from any insurer authorized by the Director of the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) or establish a self-insurance program. Adds a political subdivision entity to the definition of public agency for the purposes of intergovernmental operations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: animal bites; owner contact information
rollCalls.summary: Requires a person responsible for a dog that bites a person in a public or private place to provide the owner's contact information to the person who suffered the dog bite.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: probation supervision; transfer
rollCalls.summary: Removes the requirement that a request to courtesy transfer a probationer's supervision to another county be made at the time of sentencing or disposition.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: authorized recipients; donated medicine; information
rollCalls.summary: Allows authorized recipients of donated medicine, the Arizona Department of Health Services (DHS), the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) and health profession regulatory boards to post on their public website where and how to donate medicine, who is eligible and where to receive donated medicine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: international medical graduates; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the additional medical licensure requirements for students graduating from an unapproved allopathic school of medicine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; school visits; identification requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires a Department of Child Safety (DCS) caseworker to present DCS identification when visiting a child at the child's school for the purpose of an interview. Requires, if a DCS caseworker denies or is unable to present identification, the school to contact the DCS office where the DCS caseworker is employed to verify the DCS caseworker's identification and employment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: literacy endorsement; curricula; special education
rollCalls.summary: Directs the State Board of Education (SBE) to require all approved educator preparation programs in mild-moderate special education to require the necessary courses to obtain the literacy endorsement. Specifies that curriculum , for the purposes of a K-3 literacy plan, includes any curriculum that is used to provide reading instruction to children with disabilities or English language learners.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health; autism; insurance coverage
rollCalls.summary: Removes the maximum insurance benefit cap on behavioral therapy for eligible persons who are 16 years old or younger and updates the definition of autism spectrum disorder.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; formal hearings
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the procedures of the Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) when investigating and adjudicating a complaint against a licensee. Specifies examination requirements for a dental hygienist to administer local anesthetics.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: life insurance; illustrations
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, prescribes requirements for life insurance policy forms and illustrations.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: minerals; land inventory; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Adds, to the criteria allowing a vehicle owner to participate in the Voluntary Vehicle Repair Program (VVRP), that the vehicle owner repair the vehicle not more than 60 days after acceptance into the VVRP. Extends the Waste Tire Fund (Fund) and Program from January 1, 2026, to January 1, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: administrative hearings; change of judge
rollCalls.summary: Grants one peremptory change of administrative law judge to the parties to a contested case or an appealable agency action and adds conflicts of interest and being a material witness in an action to the reasons for which a party may file a nonperemptory motion to disqualify an administrative law judge.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: manufactured housing; certification; compliance
rollCalls.summary: Modifies certification requirements relating to manufactured housing.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health; temporary licensure; graduates
rollCalls.summary: Provides a 90-day licensure exemption for a college graduate who is in the process of applying for an associate level license, possesses a valid fingerprint clearance card and has completed an accredited course of study in social work, counseling, marriage and family therapy or addiction counseling.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; assigned risk plan
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the factors that exclude an employer who is refused workers' compensation coverage from placement in the assigned risk plan.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: governor; attorney general; duties; immigration
rollCalls.summary: Mandates that the Governor, the Attorney General (AG) and each county, city and town must enforce, administer and cooperate with actions, orders and programs that relate to the enforcement of federal immigration laws until January 20, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: suicide prevention special plate
rollCalls.summary: Establishes special plates for 988 suicide awareness, America250, Arizona bicycling, education fundraising, the Hopi Tribe, Italian Americans, kidney disease awareness, made in Arizona, public safety personnel mental health, sororities and fraternities and a youth charities organization.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: historical water use; subsequent AMA
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to August 30, 2022, modifies the time frames, from 5 years to 10 years, prior to a designation of a subsequent active management area (AMA) or an AMA, that are used to determine the amount of groundwater a person has the right to withdraw for irrigation and non-irrigation groundwater rights.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: silent witness; records; nondisclosure; exceptions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the disclosure of any information that may be used to identify an individual who submits an anonymous tip, unless required by a constitutional, legal or ethical duty or on a motion that establishes good cause and prescribes requirements for legal proceedings and the retention of tip materials.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: birth certificates; amendments; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the conditions and procedures relating to amending a person's birth certificate and prohibits the sex designation of a person from being changed on the person's original birth certificate as a result of a sex change surgery. Prohibits a commissioner from ordering an amendment to a person's name on the person's birth certificate.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; enrollment verification; presumptive eligibility
rollCalls.summary: Establishes, beginning January 1, 2026, enrollment verification requirements for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to confirm member eligibility and standards for qualified hospitals to make presumptive eligibility determinations.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; groundwater rights; AMAs
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person that owns acres of land within a subsequent active management area (AMA) described on an irrigation grandfathered right (IGFR) that have not been retired from irrigation for a non-irrigation use, to apply to the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to add acres of land within the same groundwater basin or subbasin to the person's IGFR. Grants the owner or lessee of the additional acres the right to use groundwater to irrigate the additional acres.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: genetic sequencing; insurance; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Allows an insurer and the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to limit coverage for genetic sequencing if the company or operation is associated with a foreign adversary. Establishes prohibitions and requirements for health care institutions and research facilities relating to genetic sequencers and software used for genetic sequencing.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: identification driver licenses; Native American
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, allows a distinguishing mark to show on a nonoperating identification or driver license that identifies the licensee as an enrolled member of a Native American tribe located in Arizona, if elected by an applicant who submits satisfactory proof, as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: public monies; investment; virtual currency
rollCalls.summary: Allows the State Treasurer, the Arizona State Retirement System and the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (public funds) to invest up to 10 percent of the public monies under its control in virtual currency holdings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transportation system performance; ADOT
rollCalls.summary: Adds requirements and restrictions for the development, measurement and delivery of transportation system performance factors that include modified variables and prescribed weights.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: penalty assessment; victims' rights enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $2 to $4, the penalty assessment that is levied on fines, penalties and forfeitures that are deposited into the Victims' Rights Enforcement Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: demand calculator; rules; conservation code
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to adopt rules to update ADWR's project demand calculator every five years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child fatality; maternal mortality
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Maternal Mortality Review Program (MMR Program), consisting of members and staff of the Maternal Mortality Review Committee (Committee), to evaluate the incidence, causes and preventability of pregnancy associated deaths. Outlines Committee membership and duties of the MMR Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; teledentistry; report
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the Legislative Council to provide for the placement of a Don Bolles Memorial in the Wesley Bolin Plaza.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: digital assets strategic reserve fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Digital Assets Strategic Reserve Fund (Fund), administered by the State Treasurer, and consisting of monies appropriated by the Legislature and digital assets seized by the state. Allows the State Treasurer to loan digital assets from the Fund, if the loan does not increase financial risk to the state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parental rights; compensatory damages
rollCalls.summary: Requires compensatory damages awarded for violations of the Parents' Bill of Rights to total at least $2,500 for each violation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: lifetime injunction; undesignated offenses
rollCalls.summary: Requires a class 6 felony offense, before the offense has been designated as a felony or a misdemeanor by the court, to be treated as a felony for the purpose of issuing a lifetime injunction.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school district budgets; three years
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board (governing board) to prepare a budget for the next three fiscal years, rather than the fiscal year that immediately follows the current year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: certified teachers; braille literacy; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the methods for a teacher to demonstrate braille competency for certification in educating blind pupils and visually impaired pupils.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: budget unit; vacant positions; reporting
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to collect a list of all vacant full-time equivalent positions (FTEs) that have been vacant for at least 150 days and requires each budget unit to eliminate the vacant positions each fiscal year, with outlined exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unbuilt certificates; assured water supply
rollCalls.summary: Sets the Town of Wellton's penalty at $100 for exceeding its constitutional expenditure limitation in FY 2023.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: occupational boards; renewal extension
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a health profession regulatory board (health board) or nonhealth licensing authority (licensing authority) if the processing of renewal applications for licenses or certifications is suspended.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance reports; filing dates
rollCalls.summary: Modifies filing requirements for various campaign finance reports and adds a postprimary report to the list of reports required to be filed as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: higher education; withholding state monies
rollCalls.summary: Deems an Arizona higher education institution ineligible from receiving state monies and prohibits the State Treasurer, the Arizona Board of Regents (ABOR) and the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) from distributing state monies to a higher education institution in a fiscal year that the higher education institution offers one or more courses on diversity equity and inclusion (DEI).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: developmental disabilities; appropriations; waivers
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that appropriates $122,300,300 from the Prescription Drug Rebate Fund and $403,000,000 in Medicaid Expenditure Authority in FY 2025 to the Department of Economic Security (DES) for the developmental disabilities Medicaid program. Prescribes requirements for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) relating to DES's developmental disabilities Medicaid program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land; exchanges
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements relating to the establishment, decommissioning, location, permitting, operation and conveyance of wind farms. Outlines requirements relating to financial sureties and public hearings and notice for wind farms.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: issuance; affidavit; arrest warrant
rollCalls.summary: Requires a magistrate to issue an arrest warrant for a person if presented with an affidavit that establishes probable cause that a felony offense has been committed, and modifies requirements relating to where a person who is arrested by virtue of an arrest warrant must be brought before the court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; satellite communication system
rollCalls.summary: Grants four peremptory challenges to each party to a civil action in the superior court and outlines procedures related to use, waiver and additional granting of peremptory challenges.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: concealed weapons permits; fees
rollCalls.summary: Sets the fee that the Department of Public Safety (DPS) may charge Arizona residents for a concealed carry weapon (CCW) application at 10 percent of the fee that is charged for nonresidents.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small claims court; jurisdictional limit
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $3,500 to $5,000, the jurisdictional limit for the small claims division of the justice court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registration rolls; internet access
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county recorder SOS and other officers in charge of elections to provide electronic access to voter registration information and additional copies of an official precinct list to a person who requests the information for noncommercial purposes as outlined. Requires the data from a county voting location ballot report to be made available as a public record by the last posting of election results for that election night and allows an expanded postelection early ballot hand count to be performed at the discretion of the county board of supervisors (BOS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: political signs; homeowners' associations
rollCalls.summary: Adds a flag to the definition of a political sign for a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or planned community association (HOA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: false claims; agriculture; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Allows a municipal provider that applies for a new designation of assured water supply in the Pinal Active Management Area (AMA) that relies on a member service area agreement to elect for all parcels of member land in the municipal service area to retain a replenishment obligation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: computer-generated pictorial representations; unlawful disclosure
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, if an image depicting a person in a state of nudity or sexual activity is a realistic pictorial representation, the depicted person need not have a reasonable expectation of privacy for the nonconsensual disclosure of such image to be considered unlawful, unless the image was created or modified by the depicted person themselves.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater storage facility; withdrawals; area
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR), for the purposes of the recovery of stored water within an active management area (AMA) and if a recovery well permit applicant does not submit a separate hydrologic study to the Director, to assume that the recovery well is located within the area of impact of stored water if the recovery well location is either in land permitted to operate as a groundwater savings facility or within one mile of outlined locations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: broadband service district authority; formation
rollCalls.summary: Allows a group of individuals, businesses or organizations in a county with a population between 200,000 and 210,000 to form a broadband service district authority (authority) and prescribes the powers and duties of an authority.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADOT; report; construction projects; bidders
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a reporting requirement for when the lowest responsible bidder is not selected for a construction contract.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: government anti-identification procedures; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Allows a storer in the Phoenix Active Management Area (AMA) to recharge stormwater within a constructed underground storage facility pursuant to outlined requirements and permits and receive a replenishment credit. Allows a storer to use replenishment credits or transfer the replenishment credits to any other eligible entity and offset an equal amount of the storer's replenishment obligation within the same subbasin for any year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; safety; reporting requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Education (ADE), by December 15, to annually submit a school safety report that includes specified information reported to the U.S. Department of Education Office of Civil Rights for the Civil Rights Data Collection survey (CRDC). Requires each Arizona public school and local education agency (LEA) to post a link on its website the most recent information reported to the U.S. Department of Education for the CRDC.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: diversity; equity; inclusion; training; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state or an agency, board, commission or department of the state from requiring participation in diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI) programs or using DEI programs for hiring, training, or promotion.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cast vote record; public record
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county board of supervisors (BOS) or officer in charge of elections to transmit the cast vote record to the Secretary of State (SOS) within 48 hours after the county BOS transmits the county canvass. Prohibits the county BOS or officer in charge of elections from randomizing or altering the cast vote record.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state fire marshal; phased permitting
rollCalls.summary: Establishes phased permitting for construction projects that are reviewed and approved by the Office of the State Fire Marshal (Office). Authorizes municipalities to review and approve certain construction permits in lieu of approval from the Office.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax laws; interpretation; application; hearing
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to notify the Legislature of a proposed interpretation or application of tax law that will adversely affect taxpayers before the new interpretation or application is adopted and requires ADOR to provide testimony regarding the interpretation or application, if the Legislature holds a hearing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquor; consumption; watercraft
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements, under a government series liquor license, to operate a dock and boats as a licensed premises for the sale and consumption of spirituous liquor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: community colleges; baccalaureate degrees; reports
rollCalls.summary: Requires each community college district (CCD) that offers baccalaureate degree programs to include the projected enrollment for each baccalaureate degree program in the CCD's annual report. Requires the total number of students pursuing a baccalaureate degree and the total number of completed baccalaureate degrees to be disaggregated by baccalaureate degree program in a CCD's annual report.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ballot measures; description; legislative council
rollCalls.summary: Requires either the Legislative Council or a local official as specified, rather than the Secretary of State (SOS) and the Attorney General (AG), to prepare descriptive titles for proposed measures and constitutional amendments.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: corporation commission; non-thermal generating unit
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of plant to include a non-thermal electric generating unit and increases the nameplate rating threshold from 100 megawatts or more to 200 megawatts or more.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county detention facilities; arrestees; information
rollCalls.summary: Requires county detention facilities to provide personal identifying information and access to a person arrested for an outlined offense on the request of U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (U.S. ICE), except as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: document retention; proposals; donations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements under the Arizona Procurement Code and for the solicitation and award of grants by state governmental units.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health insurance; surprise billing; disputes
rollCalls.summary: Applies requirements related to providing notice to a health insurance enrollee regarding the enrollee's statutory right to dispute surprise out of network medical billing only to dispute resolution claims that are not subject to an independent dispute resolution (IDR) under the federal No Surprises Act (NSA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state board; allegations of misconduct
rollCalls.summary: Allows the highest ranking official of a school or school district to request information from the State Board of Education (SBE) relating to allegations of conduct that, if true, constitutes grounds for disciplinary action before the SBE investigates the allegations or determines whether to take disciplinary action.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: firearms; state preemption; civil penalty
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to assess a $5,000 civil penalty against a government official or agency head who knowingly and willfully violates state firearm preemption laws and prevents public monies from being used to defend or reimburse this unlawful conduct.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical schools; admissions; in-state students
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, requires a public university medical school (medical school) to give priority consideration in the first round of admissions interviews to applicants from Arizona who meet prescribed admissions qualifications and requirements and to offer an interview to such applicants from Arizona. Outlines admissions information that a medical school must include in promotional materials and on the medical school's website and reporting requirements for medical schools to demonstrate compliance with the prescribed requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fair jury improvement fund
rollCalls.summary: Renames the Arizona Trial and Digital Evidence Fund (Fund) the Fair Jury Improvement Fund . Terminates the Fund and the additional fee that supplies the fund on July 1, 2031, and January 1, 2031, respectively.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ROTC cadets; in-state student status
rollCalls.summary: Expands eligibility for in-state student classification by including contracted cadets participating in a Reserve Officer Training Corp (ROTC) program in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; named claimants
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates monies from various funds to named claimants in FY 2025.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquified petroleum gas containers; penalties.
rollCalls.summary: Raises the penalty for the unauthorized filling, evacuating or defacing of a liquefied petroleum gas container.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: foreign entities; land; legislative approval
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits land in Arizona from being conveyed to a foreign entity that is hostile to the United States.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical boards; complaints; time limit
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Medical Board (AMB) and the Arizona Board of Osteopathic Examiners in Medicine and Surgery (ABOE) to take final action on a complaint unrelated to protecting the public health and safety within one year of receiving the complaint.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: residential contractor assessments; recovery fund
rollCalls.summary: Reduces the maximum assessment paid by a residential contractor every two years and prescribes adjustments to the assessment amount based on the total balance of the Residential Contractors' Recovery Fund (Fund) at the end of a fiscal year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: watermark; paper ballots
rollCalls.summary: Requires fraud countermeasures for ballots to include at least 3 of the 10 outlined features.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: veterans; emergency admission; transport
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that grants a peace or police officer who is an employee of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (U.S. VA), the authority to apprehend and transport veterans to a screening or evaluation agency and apply for emergency admission evaluations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: special deposits; banks; requirements; definitions
rollCalls.summary: Adopts the Uniform Special Deposits Act (Act), which governs bank deposits made under an account agreement that designates at least one beneficiary who may receive payments from the deposit, subject to a contingency. Outlines bank requirements and responsibilities and special deposit permissible purposes and termination requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; limited property value
rollCalls.summary: Adds properties that previously qualified for a property valuation protection option or a statutory valuation and no longer qualify to the circumstances that require the county assessor to determine the property's limited property value (LPV) at a level or percentage of full cash value (FCV) that is comparable to other properties of the same or similar use or classification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sober living homes
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements of the Department of Health Services (DHS) relating to the licensing, oversight and regulation of sober living homes. Prescribes guidelines for the inspection and penalizing of sober living homes that are noncompliant with applicable state and local regulations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; partisan elections
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board candidate's political party to appear on the ballot.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: CTEDs; state universities; intergovernmental agreements
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a career technical education district (CTED) and a public university to enter into an intergovernmental agreement (IGA) to provide administrative, operational and educational services or facilities if a community college district (CCD) in the county of the CTED is not able to offer the course or program in the next school year. Applies the IGA and funding calculation requirements for a CTED that enters into an IGA with a CCD to a CTED that enters into an IGA with a public university.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public employees; merit; hiring practices
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the State of Arizona or a political subdivision of Arizona from establishing any policies or practices requiring employees to be hired based on anything other than the merit of the employee .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county board of equalization; decisions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a county board of equalization's (county board's) decision on the valuation or legal classification of a petitioner's property from exceeding the county assessor's noticed valuation and recommended classification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; obstructing governmental operations
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) from adopting rules that require or prescribe minimum housing size standards for egg-laying hens.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: underground storage tanks; reimbursement
rollCalls.summary: Requires applicants for reimbursement from the Underground Storage Tank Revolving Fund (Fund) to apply to the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) within one year after the completion of work. Requires ADEQ, by September 1, 2025, and by September 1 every year thereafter, to compile a report on the Fund preapproval process.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; nuclear emergency management fund
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that appropriates monies from the Nuclear Emergency Management Fund (Fund) to the Department of Emergency and Military Affairs (DEMA) and the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) in FY 2026 and FY 2027 to implement the state off-site nuclear emergency response plan (plan).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assessor's valuations; special districts; petitions
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies the property type and assessed valuation that is used during the process to establish fire, community park maintenance, sanitary or hospital special taxing districts.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ADWR; application; review; time frames
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a county water augmentation authority (Authority) to issue revenue bonds, hold public hearings relating to the issuance of revenue bonds and enter into loan repayment agreements with the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: victims' rights; audio recordings; appeal
rollCalls.summary: Requires a law enforcement agency to provide crime victims with a free copy of any audio recordings within a police report and allows a victim to appeal a denied public records request as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; volunteer chaplains; authorization
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a school district governing board (governing board) or charter school governing body (governing body) to allow volunteer school chaplains to provide support, services and programs to students and outlines policy requirements each governing board and governing body must adopt regarding volunteer school chaplains. Requires a school principal to ensure that each volunteer school chaplain meets outlined requirements, including the fingerprinting, affidavit form and background investigation requirements for school employment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health insurers; provider; payment; claims
rollCalls.summary: Effective April 1, 2026, modifies deadlines of the health insurance provider credentialing process and prescribes requirements for processing of claims.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unemployment benefits; requirements; disqualifications; determinations
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the factors that an unemployed individual must meet to be eligible for Unemployment Insurance (UI) benefits. Requires the Department of Economic Security (DES) to cross-check the validity of UI benefit claims against prescribed data sets.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: newborn screening program
rollCalls.summary: Adds an exemption to the requirement that new congenital disorders be added to the Arizona newborn screening panel within two years of being added to the federal Recommended Uniform Screening Panel (RUSP) if laboratory testing is required but there is not yet a commercially available test approved or authorized by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: charter schools; access; decision-making authority
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a charter representative, charter school governing body member and officer, director, member and partner of a charter holder, as allowed by the charter holder, to have access to the charter school's student records and campuses and authority to make final decisions regarding learning and safety for the charter school's students and campus.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial motor vehicles; civil penalties
rollCalls.summary: Allows the driver of a large truck to deviate from the lane to the extent necessary to make a right or left turn, lowers penalties prescribed for outlined commercial vehicle violations from misdemeanors to civil penalties, standardizes statutory definitions for commercial vehicles and vehicle weights and reconciles related requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public records; notification; commercial purpose
rollCalls.summary: Requires a person submitting a public records request to affirm that the public record is not for a commercial purpose, or if the request is for a commercial purpose, requires the person to provide a statement that explains the intended use pursuant to statutory requirements for using the public records for a commercial purpose.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: epinephrine delivery systems
rollCalls.summary: Replaces statutory references to the term epinephrine auto-injector with the term epinephrine delivery system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: personal property exemptions; vehicles
rollCalls.summary: Exempts a person's value in a homestead from bankruptcy proceedings, up to the amount of the homestead exemption plus any value increase during pendency of the case. Adds, to the property types that qualify for the $400,000 homestead exemption, park model trailers, motor homes, travel trailers, fifth wheel trailers, houseboats, manufactured homes and other forms of shelter in which a person resides, plus the land on which the shelter is located.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual abuse; dangerous crimes; children
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of a dangerous crime against children (DCAC).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: licensed secure facility; incompetent defendants
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits patients found dangerous and incompetent to stand trial and who are court ordered to involuntary treatment from being treated at a secure behavioral health residential facility (SBHRF) that treats patients who are civilly committed to treatment at the SBHRF.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: student athletes; employment status; restrictions
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that outlines prohibitions and requirements on regulators, student athletes and postsecondary education institutions relating to the use of a student athlete's own name, image and likeness (NIL). Prescribes causes of action that may be brought in a court of competent jurisdiction for outlined violations relating to student athlete compensation. Allows a public university or an organization that has qualified for exemption from the taxation of income (nonprofit organization) that assists student athletes to earn compensation from NIL usage to conduct a raffle as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; overexpenditures; ADE; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires, if the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) determines without prior notification from a county school superintendent that a school district's expenditures exceed the school district's general budget limit or unrestricted capital budget limit, ADE to notify the county school superintendent and take any required actions prescribed by statute. Allows a county school superintendent to review the operations and finances of each school district within the county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school policies; internet; wireless devices
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district governing board (governing board) and charter school governing body (governing body) to prescribe and enforce policies and procedures that govern student access to internet, restrict student access to social media platforms and limit student use of wireless communication devices during the school day as outlined, unless the school district or charter school has existing policies and procedures that meet the prescribed requirements on the effective date.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: hunting; fishing; license; deferred prosecution
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Game and Fish Commission (Commission), on entering a deferred prosecution agreement and after a public hearing, to revoke or suspend a license issued to any person and deny the person the right to secure another license to take or possess wildlife for a period of up to five years for statutorily outlined violations and the unlawful taking or possession of wildlife.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: critical telecommunications infrastructure; construction requirements
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, establishes the Secure Telecommunications Act of 2025 which prohibits, and requires the removal of, any critical telecommunications infrastructure that uses equipment manufactured by a foreign adversary and prescribes reporting requirements for telecommunications providers and penalties for noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: postconviction relief proceedings; hourly rate
rollCalls.summary: Allows court appointed counsel of a capital defendant for state postconviction relief proceedings to receive compensation exceeding $100 per hour if the higher compensation rate has been approved by the county board of supervisors (BOS) and does not exceed $200 per hour.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public entity liability; sexual offenses
rollCalls.summary: Until January 1, 2028, subjects a public entity to liability for losses that arise out of an act or omission by a public employee that is determined to be a felony sexual offense if the victim is a minor or a child with a disability and one or more outlined conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: immigration laws; local enforcement
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Immigration, Cooperation and Enforcement Act (Arizona ICE Act) and prescribes requirements for state and local cooperation with federal immigration authorities and the enforcement of federal immigration laws that include facilitating immigration detainer requests, providing temporary housing for detainees and procedures for noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health facilities; accreditation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes patient intake form requirements for behavioral health outpatient treatment centers that are service providers for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) or a regional behavioral health authority. Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to provide a priority matrix for complaints filed against health care institutions on its public website and to implement an annual training program for licensing surveyors, supervisors and managers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement officers; probation; termination
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the permissive authority of an employer to terminate promoted or transferred law enforcement officers and police recruits under specified conditions and asseverates that an employer may terminate an officer at any time with just cause.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: common expense liens; foreclosure; amount
rollCalls.summary: Increases the amount over which an owner in a planned community association (HOA) must be delinquent to $10,000 and the period of delinquency to 18 months for an HOA to foreclose a common expense lien.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homestead exemption; equity increase
rollCalls.summary: Requires certain municipalities to allow hotels and multifamily residential housing as an ancillary use in a district zoned for light industrial use without requiring an application that will require a public hearing if the ancillary use is located within an international headquarters campus and developed in accordance with prescribed standards.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; disability; definitions
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements for the Industrial Commission of Arizona (ICA) to set a physician's schedule of fees for employee injuries under workers' compensation. Increases the monthly dependent allowance provided to an employee in addition to compensation for a temporary total disability.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: congregate care; dependent children; placement
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to establish a minimum number of licensed foster homes sufficient to place a child in a licensed foster home that best meets the needs of the child. Outlines reporting requirements and procedures that DCS must follow within 30 days of placing a child in a congregate care setting. Prohibits licensed behavioral health facilities from denying placement of a foster child when outlined conditions apply. Makes modifications to the Foster Youth Permanency Pilot Project Team.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquor sampling; reporting; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of impersonating a veteran , which a person commits by knowingly misrepresenting themselves to be a veteran and engaging in specified acts with intent to obtain money, property or any other tangible benefit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; counties; fee increases; vote
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the common council of a municipality or the board of supervisors of a county from increasing an assessment, tax or fee without a two-thirds vote of the governing body. Declares the regulation of increases in municipal or county assessments, taxes and fees to be a matter of statewide concern and preempts further regulation by a municipality or county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: GPLET; notice; abatement period
rollCalls.summary: Limits the revenues that may be abated during the government property lease excise tax (GPLET) abatement period by prohibiting GPLET revenue designated for school districts from being abated. Outlines posting requirements for GPLET leases, development agreements and notices.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; TANF; public welfare; verification
rollCalls.summary: Establishes evaluation requirements for the Department of Economic Security (DES) to confirm eligibility for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public utilities; electric grid improvements
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC), during the integrated resource planning process, to require a public service corporation to ensure that any changes to maintain or improve an electric power grid are capable of producing enough electricity to provide safe, adequate and reliable service throughout the year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: grid security; cybersecurity; reviews; commission
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to conduct a grid security review at least every two years or as a part of the ACC's integrated resource planning process or biennial transmission assessment and make outlined assessments and evaluations when conducting the review.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: loan agreements; escrow
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes exceptions to an escrow agent's authorization to only use monies in an escrow account to make a onetime payment or multiple payments pursuant to a loan agreement.
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: justices of the peace; online signature
rollCalls.summary: Adds justice of the peace and constable to the list of offices for which the Secretary of State (SOS) must provide the means for qualified electors to electronically sign nomination petitions by using the online signature collection system (E-Qual).
rollCalls.question: Final Reading

rollCalls.title: police reports; victims; prosecuting agency
rollCalls.summary: Broadens the responsibility of providing outlined information to crime victims to include the charging prosecutorial agency.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: employment practices; wage claims
rollCalls.summary: Increases, from $5,000 to $12,000, the cap under which an employee may file an unpaid wages claim against an employer with the Labor Department of the Industrial Commission of Arizona (Labor Department).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: newly elected constables; training
rollCalls.summary: Allows an elected or appointed constable to request training from the Constable Ethics Standards and Training Board (CESTB) as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internal investigations; notice; confidentiality
rollCalls.summary: Requires an employer to provide relevant materials to a law enforcement officer at least 24-hours before an interview for an administrative investigation, except as specified.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax deed land sales; procedures
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the procedures for a county board of supervisors (county BOS) to sell tax deeded real property that is held by the state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: residential utilities; consumer office; definition
rollCalls.summary: Defines represents the interests of as advocating for the safest and most reliable utility service achievable at the lowest retail rate possible.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; oral preventive assistants
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a pathway for dental assistants to practice as oral preventative assistants (OPA) upon completion of a training course approved by the Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) and outlines OPA scope of practice.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax corrections act of 2025
rollCalls.summary: Corrects errors and obsolete language, addresses blending problems and provides clarifying changes to tax statutes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowner's associations; meetings; recordings
rollCalls.summary: Requires the board of directors of a condominium unit owners' association (COA) or planned community association (HOA) to keep a copy of a recorded meeting for at least six months.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax exemptions; inflation adjustment
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the method used to annually increase the property assessment limit under which a person qualifies for certain statutory property tax exemptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: write-in candidates; nomination paper filing
rollCalls.summary: Requires a write-in candidate to file a nomination paper no later than 5:00 p.m. on the 60th, rather than 40th, day before an election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: implements of husbandry; autonomous; automated
rollCalls.summary: Expands the definition of an implement of husbandry to add an implement or vehicle that is an autonomous vehicle or uses an autonomous driving system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: evaluation agencies; hearings; witnesses
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies requirements related to certain witness testimony during a hearing for court ordered treatment and limits specified witness testimony to observed facts, not including expert opinion or conclusions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: behavior analysts; regulatory board
rollCalls.summary: Effective July 1, 2026, delegates to the Committee on Behavior Analysts the Arizona Board of Psychologist Examiners (ABPE) authority to license and regulate behavior analysts.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: religious institutions; development; allowed use
rollCalls.summary: Allows eligible sites to be designated as an allowed use development subject to specified requirements and restrictions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire insurance; wildfire risk modeling
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Standard Fire Policy (Policy) to use wildfire risk modeling for specified cities. Instructs an insurer to use a rating plan that takes into account a city or town (municipality) level mitigation designation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: employment; prohibitions; corporation commission
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public service corporation or public power entity that is regulated by the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) from employing or entering into an independent contractor agreement with an individual who served as a commissioner in the preceding two years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; fire incident management grants..
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) for a fire incident management grant program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pledge of allegiance; parental notification
rollCalls.summary: Adds, to the course of study and competency requirements for the promotion of students from the 8th grade, a requirement that each student complete at least three social studies course credits in the 6th-8th grades, including one civics education course credit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: manufacturer plates; proof of contract
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person to use an unladen truck or passenger vehicle that is owned by a manufacturer (manufacturer vehicle) for personal transportation, if other evidence of a contract and designation is present in the vehicle.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: townsites; trustees; board of supervisors.
rollCalls.summary: Designates the trustee of a townsite as the county board of supervisors (county BOS) of the county in which the townsite is located, rather than the judge of the superior court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: counties; board; administrative review; approval
rollCalls.summary: Expands the administrative review and approval of certain planning and development documentation by a county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: west valley charity specialty plates
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a west valley charity special plate and the West Valley Charity Special Plate Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: department of corrections; reporting; website
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Director of the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to post statutorily required information on the ADCRR website as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: conservation easements; valuation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) or a county assessor, when determining the full cash value (FCV) of a conservation easement, to use and apply standard appraisal practices and techniques unless a statutory formula takes precedence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: security guards; private investigators; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Extends the validity, from two years to four years, for private investigator and security guard agency licenses and related registration certificates and removes the 90-day limit on renewing licenses and certificates after expiration.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowners' associations; budget ratification; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Establishes certain procedures and requirements for a condominium association or homeowners association relating to the approval of an annual operating budget and additional unanticipated expenses.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state contracts; foreign adversary; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a company domiciled in the People's Republic of China from bidding on, submitting a proposal for or entering into a contract with a state agency for goods or services. Requires each company that submits a bid or proposal for a state contract for goods or services to certify that the company is not domiciled in the People's Republic of China. Outlines penalties for a company that submits a false certification letter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: recall elections; procedures; timeline
rollCalls.summary: Modifies prescribed statutory timeframes for recall elections, including timeframes related to petition signatures, nomination petitions and the date on which a recall election must be held. Deems invalid any nomination petition signatures that are collected before a candidate's statement of interest is filed and before the recall application is filed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacy benefits; prescribing; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) from limiting or excluding coverage of a prescription drug for any covered individual who is on a specific prescription drug if outlined conditions are met. Prescribes formulary change notification requirements and establishes a formulary prescription drug exception process.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical marijuana dispensaries; location
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a nonprofit medical marijuana dispensary or cultivation site from being within 500 feet of a child care facility or facility that provides preschool programs. Prohibits a locality from enacting any ordinance or rule that allows a marijuana establishment to be located within 500 feet of a public school, private school, child care facility or facility that provides preschool programs. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mandatory reporting; school employees; investigations
rollCalls.summary: Adds school district governing board (governing board) and charter school governing body (governing body) members to the list of individuals subject to the duty to report abuse, physical injury, neglect and denial or deprivation of medical care or nourishment of minors (abuse of minors). Expands reporting and investigation requirements relating to the duty to report immoral or unprofessional conduct.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; naturopathic physicians
rollCalls.summary: Includes naturopathic physicians in the definition of physicians that can provide covered services for members through the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS). Conditions the enactment of this legislation on October 1, 2028, upon approval by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire insurance; wildfire risk modeling
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Standard Fire Policy (Policy) to use wildfire risk modeling for specified cities. Instructs an insurer to use a rating plan that takes into account a city or town (municipality) level mitigation designation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: harassment; intent; defense
rollCalls.summary: Narrows the definition of harassment to acting with the intent to harass another person ; and adds a defense to prosecution if the act was criticism of public officials.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: employment; prohibitions; corporation commission
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public service corporation or public power entity that is regulated by the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) from employing or entering into an independent contractor agreement with an individual who served as a commissioner in the preceding two years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: grade levels; 9/11 instruction
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that limits the requirement to provide age-appropriate instruction on 9/11 Education Day to students in grades 7 through 12.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; certificate; model
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that requires the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to review the merits of an application for a certificate of assured water supply (Certificate) in the Phoenix active management area (AMA) and issue a new written determination of action within 15 days if certain criteria are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: power; public utilities; UCC; securities
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a process for a public power entity to initiate a securitization transaction by providing public notice of the public power entity's intent to adopt a financial resolution or for an applicant to request permission to initiate a securitization transaction from the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) by submitting an application for a financing order.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public meetings; records; requirements; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Modifies requirements relating to open meeting law and public records requests by requiring the minutes or recording of a public meeting to be available online for public inspection, within three working days after the meeting and remain available online indefinitely. Requires the Attorney General (AG) to respond to a violation of open meeting law within with 120 days. Requires electronic copies of public records to be provided on request and charges for the public record to be provided in the least expensive manner possible with a preference for providing electronic copies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Colorado River; cause of decline
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislatures recognition of the importance of the eradication of salt cedars and managing the forest to substantially increase the available water in the Colorado River.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dentists; dental hygienists; compact
rollCalls.summary: 1. Declares the purpose of the Compact is to facilitate the interstate practice of dentistry and dental hygiene and improve public access to dentistry and dental hygiene services by providing dentists and dental hygienists who are licensed in a participating state with the ability to practice in other participating states in which they are not licensed. (Sec. 1) 2.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small land subdivision; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Allows the county board of supervisors (county BOS) of each county to adopt ordinances and regulations that allow small land subdivisions of 6 to 10 lots or parcels for parcels that are 2 acres or more in size and not subject to an assured water supply requirement or a mandatory adequate water supply requirement. Requires an applicant for small land subdivisions to submit a small land subdivision report and notice. Prescribes disclosure requirements for small land subdivisions and civil penalties for violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: advanced mathematics courses; student enrollment
rollCalls.summary: Requires a public school to enroll a 6th-8th grade student in an available advanced math course if the student meets prescribed criteria. Details reporting requirements for public schools and the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) relating to the enrollment of students in advanced math courses and student performance in math courses, assessments and exams.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cybersecurity; data encryption; pilot program
rollCalls.summary: Allows the National Guard of Arizona's cyberattack prevention, response and support activities to include an assessment that performs testing on the state's technology systems to determine vulnerabilities in cybersecurity. Outlines a multi-year plan to review the state's current cybersecurity technologies and develop statewide plans to implement new cybersecurity technology.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: excessive speed; speed inhibiting device
rollCalls.summary: Allows courts to mandate the installation of speed inhibiting devices on vehicles as an alternative to license suspension or revocation for certain traffic offenses, outlining specific durations, compliance requirements and penalties for violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: constitutional amendments; sixty percent vote
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally requires proposed amendments to the Arizona Constitution to be approved by 60 percent of the vote .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative privilege; traffic violations
rollCalls.summary: Excludes traffic violations from legislature immunity in the Arizona Constitution.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: harassment; intent; defense
rollCalls.summary: Narrows the definition of harassment to acting with the intent to harass another person ; and adds a defense to prosecution if the act was criticism of public officials.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sales of securities; definition
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of offer to sell or offer for sale in the context of the sale of securities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; groundwater recharge facilities; maintenance
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $250,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the State Natural Resource Conservation Board (Board) to clean and restore artificial groundwater recharge facilities that are located in a subsequent active management area (AMA) and provide flood control benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: minerals; land inventory; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Adds, to the criteria allowing a vehicle owner to participate in the Voluntary Vehicle Repair Program (VVRP), that the vehicle owner repair the vehicle not more than 60 days after acceptance into the VVRP. Extends the Waste Tire Fund (Fund) and Program from January 1, 2026, to January 1, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; petroleum product storage
rollCalls.summary: Clarifies the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ)'s authority for regulating air quality through the permitting of open burning. Extends the Waste Tire Fund and Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; naturopathic physicians
rollCalls.summary: Includes naturopathic physicians in the definition of physicians that can provide covered services for members through the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS). Conditions the enactment of this legislation on October 1, 2028, upon approval by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; commingling
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR), for the purpose of determining whether sufficient groundwater, surface water or effluent of adequate quality will be continuously available to satisfy the water need of the proposed use, to consider only the proposed source or sources of the supply dedicated to the proposed use regardless of whether the water is distributed through a water delivery system that is commingled with other sources of water supply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: silent witness; records; nondisclosure; exceptions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the disclosure of any information that may be used to identify an individual who submits an anonymous tip, unless required by a constitutional, legal or ethical duty or on a motion that establishes good cause and prescribes requirements for legal proceedings and the retention of tip materials.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: drug-free homeless zones
rollCalls.summary: Establishes drug-free homeless service zones and outlines drug-free homeless zone violations, penalties, fines and requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: GRRC; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Governor's Regulatory Review Council (GRRC) for two years. Prescribes requirements for GRRC regulatory rule review and approval including prohibiting GRRC from approving a rule during a study session. Modifies GRRC membership and outlines requirements for the Chairperson of GRRC.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater replenishment districts; annual dues
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the calculation for the Central Arizona Groundwater Replenishment District (CAGRD) when determining the amount of revenues to be raised through annual membership dues.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: critical Infrastructure; foreign adversary; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Critical Infrastructure Protection Act which prohibits, and requires the removal and replacement of, critical infrastructure software and communications equipment produced by the People's Republic of China, preempts contracts and agreements that would allow access or control of critical infrastructure in Arizona and outlines exceptions and registration, reporting and publishing requirements relating to prohibited technologies and equipment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: identification driver licenses; Native American
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, allows a distinguishing mark to show on a nonoperating identification or driver license that identifies the licensee as an enrolled member of a Native American tribe located in Arizona, if elected by an applicant who submits satisfactory proof, as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; school district boards
rollCalls.summary: Establishes two biennial training requirements for school district governing board (governing board) members. Makes a governing board member ineligible for nomination, election or appointment to a governing board if they fail to complete the required biennial trainings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: accessory dwelling units; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires counties to adopt regulations that allow accessory dwelling units (ADUs) on any lot or parcel where a single-family dwelling is allowed. Outlines development standards for the ADUs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: merchant; fees; calculation; transactions; penalty
rollCalls.summary: Provides prohibitions relating to interchange fees.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ticket sales; resellers; website requirements
rollCalls.summary: Provides requirements for the delivery of an electronic ticket.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: excessive speed; speed inhibiting device
