rollCalls.summary: Allows courts to mandate the installation of speed inhibiting devices on vehicles as an alternative to license suspension or revocation for certain traffic offenses, outlining specific durations, compliance requirements and penalties for violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: governor; question time
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Governor, beginning January 4, 2027, to appear before the Legislature and answer questions from outlined members once every month during the Legislative Session.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public retirement systems; administration
rollCalls.summary: Modifies administration of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) and other PSPRS-managed retirement plans relating to reemployment restrictions, authorized investments and supplemental defined contribution plan and disability program participation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; records; noncompliance; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes training requirements, civil penalties and bond and override election restrictions for a school district that fails to correct a uniform system of financial records (USFR) deficiency within specified timeframes. Transfers oversight and administrative requirements relating to the School Financial Transparency Portal (Portal) from the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) and establishes the Portal Fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: wind farms; construction; policies; procedures
rollCalls.summary: Establishes requirements to approve, permit, construct and operate a wind farm. Creates the Wind Farm Health Impacts Study committee and prescribes duties.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: shared parenting time; presumption; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Changes the factors a court must consider when deciding a parenting time case and details instructions to the court when deciding specified proceedings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; workers' compensation; investigation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Blockchain Budget Initiative Pilot Program (Pilot Program) within the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to assess the feasibility and cost-effectiveness of using a blockchain platform to record and publish budget data from selected agencies. Appropriates $1,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to ADOA for the Pilot Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire protection systems; inspections.
rollCalls.summary: Instructs inspections of fire protection systems in a city, town or county to be performed in accordance with the standards established by a nationally recognized standards developing organization.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: produce incentive program; annual appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,000,000 in FY 2026 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Department of Economic Security (DES) to implement the Produce Incentive Program (Program).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: attorney general; election certification; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, prohibits the Attorney General (AG) from prosecuting, bringing criminal charges against or filing a civil action against a member of a county board of supervisors (BOS) based on the member's vote against the certification of an election canvass, when outlined conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; law enforcement; records management.
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates a total of $4,585,575 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to distribute to 39 law enforcement entities to expand participation in the Law Enforcement Data Sharing Pilot Program (Pilot Program).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; fire incident management grants..
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $2,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) for a fire incident management grant program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; agriculture; brand inspectors
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $957,175 and five full-time equivalent (FTE) positions from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) for three livestock inspectors, one veterinary assistant and one veterinary technician.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; local border support
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $50,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) for local border support that includes grants to cities, towns and counties and funding local law enforcement officer positions as prescribed.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: academic standards; social studies; geography
rollCalls.summary: Expands the high school social studies academic standards to include geography and instruction on the Gulf of America.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electric utility customers; carbon reduction
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Corporation Commission (Commission) to allow retail electric customers to opt out of service from one electric service provider and receive service from another electric service provider, based on certain criteria.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire insurance; policy cancellation; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Restricts an insurance producer from cancelling or refusing to renew a fire insurance policy upon the Governor declaring a state of emergency after a natural disaster or wildfire.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Yuma agriculture; water rights; supporting
rollCalls.summary: States that it is the intent of the Legislature to protect Yuma agriculture and Arizona's rights to Colorado River water.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: initiatives; referendums; signature requirement; counties
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally requires initiatives, constitutional amendments and referendums to be approved by a sufficient percentage of qualified electors from each county, rather than a sufficient percentage of qualified electors from the state, in order to be placed on the ballot.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public libraries; annual report; date
rollCalls.summary: Changes the deadline for when the board of trustees of a municipal public library must make their annual report to the governing body of its city or town.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: made in Arizona special plates
rollCalls.summary: Requires a nonresident owner of a watercraft to register and number the watercraft that the owner intends to rent to a third party and maintain and provide proof of insurance for the watercraft.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: suicide prevention special plate
rollCalls.summary: Establishes special plates for 988 suicide awareness, America250, Arizona bicycling, education fundraising, the Hopi Tribe, Italian Americans, kidney disease awareness, made in Arizona, public safety personnel mental health, sororities and fraternities and a youth charities organization.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: right to jury; domestic relations
rollCalls.summary: Permits the demand of a jury trial in any dissolution of marriage, determination of legal decision-making or parental time proceeding.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: professional registration; reciprocity; endorsement
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the qualifications for registration with the Arizona Board of Technical Registration (AZBTR) as a professional engineer, architect, land surveyor or landscape architect in Arizona through reciprocity or endorsement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Woolford Road extension
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $6,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to distribute to the City of Show Low for the Woolford Road extension project .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: settlement agreements; report; approval
rollCalls.summary: Requires a city, town or county (local government) to submit a settlement agreement report to outlined parties for review before entering into the settlement agreement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Interstate 11; environmental; engineering; study
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Pinal County Transportation Needs Study Committee (Study Committee) and appropriates $500,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Study Committee to collaborate with an institution of higher learning.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: domestic relations; temporary orders; hearings
rollCalls.summary: Outlines when a court must reevaluate a temporary order and the requirements for the proceedings when reevaluating a temporary order.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parental alienation; testimony; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a court from ordering a party to pay for any type of therapy, treatment or counseling program designed to improve or maintain the parent-child or parent-parent relationship, including court-ordered behavioral intervention, in any legal decision-making or parenting time proceeding.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire districts; homeowner's policies; DIFI
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Wildfire Prevention Authority (Authority) to identify and make grants to cities, towns, counties, fire districts and nongovernmental organizations that are located in areas of Arizona identified as being at a greater fire risk, impacted by elevated wildfire risks or experiencing insurance policy nonrenewals or premium increases due to wildfire risk. Establishes the Authority Fund (Fund), consisting of any private and public monies received by the Authority, to pay the administrative expenses of the Authority and to make grant awards for the prescribed purposes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; unordered merchandise
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the FY 2024 $7,000,000 appropriation from the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) Subaccount in the Automation Projects Fund (APF) for the Business One Stop from lapsing until July 1, 2026.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; unclaimed property; interest
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to order a person convicted of an offense for which forfeiture applies to forfeit any digital asset that is owned by the convicted person and used in, acquired through or traceable to the offense. Prescribes procedures for a government agency to sell seized digital assets and outlines the allocation of monies acquired from the sale. Establishes the Bitcoin and Digital Assets Reserve Fund (Fund), administered by the State Treasurer, to store, manage and allocate digital assets securely.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: murder; law enforcement officer; punishment
rollCalls.summary: States that first degree murder in which a person causes the death of a law enforcement officer who is in the line of duty is punishable by death or natural life, only if the offender is at least 18 years old.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cryptocurrency kiosk; license; fraud prevention
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements and limitations for a cryptocurrency kiosk operator (operator) doing business in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parenting time; neutral exchange location
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to order that the custody of minor child is exchanged at a safe exchange location and a sheriff's office and city or town police department to designate two or more parking spots as a neutral safe exchange location and prescribes requirements for designated locations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; hearings; complete disclosure requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires a petition to terminate parental rights or to determine dependency of a child, to include a notarized affidavit stating that there has been full disclosure and an exchange of all information in the custody of the Department of Child Safety (DCS) and evidence relating to the matter. Outlines affidavit requirements and modifies the procedures the court must follow when finding the allegations in a dependency petition are true.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dogs; hunting; rules; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Allows the use of dogs for hunting wildlife.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; State Route 347; widening
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $12,300,000 in FY 2026 and $29,100,000 in FY 2027 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) for the right of way acquisition, utility relocation and natural resource recovery to construct an overpass at Riggs Road and State Route 347.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacies; emergency authority
rollCalls.summary: Requires the rules adopted by the Arizona State Board of Pharmacy (Board) relating to the emergency provision of pharmaceutical care and drug device delivery to allow pharmacies owned by a health system to compound and repackage prescription drugs on a nonpatient-specific basis during a declared natural disaster or terrorist attack.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: abortion-inducing drugs; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements for the administration of abortion-inducing drugs and creates a civil right of action for intentional or knowing violations of these requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cancer insurance; public safety; retirees
rollCalls.summary: Allows, effective January 1, 2026, a person who did not receive covered Cancer Insurance Program (CIP) benefits to elect to continue CIP coverage after retirement by paying the CIP premium. Prescribes requirements for the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) Board of Trustees when determining the cost of the CIP premium for persons who elected to continue coverage. Extends, permanently, the requirement for the state and political subdivisions to offer a supplement benefit plan for public safety employees who have a duty-related injury.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: financially vulnerable adult; financial exploitation
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a financial institution to communicate with certain persons that a financially vulnerable adult is believed to be a victim or target of exploitation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health; intensive treatment orders
rollCalls.summary: Allows the court to enter an order for intensive treatment services for which there is an identified funding source, if the court finds by clear and convincing evidence that the patient is seriously mentally ill and chronically resistant to treatment, as prescribed. Outlines requirements and procedures related to orders for intensive treatment and intensive treatment plans.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county water authority; post-2024 authority
rollCalls.summary: Allows for a county water authority to be formed in La Paz County and outlines the process for the establishment of a county water authority in La Paz County.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fingerprinting; personnel; committed youth; contact.
rollCalls.summary: Expands mandatory fingerprinting, criminal history records checks and disclosure of outlined criminal offenses required for direct contact with committed youth under the jurisdiction of the Arizona Department of Juvenile Corrections (ADJC) to include volunteers and visitors, immediately terminates of a contract for an employee's noncompliance and restricts a rehabilitated individual to supervised direct contact with committed youth.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: food products; cultivated cells; labeling
rollCalls.summary: Outlines labeling requirements for food products derived from cultivated cells.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater replenishment; Pinal AMA
rollCalls.summary: Allows a municipal provider that applies for a new designation of assured water supply in the Pinal Active Management Area (AMA) that relies on a member service area agreement to elect for all parcels of member land in the municipal service area to retain a replenishment obligation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registrations; transportation department; recorders
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, requires the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to send voter registration information to both the Secretary of State (SOS) and the appropriate county recorder simultaneously.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state land transfer; Bullhead City
rollCalls.summary: Transfers the title of approximately 38.38 acres of state sovereign land from the Arizona State Land Department (ASLD) to Bullhead City.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: narcotic injection sites; zoning; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a municipality or county from adopting an ordinance, regulation or overlay zoning district that would allow for the development of a narcotics injection site.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mixed hoteling; signage; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires a homeless service provider, building supervisor and building owner of a hotel that engages in mixed hoteling to prominently post a prescribed statement that informs the reader that the business is being used to house homeless individuals alongside the general public. Requires any guest who objects to mixed hoteling to be issued a full refund at the time of arrival and prohibits the use of state or local monies for mixed hoteling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; double punishment.
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $500,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Veterans' Services (ADVS) to award grants to nonprofit veterans' organizations in counties with a population of fewer than 500,000 persons that assist with housing or employment benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: food; municipal tax; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily caps, retroactive to January 1, 2025, the tax or fee that a city, town or other taxing jurisdiction may impose on the sale of food and certain beverage items intended for home consumption at 2 percent of the base, subjects the adoption or increase of the tax or fee to voter approval and prohibits the adoption or increase of the tax or fee from occurring in the 24-month period preceding June 30, 2027.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registrations; recorder; inactive status
rollCalls.summary: Allows a county recorder to place a person's voter registration information in paused status on receipt of information that provides reasonable cause to believe a person's registration information does not match existing records or open-source public data.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internet safety instruction; public schools
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school that is operated by a school district or charter school to complete an annual attestation stating that the school is providing instruction that meets the digital citizenship and media literacy standards within specified academic standards beginning in the 2026-2027 school year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: model city tax code; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires a municipality that proposes an ordinance to adopt or repeal a model or local option in the Model City Tax Code (MCTC) to notify all affected taxpayers before the proposed ordinance is approved or rejected, with exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physician assistants; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Modifies qualifications for physician assistants (PA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early voting list; undeliverable ballots
rollCalls.summary: Requires the county recorder, or officer in charge of elections, to remove the voter from the Active Early Voting List (AEVL) if the AEVL notice is returned undeliverable by the post office.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: multistate voter registration system; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Allows Arizona to become a member of a specified governmental or nongovernmental entity for the purpose of sharing and exchanging information relating to voter registration information. Requires the county recorder to establish a general voter registration list maintenance program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: jurors; peremptory challenge; civil action
rollCalls.summary: Reinstates the use of peremptory challenges in jury selection for civil actions in superior court.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: juveniles; change of judge; impartiality
rollCalls.summary: Grants each party to a permanency determination action the right to request a change of judge for cause and the right to make one request for change of judge without cause. Outlines procedures and filing requirements for requesting a change of judge for or without cause.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; workers' compensation; investigation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Arizona Blockchain Budget Initiative Pilot Program (Pilot Program) within the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) to assess the feasibility and cost-effectiveness of using a blockchain platform to record and publish budget data from selected agencies. Appropriates $1,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to ADOA for the Pilot Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: postpartum depression; treatment; insurers
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Health Services (DHS) to compile relevant educational materials and information regarding maternal mental health conditions, including postpartum depression, for use by health care institutions, health care professionals and patients and to establish an Advisory Committee on Obstetrics, Gynecology and Maternal Mental Health in Rural Communities (Advisory Committee).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: cell phone carrier; spam calls
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a city, town or county from regulating the act of lawfully assessing or using computational power in a residence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: website information; pregnant women
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), by December 1, 2025, to provide a conspicuous link on the agency's public website that directs a person to adoption information and support for pregnant women.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; foreign money
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of monies or in-kind goods and services from a foreign government in election administration.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: abortions; public funding; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state or any political subdivision of the state from providing public funding to any entity that performs or promotes abortions, rather than any entity that performs nonfederally qualified abortions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fentanyl; motor vehicle; sentencing
rollCalls.summary: Establishes specific sentencing ranges for persons convicted of possession or transportation of a narcotic drug if the offense involves the possession of fentanyl in a motor vehicle in an amount of at least 200 grams.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: aggravated assault; accomplices; classification
rollCalls.summary: Expands the criminal classification of aggravated assault .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: election procedures manual; legislative approval
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Elections Procedure Manual (EPM) to be approved by the Governor and the chairpersons of the House of Representatives and Senate committees with jurisdiction over election matters, rather than the Governor and Attorney General (AG).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance complaints; resolution
rollCalls.summary: Deems a campaign finance violation complaint dismissed if the complaint is not resolved or ruled on by the filing officer within 180 days and the deadline for resolving or ruling is not extended.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: middle school students; CTE courses
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes, during the 2025-2026, 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 school years, a school district or charter school to offer career and technical education (CTE) courses to middle school students which may be counted toward the promotion from eighth grade and graduation from high school. Allows a middle school student to be funded with career technical education district (CTED) monies as prescribed and outlines administrative and reporting requirements for school districts and charter schools that offer CTE courses to middle school students.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipalities; associations; restrictions
rollCalls.summary: Describes the regulations and restrictions a municipality is prohibited from requiring an association to impose on a preliminary plat, final plat or specific plan.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unmanned aircraft; qualified immunity
rollCalls.summary: Immunizes a public entity or employee from liability to an unmanned aircraft operator for any injury to personal property caused by a peace officer rendering an unmanned aircraft inoperative under outlined conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: juveniles; temporary custody; parental notification
rollCalls.summary: Requires, effective July 1, 2026, the Arizona Department of Education (ADE), in collaboration with the Arizona Peace Officer and Standards Training Board (AZPOST), to create a training program for law enforcement officers and security personnel who are employed by an Arizona school district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health care facilities; electronic monitoring
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits assisted living facilities and nursing care institutions that receive public monies from restricting the use of electronic monitoring devices in a current or prospective resident's private living space or otherwise discriminating or retaliating against a resident for the use of electronic monitoring.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ground ambulances; registration
rollCalls.summary: Allows an ambulance certificate of registration (certificate) to remain valid and in effect pending certain action by the Department of Health Services (DHS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical board; disciplinary action
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Arizona Medical Board (AMB) from requiring or taking any action against a licensee that requires the licensee to waive any fundamental legal rights or liberties, as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: social media protections; minors
rollCalls.summary: Provides regulations for a social media platform providing an online service, product or feature to a minor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowner's associations; unlawful enforcement; damages
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes liability damages for associations that attempt to enforce provisions of their governing documents that are prohibited by law.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: antisemitism; public schools; prohibition; penalties
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes prohibitions on public schools, public school personnel, higher education institutions and higher education institution personnel relating to the teaching or promotion of antisemitism or anti-Semitic conduct, acts and processes (antisemitism or anti-Semitic conduct). Outlines reporting procedures, disciplinary requirements and legal remedies for violations of the prohibitions on antisemitism and anti-Semitic conduct and compliance requirements for higher education institutions. Designates this legislation as the Antisemitism in Education Act (Act) .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: preferential treatment; discrimination; policies
rollCalls.summary: Outlines prohibitions for the state or a state agency, a city or town, county, community college district governing board and a state university relating to diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). Requires the state or a state agency, a city or town, county, community college district governing board and a state university to adopt policies that appropriately discipline an employee or contractor that engages in conduct that violates the prohibitions relating to DEI.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; ibogaine; clinical research study
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $5,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Health Services (DHS) to award a grant to conduct a certified clinical research study on the use of ibogaine for the treatment of neurological diseases.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; office of defense innovation
rollCalls.summary: Requires, beginning on the effective date, any executive director or director who serves at the pleasure of the Governor who is subject to Senate confirmation and who is retained from any previous Governor's administration to be renominated by the current Governor, with the consent of the Senate. Requires the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of the Arizona Commerce Authority (ACA) to be appointed by the Governor, rather than employed and contracted by the ACA Board of Directors.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unauthorized encampments; higher education institutions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an individual from establishing or occupying an encampment on the campus of a university or community college and outlines requirements for enforcement and penalties for violators.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: alternative fuel vehicles; HOV lanes
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person who owns a motor vehicle that uses alternative fuel to apply for a license plate or special plate, rather than an alternative fuel vehicle special plate.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: silver alert; criteria; notification
rollCalls.summary: Renames the silver alert as the seek and find alert, expands the alert to include missing persons with cognitive disabilities, prohibits the denial or delay of an alert and requires law enforcement agencies (LEAs) to develop and conduct training on the Seek and Find Alert Notification System (System).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state budget; structural balance; estimates
rollCalls.summary: Requires the annual general appropriation act to be balanced for each fiscal year. Reduces the amount owed to each school district for Basic State Aid (BSA) and additional state aid entitlements in the FY 2025 General Appropriation Act (K-12 rollover).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sovereign authority
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the state's intent to exercise sovereignty over all powers not otherwise granted to the Federal Government or reserved to the people by the U.S. Constitution.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: insurance coverage; hearing aids; children
rollCalls.summary: Requires a claim against an irrigation and water conservation district by a municipal water provider, or a claim against a municipal water provider by an irrigation and water conservation district, regarding a contract for the district to provide water with a term of 20 years or more to be brought within eight years after the claim accrues. Applies the eight-year time limitation to any cause of action commenced on, after or before the general effective date.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nurses; provisional licensure
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona State Board of Nursing (AZBN) to issue a provisional license or certificate to an out-of-state advanced practice registered nurse (APRN), registered nurse (RN) or licensed practical nurse (LPN) within five business days after receipt of an application and the associated fees, if outlined conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: long-term RVs; cooling; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that allows a tenant of a recreational vehicle (RV), that is a motor home, park trailer or travel trailer, to install reasonably necessary commercial cooling methods on the tenant's RV.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: acute care services; pilot program
rollCalls.summary: Extends the Acute Care at Home Pilot Program (ACHPP) until January 1, 2029, and requires eligible hospitals to demonstrate the ability to ensure emergency response times of no more than 30 minutes to a patient's home.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; health innovation trust fund
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $250,000 from the General Fund (GF) to the Arizona Health Innovation Trust Fund (Trust Fund) in FY 2026; additionally, $250,000 is appropriated for a health innovation pilot program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: on-site wastewater treatment; general permit
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ), by January 1, 2026, to issue a general permit that authorizes a liquid effluent collection system that is designed as a septic tank effluent pump system or a septic tank effluent gravity system, complies with statutorily prescribed requirements relating to general permits for defined classes of facilities and is owned or operated by a single person.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elevator contractors; elevator mechanics; regulation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to take a majority vote at a public meeting and publish the ACC's position online before the ACC, ACC staff or any registered lobbyist on behalf of the ACC may advocate for or against any legislation, regulation or rule. Requires the Attorney General (AG), at the request of the Legislature to investigate a violation of the requirement that the ACC publicly vote before advocating on any legislation, regulation or rule. Subjects the ACC or a commissioner to a $500 penalty for each instance of noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; veterans' services; mental health
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Veterans' Services (ADVS) for grants to nonprofit organizations that deliver outlined mental and behavioral health services to active duty service members, veterans and military families.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; health care directives registry
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $500,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Health Services (DHS) for the operation of the health care directives registry and establishes reporting requirements associated with the registry.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: historical society; local chapters; fund
rollCalls.summary: Establishes Historical Society Chapter Building Enhancement Funds (Funds) for chapters of the Arizona Historical Society (AHS) and specifies relevant details relating to the fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: justification; criminal offenses
rollCalls.summary: Specifies the justification afforded by statute regarding the threat or use of physical force or deadly physical force is a defense in a prosecution for any criminal offense, rather than only offenses listed in the criminal code.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Somerton bridge replacement
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,300,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to distribute to Yuma County for the bridge replacement project on Somerton Avenue.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nonemergency medical transportation; study
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to contract with an independent consulting firm to conduct a study on the adequacy and appropriateness of the current reimbursement rates for non-emergency medical transport (NEMT) providers and to include the results of the study in AHCCCS's next capitation rate request and reimbursement rate for NEMT providers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: TPT; exemption; firearm storage devices
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the gross proceeds of sales or gross income derived from sales of safe firearm storage devices from the retail classification of transaction privilege tax (TPT) and use tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: trusts; estates; policies; procedures
rollCalls.summary: Modifies various terms that are used when dealing with trusts, estates and protective proceedings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance; third-party complaints
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a filing officer from accepting a complaint from a third-party unless the complaint is filed by an individual, or by an individual on behalf of an entity, who submits evidence that the individual is an identifiable human being.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homeowners' associations; attorney fees
rollCalls.summary: Precludes an association from charging or assessing their attorney fees and costs onto a homeowner.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: vehicle license tax; exemption; military
rollCalls.summary: Expands the exemption on vehicle license taxes (VLTs) and registration fees for an active duty member of the U.S. Armed Forces to include the 30 days before deployment and allows qualifying payments to be refunded, rather than prorated in the following year.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: emergency use products; employers; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits an employer, government entity or healthcare entity from requiring the administration of an emergency use product.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: boards and commissions; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Repeals specified state boards, commissions, councils and related licensure.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; international registered nurses
rollCalls.summary: Requires approved amendments to the US Constitution to be ratified in the form of a bill passed by the Legislature and signed by the Governor. Establishes the criminal offense of being a faithless constitutional convention delegate .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; informed consent
rollCalls.summary: Allows parties in the Arizona Court of Appeals to seek a rehearing en banc under specific conditions, requiring a petition citing conflicting case law and approval by a majority of active appellate judges.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school immunizations; exemption; adult students
rollCalls.summary: Requires a higher education institution that requires students to submit documentary proof of immunization to exempt any student who is at least 18 years old from the requirement if the student submits a statement that the student understands the risks of nonimmunization and does not consent to the immunizations due to personal beliefs or an outlined written certification that states that one or more of the required immunizations may be detrimental to the student's health.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: natural resources; federal law; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the state, any agency or political subdivision of the state and any employee, agency or political subdivision of the state acting in the employee's official capacity from using any personnel or financial resources to enforce, administer or cooperate with outlined federal actions and programs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state sovereign authority; elections
rollCalls.summary: Asserts the sovereign authority of Arizona election statutes over qualifications to vote in federal elections that are held in Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: TPT; exemption; wastewater; pipes
rollCalls.summary: Expands the transaction privilege tax (TPT) deduction and use tax exemption relating to pipes to include pipes or valves that are four inches in diameter or larger that are used to transport wastewater.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; licensure; renewal
rollCalls.summary: Deems, as failure to maintain adequate records , a person's knowing failure to maintain or report the destruction of certain behavioral health service records for which a claim is submitted, payment is received or that disclose information on which rates of payment are based, when outlined conditions apply. Prescribes penalty classifications for the failure to maintain or report the destruction of records as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; prohibited purchases; waiver
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Department of Economic Security (Director) to request a waiver from the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) to exclude soda from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and, if the waiver is granted, to prohibit SNAP enrollees from purchasing soda with SNAP benefits.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commercial driver license examiners; notice
rollCalls.summary: Requires use fuel dispenser labels to be provided to vendors that submit receipts from one fueling position for each use fuel type and, if applicable, one in-store point of sale system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; board meetings; expenditures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a school district governing board (governing board) to hold governing board meetings at a public facility in the school district and provide public access to meeting materials and recordings as outlined. Prescribes requirements on a governing board regarding the approval of out-of-state travel for school employees and governing board members.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: mental health inquiry; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a health profession regulatory board or licensing authority from asking on an application for a license, permit, certificate, endorsement or registration whether an applicant has received mental health assistance, diagnosis or treatment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ALTCS; preadmission screening; cognitive impairment
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS), subject to available monies, to update the Arizona Long Term Care System's (ALTCS's) preadmission screening instrument to assess cognitive needs regarding prompting, monitoring and supervising activities of daily living for applicants who are elderly or adults with physical disabilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: digital advertising; content; children; penalty
rollCalls.summary: Requires, beginning January 1, 2026, a child-directed application to take appropriate measures to prevent the display of inappropriate and mature advertisements on the application.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona department of housing; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Department of Housing (ADOH) for one year through July 1, 2026. Directs the Auditor General to conduct a special audit on the amount of monies spent on programs and services for individuals experiencing homelessness. Outlines requirements for ADOH.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: advisory committee; subcommittee; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Exempts, from open meeting law, the exchange of communications among a quorum of a three-member advisory committee or subcommittee that involves a discussion or deliberation concerning a matter before the advisory committee or subcommittee.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; vaccinations; child placement
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Department of Child Safety (DCS) from refusing to place a child with a foster home or kinship foster care parent based solely on the vaccination status of the child or other children in the home.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; state mine inspector; safety
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $900,000 in FY 2026 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the State Mine Inspector for mine safety measures and software database acquisitions and upgrades.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: supply and demand; assessment; groundwater
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to include outlined data in each five-year supply and demand assessment for each groundwater basin.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; assured water supply
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Cochise County Board of Supervisors (BOS), by July 2, 2026, to vote to place a question on the 2026 general election ballot for the residents of Cochise County that reside within the Willcox Groundwater Basin on whether to establish a domestic water improvement district.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: designation; assured water supply; offset
rollCalls.summary: Creates an alternative designation of assured water supply (AWS) for persons withdrawing groundwater and storing water recovered from outside the area of impact.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; certificate; model
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that requires the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to review the merits of an application for a certificate of assured water supply (Certificate) in the Phoenix active management area (AMA) and issue a new written determination of action within 15 days if certain criteria are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) for six years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health examiners board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Governor's Regulatory Review Council (GRRC), the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI), the Arizona Board of Behavioral Health Examiners, the Arizona Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX), the Arizona Board of Osteopathic Examiners in Medicine and Surgery and the Arizona Board of Respiratory Care Examiners . Modifies GRRC membership and appointment requirements and outlines requirements for GRRC meetings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: osteopathic examiners board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Board of Osteopathic Examiners in Medicine and Surgery (Board) for six years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: respiratory care examiners board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Board of Respiratory Care Examiners (Board) for six years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: notaries; businesses; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that, if an entity does not provide the option to notarize documents without charge or cost, then individuals seeking notarization may use any authorized notarial officer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: transnational repression; foreign adversaries
rollCalls.summary: Establishes sentencing enhancements for crimes committed by an agent of a foreign government or a foreign terrorist organization and requires the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to establish a Transnational Repression Recognition and Response Training Program (Program).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: rare disease advisory council
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Rare Disease Advisory Council (RDAC) within the Department of Health Services (DHS) to provide guidance and recommendations on the needs of individuals living with a rare disease. Outlines RDAC membership, powers and responsibilities.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: corrections; Marana; transitional facility; study
rollCalls.summary: Directs the Arizona Department of Corrections, Rehabilitation and Reentry (ADCRR) to conduct a comprehensive study that determines whether the Marana Prison Site could be converted into and used as a transitional facility and program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: homelessness; data; performance audit
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Office of the Auditor General (OAG), by December 31, 2026, to conduct a special audit of the amount of monies spent on programs and services for individuals experiencing homelessness in Arizona. Appropriates $1,250,000 from the Housing Trust Fund to the OAG in FY 2026 to conduct the special audit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: AHCCCS; enrollment verification; presumptive eligibility
rollCalls.summary: Establishes, beginning January 1, 2026, enrollment verification requirements for the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to confirm member eligibility and standards for qualified hospitals to make presumptive eligibility determinations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: written request; property locators
rollCalls.summary: Outlines requirements for a locator to register with the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to provide recovery services to the apparent owner of unclaimed property. Establishes the Locator Registration Fund consisting of monies received from locator registration and renewal fees. Reduces the cap on the fee a locator may charge for recovering unclaimed property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: corporation commission; electricity; reliability; management
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) from authorizing or approving the retirement of an electric generation facility as presented in a rate case, integrated resource plan or other submission to the ACC unless there is a new electric generation facility with equal or greater power generation that is presently available on the grid.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: conservation requirements; industrial water use
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR), by January 1, 2026, to include in an Active Management Area (AMA) management plan for each qualifying AMA, conservation requirements for industrial uses that are within and outside of the service area of a designated service provider and that meet outlined conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; groundwater rights; AMAs
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person that owns acres of land within a subsequent active management area (AMA) described on an irrigation grandfathered right (IGFR) that have not been retired from irrigation for a non-irrigation use, to apply to the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to add acres of land within the same groundwater basin or subbasin to the person's IGFR. Grants the owner or lessee of the additional acres the right to use groundwater to irrigate the additional acres.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; plants; containers; non-irrigation
rollCalls.summary: Expands non-irrigation uses of groundwater in an active management area (AMA) to include using groundwater to water plants grown using hydroponics and wine grapes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: memorial; Don Bolles
rollCalls.summary: Dedicates a memorial in Wesley Bolin Plaza to Don Bolles.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: physical therapists; imaging; laboratory tests
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that a physical therapist may order imaging only for patients with an established patient relationship with the physical therapist and for whom there is a clinical need for the imaging. Removes the specification that imaging ordered by a physical therapist be musculoskeletal consisting of plain film radiographs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child and family representation; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Child and Family Representation Program (Program) in the Administrative Office of the Courts (AOC) to ensure uniform legal representation by attorneys appointed to represent juveniles, parents and guardians during juvenile court proceedings. Appropriates $200,000 and one FTE from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the AOC to implement the Program. Outlines Program and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: competitive sealed bidding; questions; answers
rollCalls.summary: Creates a mandatory question and answer period for the Arizona Department of Administration's (ADOA) competitive sealed bidding process.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; leases; termination; nonrenewal
rollCalls.summary: Grants a charter school that is leasing or is the most recent lessee of a building owned by a school district the right of first refusal to purchase the building if the building is up for sale. Prescribes actions a school district must take before terminating or refusing to renew a lease for school buildings. Exempts proceeds derived from the sale or lease of school property to other schools from the statutory restrictions on the expenditure of proceeds derived from the sale or lease of school property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: victims; disclosure requirements; witnesses; names
rollCalls.summary: Allows a victim's name to be redacted from records released pursuant to a public records request if the agency reasonably expects that the release of the victim's name will result in harassment of the victim, threats to the victim's safety or witness tampering, with outlined exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: blockchain and cryptocurrency study committee
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a luxury privilege tax classification for ready-to-drink spirits products and imposes a tax of $1.50 per gallon on each sealed container. Requires craft distillers, producers and wholesalers to pay the luxury privilege tax and add the amount of tax to the sales price. Outlines Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) administrative requirements for ready-to-drink spirits product treatment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: expungement of misdemeanor convictions
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person who was convicted of a misdemeanor to submit a petition for expungement (Petition) with the convicting court, provided that the individual satisfies all outlined requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DCS; kinship care placement; requirement
rollCalls.summary: Adds extended family members to the list of persons who qualify as a kinship foster care placement and requires extended family members to be included in all investigations and proceedings related to identifying a kinship foster care placement for a child in the temporary custody of the Department of Child Safety (DCS).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; exemption; veterans; disabilities
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the property of a veteran with a service-connected disability whose U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) disability rating is 100 percent, or the veteran's surviving spouse, from the full amount of property tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state fair board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Arizona Exposition and State Fair Board (Board) for eight years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax; distribution; county stadium district
rollCalls.summary: Redirects, to the Maricopa County Stadium District Fund (District Fund), specified transaction privilege tax (TPT) revenues collected from certain business activities at a Major League Baseball (MLB) facility or adjacent buildings that are owned by the Maricopa County Stadium District (Chase Field and its adjacent buildings) and redirects 82 percent of the state income tax from the professional baseball franchise organization domiciled in Arizona before the general effective date (Arizona Diamondbacks), Arizona Diamondback employees and any professional baseball franchise organizations from…
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public resources; expenditures; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a public entity from spending, loaning or allowing the use of public resources to aid an individual, association, corporation or other private party, unless the expenditure is for a public purpose as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pledge of allegiance; parental notification
rollCalls.summary: Adds, to the course of study and competency requirements for the promotion of students from the 8th grade, a requirement that each student complete at least three social studies course credits in the 6th-8th grades, including one civics education course credit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater permits; technical correction
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of water supply development as it relates to the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA) to include planning, designing, building or developing water-related facilities, permits or plans reasonably necessary for those facilities for remediation, including by a reclamation or remediation project that is approved by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and that increases the availability of water.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: liquor sampling; reporting; requirements.
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes the authorized means for a licensed beer and wine store or liquor store with sampling privileges to maintain and report required sampling records.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: court-ordered evaluations
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the county's responsibility for court-ordered evaluation of persons who are alleged to be, as a result of a mental disorder, a danger to self or to others or who have a persistent or acute disability or a grave disability, continues until the end of the evaluation period and excludes weekends and holidays from the prescribed timelines relating to court-ordered evaluation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unclaimed property; virtual currency; security
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a process to deem digital assets as abandoned property and for a holder to deliver the abandoned property to the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR). Establishes the Bitcoin and Digital Assets Reserve Fund (Fund) consisting of abandoned digital assets for which three years have passed after the date the abandoned digital assets were transferred to a qualified custodian, if the abandoned digital assets remain unclaimed. Requires the State Treasurer, on approval of the Legislature, to deposit 10 percent of the digital assets held in the Fund into the state General Fund (state GF).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: fire trucks; diesel fuel; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a fire truck, fire engine or other fire apparatus that is exempt from the federal diesel fuel tax to use dyed diesel fuel when transporting fire fighters on state highways outside of areas A, B and C.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona teachers academy; community colleges..
rollCalls.summary: Expands the definition of eligible postsecondary institution for the purposes of the Arizona Teachers Academy by including any Arizona community college.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; certificate; environmental compatibility
rollCalls.summary: Allows a utility, after providing 30 days written notice to the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to construct a new small modular nuclear reactor in Arizona without filing an application or receiving a certificate of environmental compatibility if the new or small nuclear reactor is co-located with a large industrial energy user.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: utility; resource plan; commission review
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to require an electric public service corporation in Arizona to prepare and submit an outlined integrated resource plan to the ACC for review and approval at least once every three years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: student records; expulsions; disclosure requirements
rollCalls.summary: Requires a pupil who brings a deadly weapon to a school to be expelled for at least one year. Directs a school district governing board (governing board) to record the results of any discipline taken after a student withdraws. Mandates a public school disclose to another Arizona educational institution whether a pupil has been expelled from the public school.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technology study committee; assistive technology
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Technology Study Committee (Committee) study and address specific issues related to assistive technology, including technology first initiatives.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: erroneous convictions; compensation
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a claimant's ability to bring an action against the state for an erroneous conviction, with outlined procedures for the processing of the claim and entitlements to the claimant if the claim is granted.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: noncustodial federal monies; appropriation
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2027, authorizes the Legislature to appropriate noncustodial federal monies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative subpoena; refusal; contempt
rollCalls.summary: Allows a legislative committee to hold a witness in contempt for neglecting to obey a legislative subpoena if an order of contempt is issued by the committee chairperson for failure to comply with the subpoena after the witness is given an opportunity for a hearing to present evidence as to why the witness is not in contempt. Requires all testimony produced pursuant to legislative proceedings to be sworn testimony under penalty of perjury.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legislative district committee; county committee
rollCalls.summary: States a chairman of a legislative district committee is a nonvoting member of the county committee unless the chairman resides in that county.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: terrorist organizations; drug cartels
rollCalls.summary: Declares that drug cartels are terrorist organizations and requires the Arizona Department of Homeland Security (AZDOHS) to do everything within its authority to address the threat that drug cartels pose.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Glendale; 75th Avenue reconstruction
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $3,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to distribute to the City of Glendale (Glendale) for the 75th Avenue reconstruction project.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: trailers; HOV lanes; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a vehicle towing a trailer, semitrailer or pole trailer from using a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county committee; vacancy; precinct committeeman
rollCalls.summary: Establishes requirements for filling a vacancy in the office of precinct committeeman for a county political committee.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: task order contracts; website; posting
rollCalls.summary: Requires a state governmental unit, school district, or city, town or county government that enters into a task order contract with a contractor in Arizona to conspicuously post the contract on the state governmental unit's website. Outlines personal or proprietary information that may be exempt from the posting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; juvenile court; records
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to distribute to city, town, county and tribal law enforcement agencies for the purchase and deployment of drones for law enforcement purposes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: craft producer; festival; fair; license
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a craft producer festival license and a craft producer fair license. Repeals statutes authorizing farm winery, craft distillery and microbrewery festival and fair licenses.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: financial technology; digital assets program
rollCalls.summary: Retitles the Arizona Regulatory Sandbox Program as the Financial Technology, Digital Assets and Blockchain Sandbox Program and modifies the definition of innovation to include digital assets.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tax rates; reductions
rollCalls.summary: Decreases the individual income tax rate, the estates and trusts income tax rate, the Arizona small business income tax rate, the state transaction privilege tax (TPT) rate and the qualifying tax rate (QTR).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: qualifying tax rate; tax bill
rollCalls.summary: Requires each property tax bill and property tax statement prepared for any property located within a school district to include a prescribed statement regarding specified tax rates.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: inpatient treatment days; computation; exclusion
rollCalls.summary: Excludes any time that a patient has spent in jail or prison from the maximum period of involuntary inpatient treatment days that the court may order the patient to undergo.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: gold star families; legacy preservation
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's support of Gold Star Families, pledge to preserve the term Gold Star Families and encouragement of public and private entities in Arizona to protect the term.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: federal funds; legislative approval
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily authorizes the Legislature to appropriate noncustodial federal monies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: for-sale housing; development; groundwater replenishment
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's support for allowing for-sale housing developments to be built outside of the service area of a designated provider if the development is enrolled in the Central Arizona Groundwater Replenishment District (CAGRD) and the groundwater used to serve such homes is replenished.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: property tax; combat veterans; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily exempts the property of a combat veteran with a combat-related, service-connected disability that is rated at 100 percent by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) from the full amount of property tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prohibited weapons; definition repeal
rollCalls.summary: Adds, to the eligibility requirements for a member of legislative office, that the person has not been a lobbyist for one year immediately preceding the primary election. Adds, to the eligibility requirements for a member of statewide office, that the person has not been a lobbyist for two years immediately preceding the primary election. Prohibits a member of a school district governing board, county board of supervisors (county BOS) or city or town council from engaging in paid lobbying for any person or entity.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: assured water supply; legislative intent
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislatures opposition to the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) rulemaking relating to the alternative path to the designation of assured water supply (ADAWS) and determines that it is contrary to Arizona statute and therefore null and void. Expresses the Legislatures opposition to any rule, regulation, policy or condition that the Governor or the Director of ADWR proposes or adopts that meets outlined conditions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement; first responders; honoring
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's gratitude to all law enforcement personnel, other first responders and volunteers in the State of Arizona for their unparalleled public service.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: drug cartels; terrorist organizations
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily declares that drug cartels are terrorist organizations and requires the Arizona Department of Homeland Security ( AZDHS ) to do everything in its authority to address the threat posed by drug cartels.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: teacher retention; study; report
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to complete an annual study to determine the retention rate of Arizona school district and charter school teachers. Appropriates $500,000 from the Teacher Certification Fund in FY 2026 to ADE to conduct the annual study. Outlines study and reporting requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; accountants; investigations
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that establishes the procedure a County Recorder must follow if they receive or received information that a registered voter who filled out a state voter registration form has not provided satisfactory documentary proof of citizenship.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parental notification; school immunization exemptions
rollCalls.summary: Requires any school communication regarding school immunization requirements to a parent, guardian or person in loco parentis to include information about school immunization exemptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child care facilities; program providers
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes requirements for an out-of-school time (OST) program provider licensed as a child care facility to maintain rosters of school-age children.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: landlord tenant; assistance animals
rollCalls.summary: States that a landlord is not liable for injuries or damages cause by a purported assistance or service animal that is allowed a reasonable accommodation or modification on the landlord's property.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; mandatory employment and training
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Economic Security (DES) to require able-bodied adults under 60 years old who are receiving Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits to participate in a mandatory employment and training program, as prescribed by federal law, unless the recipient meets criteria for exemption.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: SNAP; work requirement waivers; exemptions
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the Department of Economic Security (DES) from seeking, applying for, accepting or renewing any waiver of work requirement under the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) for able-bodied adults without dependents unless it is required by federal law or authorized by state law. Prohibits DES from exercising the option to provide exemptions from the SNAP work requirement unless authorized by state law.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical records; parental rights
rollCalls.summary: Requires a healthcare entity, while maintaining required confidentiality, to provide the parent of a minor child with access to any electronic portal and delivery platform for the minor's medical records, regardless of whether parental consent is required for the medical treatment rendered.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: environmental remediation; liability; release
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) to provide to a prospective remediator of a site, a written release and covenant not to sue. Allows the agreement with ADEQ and a prospective remediator to include an agreement by the prospective remediator to provide substantial funding or other resources to perform or facilitate remedial measures at a facility.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: registered sanitarians; qualifications
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the eligibility requirements for registration as a sanitarian.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health facilities; complaints; investigations; training
rollCalls.summary: Establishes requirements for the Arizona Department of Health Services (DHS) relating to complaint investigations. Describes the process for licensee's who receive a statement of deficiencies following a state survey or complaint investigation and wishes to refute those deficiencies. Requires DHS to implement an annual training program for all licensing surveyors, supervisors and managers of licensing surveyors to ensure compliance with health care institution licensing, survey and complaint investigation requirements and outlines objectives for the training program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; AEDs; CPR training; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Establishes automated external defibrillator (AED) and training requirements for public high schools that sponsor an athletic team or sports program. Appropriates $500,000 from the state General Fund (GF) in FY 2026 for AED and training requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; electricity; power authority
rollCalls.summary: Requires public power entities and electric utilities to prepare a biennial wildfire mitigation plan, as prescribed, and outlines wildfire mitigation plan review and approval requirements. Prescribes liability for causing wildfires in any cause of action for negligence against a public power entity or electric utility that is related to wildfire.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: total loss vehicle; electronic signatures
rollCalls.summary: Allows a power of attorney (POA) to be to be signed electronically and printed by using a commercial product that uses an identity assurance level 2 (IAL2) or higher authorization without biometrics, prescribes requirements for electronic signatures and allows an agent to execute a POA involving a total loss settlement without notarization.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: condominiums; commercial structures; residential structures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a condominium that includes commercial structures that are separate from the residential structures to assess common expenses that exclusively benefit the residential or commercial structures against the respective units.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: disability; voluntary disclosure; licenses
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person to request the Arizona Department of Transportation (ADOT) to note that a communication accommodation may be needed on a person's license or vehicle registration and requires ADOT to establish methods and procedures for requests.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: business personal property; exemption.
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2032, exempts, from property tax, all locally assessed personal property that is used for agricultural purposes or used in a trade or business.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; purchases; board members
rollCalls.summary: Limits the authorization for a school district governing board (governing board) to make purchases from a member of the governing board as prescribed to school districts that are not located in a county with a population of at least 750,000.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: alcohol consumption; golf courses
rollCalls.summary: Permits certain golf courses to allow patrons to bring their own spiritous liquor onto the golf course.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal council vacancies; appointment; deadline
rollCalls.summary: Requires vacancies on a municipal council to be filled within 60 days of the vacancy notice.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: psychologist board; complaint-related documents
rollCalls.summary: Modifies documental review requirements relating to an Arizona Board of Psychologist Examiners (Board) investigation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: self-certification program; administrative review
rollCalls.summary: Requires, rather than allows, a city or town by ordinance to authorize administrative personnel to review and approve certain development documents.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: notice; violation; deficiency correction
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the procedures relating to inspections for a regulated person by requiring an agency to provide a regulated person with the opportunity to correct an alleged deficiency.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: wildlife; taking; landowner permits; rules
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Game and Fish Department (Department) to issue a landowner permit to take specified wildlife on private lands.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: income tax; exemption; minors
rollCalls.summary: Exempts an individual who is under 18 years old and whose Arizona gross income is $50,000 or less from state individual income tax.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hunting; fishing; license; deferred prosecution
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Arizona Game and Fish Commission (Commission), on entering a deferred prosecution agreement and after a public hearing, to revoke or suspend a license issued to any person and deny the person the right to secure another license to take or possess wildlife for a period of up to five years for statutorily outlined violations and the unlawful taking or possession of wildlife.
