rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: governor nominations; agency position; eligibility
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a nominee for a state agency director position who is rejected by the Senate, from being eligible for any other position, including an independent contractor, within the same state agency for which the individual was nominated.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electoral college; support
rollCalls.summary: Declares that the Legislature affirms the importance of the electoral college for presidential elections in the United States.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting equipment; requirements; origin
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits, beginning January 1, 2029, the Secretary of State (SOS) from certifying any vote recording and vote tabulating machines if the parts and components of such machines are not 100 percent sourced from and manufactured in the United States.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: health education; fetal development instruction
rollCalls.summary: Requires the State Board of Education (SBE) to require all health education instruction provided to students in grades 7 or 8 include outlined instruction on fetal development. Allows the SBE to require that health education instruction that is provided to students in any of grades 1 through 6 or 9 through 12 include age-appropriate instruction on fetal development.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early ballots; deadlines; foreign money
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the procedures for adding and retaining voters on the Active Early Voting List, alters deadlines for the return of early ballots beginning in 2027, allows for the on-site tabulation of early ballots during the weekend and Monday before the election and prohibits foreign contributions in Arizona's elections.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sentencing enhancements; vulnerable; incapacitated; adult.
rollCalls.summary: Increases, to between three and five years, the presumptive, minimum and maximum sentence for felony offenses knowingly committed against vulnerable adults depending on the felony classification. Deems, as ineligible for probation, pardon, suspension of sentence or release from confinement as outlined, any person who is at least 18 years old or tried as an adult who knowingly commits a felony offense against a vulnerable adult.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: businesses; requirement to accept cash
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that cash must be accepted as a form of payment by businesses located in this state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: patriotic youth groups; school access
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a public school principal (principal) to allow representatives from a recognized patriotic youth group to address students during regular school hours in the first quarter of an academic school year. Allows a principal to accept materials provided by the patriotic youth group for distribution to students and prohibits a public school from discriminating against, or denying access to, any patriotic youth group that wishes to conduct a meeting.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DUI; alternative treatment
rollCalls.summary: Allows a court to order a person convicted of driving under the influence (DUI), at the person's option, to participate in a religious program that is approved by the court. Adds evidence-based psychotherapy as an option for required court-ordered treatment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: preferential treatment; discrimination; prohibited acts
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, constitutionally prohibits the state from compelling or spending public monies on promoting or giving preferential treatment to or discriminating against any individual on the basis of race or ethnicity.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: license exemption; basic first aid
rollCalls.summary: Excludes the provision of basic first aid in good faith to an injured person, without compensation, from licensure requirements under the Arizona Medical Board (AMB) if the individual administering aid obtains the injured person’s consent before rendering assistance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: small estate; affidavit; limits
rollCalls.summary: Increases the maximum value of real or personal property that allows a small estate to be transferred to the decedent's successor through an affidavit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hazardous substance release; notice; liability
rollCalls.summary: Requires the owner of a qualifying property where there has been a release or threatened release of a hazardous substance to provide written notice that there has been a release or threatened release of a hazardous substance on the qualifying property to any prospective buyer of the qualifying property, the Director of the Arizona Department of Environmental Quality (ADEQ) and the State Mine Inspector if the site is a mine or abandoned mine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public schools; ultraprocessed foods
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits, beginning in school year 2026-2027, any school that participates in a federally funded or assisted meal program from serving, selling or allowing a third party to sell ultraprocessed food on school campus during the normal school day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elevator contractors; elevator mechanics; regulation
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Corporation Commission (ACC) to take a majority vote at a public meeting and publish the ACC's position online before the ACC, ACC staff or any registered lobbyist on behalf of the ACC may advocate for or against any legislation, regulation or rule. Requires the Attorney General (AG), at the request of the Legislature to investigate a violation of the requirement that the ACC publicly vote before advocating on any legislation, regulation or rule. Subjects the ACC or a commissioner to a $500 penalty for each instance of noncompliance.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal separate storm sewer system
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition of county as it relates to local stormwater quality programs to include counties that operate a regulated medium or large separate storm sewer system, rather than just a small municipal separate storm sewer system.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: missing indigenous person; alert system
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Turquoise Alert System (System) to issue and coordinate alerts for a missing person who is a tribal member under 65 years old and outlines requirements for the issuance and dissemination of an alert.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: electric vehicle charging stations; report
rollCalls.summary: Adds gasoline fuel reformulation options for all gasoline sold or offered for sale for use in motor vehicles in a county with a population of 1,200,000 or more people and in Area A. Allows any person to petition the Associate Director of the Plant Services Division of the Arizona Department of Agriculture (Associate Director) to request a waiver from the statutorily prescribed standards for motor fuel or the federal standards established by the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Clean Air Act.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school policies; internet; wireless devices
rollCalls.summary: Requires each school district governing board (governing board) and charter school governing body (governing body) to prescribe and enforce policies and procedures that govern student access to internet, restrict student access to social media platforms and limit student use of wireless communication devices during the school day as outlined, unless the school district or charter school has existing policies and procedures that meet the prescribed requirements on the effective date.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: medical assistants; scope of practice
rollCalls.summary: Allows a medical assistant to place and remove urinary catheters under the general supervision of a physician, physician assistant (PA) nurse practitioner (NP), clinical nurse specialist or certified nurse midwife.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: dental board; formal hearings
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the procedures of the Arizona State Board of Dental Examiners (BODEX) when investigating and adjudicating a complaint against a licensee. Specifies examination requirements for a dental hygienist to administer local anesthetics.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: administrative decisions; security proceedings; hearings
rollCalls.summary: Requires the right to trial by jury to be available and exercisable to the defendant in an appeal of a final administrative decision in which the judgment or order sought seeks payment from the other party.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: game and fish commission; membership
rollCalls.summary: Requires at least one member of the Arizona Game and Fish Commission (Commission) to be a cattleman or rancher.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: forced organ harvesting; insurance; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Allows insurers and the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to limit coverage for human organ transplants or post-transplant care if the transplant operation is performed in, or the human organ to be transplanted was procured by a sale or donation originating in the People's Republic of China or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: development; adaptive reuse; rezoning; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that modifies the requirement for certain municipalities to establish objective standards for multifamily residential development or adaptive reuse of existing commercial, office and mixed use buildings.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unlawful camping; stock; wildlife; access
rollCalls.summary: Modifies statute relating to unlawful camping.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: claims; prior authorization; conduct
rollCalls.summary: Effective July 1, 2026, requires a medical director, before a health care insurer may deny a claim or issue a direct denial of a prior authorization, to individually review any denial that involves medical necessity and prohibits the medical director from relying solely on recommendations derived from any other source during the prior authorization denial or claim denial review.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: election procedures manual; authority
rollCalls.summary: Asserts that the requirement for the Secretary of State (SOS) to adopt an official instruction and procedures manual, referred to as the Elections Procedures Manual (EPM), must not be construed as an excessive delegation of Legislative powers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DIFI; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Continues the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) for eight years.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: groundwater model; stormwater recharge; AMAs
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to adopt rules and annually update the groundwater model for active management areas (AMA) to account for new natural, incidental or artificial stormwater recharge.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: opioids; containers; labeling; requirements; repeal
rollCalls.summary: Eliminates the requirement that prescription opioid containers, directly dispensed by a pharmacist and not for immediate use, have a red cap.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: JPs; constables; signatures
rollCalls.summary: Requires a nomination petition for a candidate for justice of the peace or constable, in a county with a population of fewer than 1,000,000 persons, to receive either 300 signatures or at least one percent of the number of qualified signers in the precinct, rather than requiring the candidates to receive at least one percent of qualified signers in the precinct.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: topical medications
rollCalls.summary: Allows any unused portion of a facility-provided multidose medication (topical medication) that was administered to a patient to be offered to the patient on discharge from a hospital or outpatient surgical center if specified conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registration information; registers; violations
rollCalls.summary: Removes language classifying the possession or purchase of official precinct registers as a class 6 felony.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting locations; emergency designation; electioneering
rollCalls.summary: Modifies restrictions related to electioneering and requires all government-owned buildings or facilities of a county, city or town that are accessible to the public to be made available as voting locations on request.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unemployment insurance; benefit amounts
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the duration of unemployment insurance (UI) benefits that a person may receive during a benefit year, based on the unemployment rate (UR) during the prior calendar quarter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: guardianship; court appointments; care placement
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that a court may appoint a qualified physician, psychologist or registered nurse to evaluate an alleged incapacitated person during guardianship proceedings if the alleged incapacitated person does not already have an established relationship with one of the outlined providers. Outlines procedures relating to reasonable compensation of court-appointed evaluators in guardianship proceedings for alleged incapacitated persons.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: notices; directory information; disclosure; consent
rollCalls.summary: Allows a school to disclose student directory information if the school notifies a parent or eligible student of the information designated as directory information and of the right to refuse the disclosure of the information. Outlines directory information that may not be disclosed unless outlined conditions are met. Modifies requirements relating to a school district's parental involvement policy.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: unclaimed property; transfer; state treasurer
rollCalls.summary: Transfers administration of the collection, maintenance, sale and payment of unclaimed property from the Arizona Department of Revenue (ADOR) to the State Treasurer. Establishes the State Treasurer Administrative Fund, repeals the ADOR Administrative Fund and transfers any unexpended and unencumbered monies in the ADOR Administrative Fund to the State Treasurer Administrative Fund.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: statewide assessment; accommodations; written form
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the circumstances in which a school district or charter school may administer the statewide assessment in the form of a written test. Authorizes a student to opt out of a school-administered statewide assessment if the student submits an official score report from a nationally recognized assessment as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: state contracts; foreign adversary; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a company domiciled in the People's Republic of China from bidding on, submitting a proposal for or entering into a contract with a state agency for goods or services. Requires each company that submits a bid or proposal for a state contract for goods or services to certify that the company is not domiciled in the People's Republic of China. Outlines penalties for a company that submits a false certification letter.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: tracking system; sexual assault kits
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a Sexual Assault Kit Evidence Tracking System (System) to track and update the location and status of sexual assault kits (SAKs) and prescribes requirements for System operations and records.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school districts; board members; superintendent
rollCalls.summary: Requires, if the State Board of Education (SBE) places a school district in receivership, the school district superintendent to be terminated for cause and each seat of the school district governing board (governing board) to be deemed vacant. Outlines governing board member replacement procedures and deems a person ineligible to hold an appointed office in Arizona if the person held a governing board seat deemed vacant due to the school district being placed in receivership.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: campaign finance; candidate committee transfers
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes a city or town candidate's committee to transfer contributions to the same candidate's statewide or legislative candidate committee, provided the aggregate individual contributions transferred are within a specified limit.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pharmacists; emergency medication; administration
rollCalls.summary: Allows a pharmacist to order and administer emergency medication to manage an acute allergic reaction to medication that was administered at the pharmacy and requires the pharmacist to notify the person's primary care provider within 48 hours of administering the emergency medication.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: regulatory costs; rulemaking; legislative ratification
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes the requirements for specified proposed agency rules to be ratified by the Legislature before enactment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: on-farm irrigation efficiency program; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Extends the On-Farm Irrigation Efficiency Pilot Program (Pilot Program) from January 1, 2027, to January 1, 2030. Adds to the information that must be included in the statutorily outlined written report relating to the Pilot Program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: classroom management; students; temporary removal
rollCalls.summary: Stipulates that a principal or designated school administrator may direct a student who was removed from a classroom by a teacher back to the classroom only if the principal or administrator provides the teacher a written certification that contains the prescribed information.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: indistinguishable; visual depiction; definition.
rollCalls.summary: Modifies certain definitions relating to the sexual exploitation of children criminal classification to account for images created or modified by means of computer software, artificial intelligence or other digital editing tools.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: hydrolyzed cocaine; threshold amount
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the statutory drug threshold amount for hydrolyzed cocaine by including it in the existing 9 gram threshold amount for regular cocaine.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: nuclear energy; Palo Verde; support
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislatures support for the Palo Verde Generating Station and the safe and efficient use of nuclear energy to supply the energy consumption needs of the people of Arizona.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: elections; foreign contributions; donations; certification
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the use of monies or in-kind goods and services from a foreign government in election administration.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: minerals; metals; supporting domestic supply
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislatures recognition of the importance of Arizona's mineral and metal resources and the Legislatures support of policies and initiatives that promote mining and a domestic supply of mineral and metal resources.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: domestic relations; court appointments; fees
rollCalls.summary: Revises qualifications under which investigators may be appointed by the court during custody proceedings, and requires the court to pay the costs of any appointment.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: commerce authority; board of directors
rollCalls.summary: Expands the Arizona Commerce Authority's (ACA) Board of Directors (Board) to include the Chairpersons of the Senate Finance Committee and of the House of Representatives International Trade Committee, or its successor committees, or the Chairpersons' designees.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county treasurers; continuing education
rollCalls.summary: Outlines continuing education requirements for a county board of supervisors (BOS), county treasurer and chief deputy treasurer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: drug-free homeless zones
rollCalls.summary: Establishes drug-free homeless service zones and outlines drug-free homeless zone violations, penalties, fines and requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: birth certificates; amendments; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the conditions and procedures relating to amending a person's birth certificate and prohibits the sex designation of a person from being changed on the person's original birth certificate as a result of a sex change surgery. Prohibits a commissioner from ordering an amendment to a person's name on the person's birth certificate.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: administrative hearings; change of judge
rollCalls.summary: Grants one peremptory change of administrative law judge to the parties to a contested case or an appealable agency action and adds conflicts of interest and being a material witness in an action to the reasons for which a party may file a nonperemptory motion to disqualify an administrative law judge.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: apprenticeship; supervised probation.
rollCalls.summary: Allows certain probationers who participate in a recognized apprenticeship program to work during any hours of the day and to travel to work in the apprenticeship program outside of the probationer's jurisdiction when specified conditions are met.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public officers; photographs; official use
rollCalls.summary: Mandates that before assuming office, a public officer must provide a photograph for official use that was taken within the last 24 months.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: special actions; public participation; postconviction
rollCalls.summary: Broadens laws against strategic legal actions against public participation (SLAPP suits) to cover political and religious expression, creates additional remedies against state actors who bring SLAPP suits and establishes a pathway for postconviction relief when a defendant asserts that a prosecution was politically motivated.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: Arizona space commission; strategic plan
rollCalls.summary: An emergency measure that requires the Arizona Space Commission (Commission) to submit a strategic plan to the Governor and legislative leadership by December 31, 2025, rather than December 31, 2024, and modifies the terms of the initial members of the Commission's Board of Directors (Board).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: congressional term limits; convention
rollCalls.summary: Applies to the U.S. Congress to call an Article V convention to propose an amendment to the U.S. Constitution to set a limit on the number of terms a person may serve in the U.S. Congress.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: governor; attorney general; duties; immigration
rollCalls.summary: Mandates that the Governor, the Attorney General (AG) and each county, city and town must enforce, administer and cooperate with actions, orders and programs that relate to the enforcement of federal immigration laws until January 20, 2029.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: claims; prior authorization; denials; contact
rollCalls.summary: Effective July 1, 2026, requires a health care insurer that denies a claim or prior authorization for any reason to provide contact information of an individual or department that can provide a detailed explanation and a substantive response to questions about why the claim or prior authorization was denied.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriations; Interstate 10; vehicle lanes
rollCalls.summary: Expedites the expansion of the Interstate 10 (I-10) by advancing appropriations for the project by one fiscal year, increasing those appropriations by a total of $25 million and prescribing requirements for the procurement of construction bids.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: technical correction; electricity; power authority
rollCalls.summary: Requires public power entities and electric utilities to prepare a biennial wildfire mitigation plan, as prescribed, and outlines wildfire mitigation plan review and approval requirements. Prescribes liability for causing wildfires in any cause of action for negligence against a public power entity or electric utility that is related to wildfire.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: auditor general; records; financial institutions
rollCalls.summary: Expands the authority of the Office of the Auditor General (OAG) to have access to and examine certain records.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: auditor general; county treasurer; review
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the requirements for procedural reviews of county treasurer offices conducted by the Office of the Auditor General (OAG).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: entrance fee; refunds; time frame
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, requires a facility in which life care services are provided, within 60 days after the facility receives a resident's notice to vacate, to assign the vacated unit a sequential refund number and provide refunds in order based on sequential number, with exceptions and subject to specified requirements. Applies the sequential refund requirement and outlined refund release exemptions and conditions to life care contracts entered into on or after December 31, 2025.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: native plants; fire prevention; exemption
rollCalls.summary: Exempts the Department of Forestry and Fire Management (DFFM), if the State Forester determines necessary to prevent, manage or suppress wildfires, from the requirement that the DFFM notify the Arizona Department of Agriculture (AZDA) before the removal or destruction of native plants over an area of state land exceeding one-fourth acre.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: behavioral health; temporary licensure; graduates
rollCalls.summary: Provides a 90-day licensure exemption for a college graduate who is in the process of applying for an associate level license, possesses a valid fingerprint clearance card and has completed an accredited course of study in social work, counseling, marriage and family therapy or addiction counseling.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; supplemental employee deferral plan
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that an employee of an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) employer, or of a political subdivision or political subdivision entity, who is participating in the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System (PSPRS) or a PSPRS-administered retirement plan is not eligible to participate in a supplemental employee deferral plan.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: guardianship; minors; appointment; notice
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the conditions that allow the court to appoint a guardian for a minor, as well as the requirements relating to providing notice of the time and place of a guardianship hearing to the minor's living parents. Allows the court to extend the authority of a temporary guardian if the extension is in the best interests of the minor.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: domestic water improvement districts; hauling
rollCalls.summary: Adds water delivery systems through water hauling and waterworks, as defined, as authorized improvement projects for both the establishment and undertaking of a County Improvement District (CID).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: water improvements program; water hauling
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements of a water improvement program by allowing persons to make gifts, grants or donations for the purpose of providing financial assistance to qualified owners of residential real property for water hauling for water delivery and adds acquiring or installing storage tanks for receiving and storing water delivered through water hauling to the list of projects that a recipient's grant must be used toward.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: TPT; sourcing; business location; receipt
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the location of servers does not determine where an order is received for purposes of sourcing certain transaction privilege tax (TPT) transactions involving tangible personal property and defines business location .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: signs; lane use; civil penalty
rollCalls.summary: Establishes a civil penalty of $200 for driving a vehicle on the left half of a roadway at a slower speed than normal traffic and requires warning signs to be posted on specified portions of the Interstate 8 (I-8), Interstate 10 (I-10) and Interstate 40 (I-40).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: children with disabilities; evaluation; deadline
rollCalls.summary: Requires a home school district, if a child's parent submits a request between May 1 and August 15 for an evaluation in accordance with the federal Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA), to begin the evaluation or provide the parent notice of refusal to conduct the evaluation within 15 calendar days.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: TPT; exemption; qualifying equipment; extension
rollCalls.summary: Extends the transaction privilege tax (TPT) deduction and use tax exemption for qualifying equipment purchased by a certified healthy forest enterprise until December 31, 2028.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pedestrians; congregating; medians; unsafe locations
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a pedestrian from congregating or engaging in solicitation on a traffic island or median, on a highway ramp or in an unsafe location and prescribes penalties for violations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: genetic sequencing; insurance; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Allows an insurer and the Arizona Health Care Cost Containment System (AHCCCS) to limit coverage for genetic sequencing if the company or operation is associated with a foreign adversary. Establishes prohibitions and requirements for health care institutions and research facilities relating to genetic sequencers and software used for genetic sequencing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early ballots; deadlines; foreign money
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily prohibits the use of monies or in-kind goods or services donated by a foreign source for election administration purposes and prohibits a person, entity or committee from accepting or using monies or in-kind goods or services contributed by a foreign source to influence the outcome of a ballot measure. Requires early mail voters to confirm their address prior to receiving their early ballot regardless of whether the early mail voter is on the Active Early Voting List (AEVL).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: public safety cancer insurance
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the calculation of the administrative costs of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System's (PSPRS's) Cancer Insurance Program (CIP).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: EORP; CORP; funded ratio
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes procedures for a Corrections Officer Retirement Plan (CORP) employer to request an asset transfer. Outlines CORP and Elected Officials' Retirement Plan (EORP) employer contribution reductions if an employer's funded ratio is 100 percent or more and removes minimum CORP employer contribution rates.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: municipal general plan; adoption
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes the governing body of a municipality to submit a new general plan if the municipality is within population and growth rate requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: prisoners; transition program
rollCalls.summary: Allows the Department of Corrections (DOC) to grant inmates a one-time, 90-day extension of transition services if they meet certain eligibility requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; termination incentive programs
rollCalls.summary: Defines unfunded liability for the purposes of assessing a cost for an unfunded liability resulting from a termination incentive program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; temporary personnel service
rollCalls.summary: Allows an active Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member who is appointed to temporary personnel service by a federal agency to receive credited service in ASRS for up to 60 months of temporary personnel service. Requires ASRS employers to make member and employer contributions as outlined.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: judicial appraisal; costs; attorney fees
rollCalls.summary: Designates the applicable court costs that are assessed against a corporation in an appraisal proceeding.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ASRS; long-term disability
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that, for an Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) member to qualify for long-term disability (LTD) benefits, the disability must have occurred while employed for an ASRS employer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: land division; applicant submissions; review
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to review the merits of a certificate of assured water supply and issue a new written determination of action if prescribed conditions apply and using outlined models as criteria. Requires a certificate of assured water supply issued pursuant to outlined requirements to relate back as if issued in calendar year 2023 for the purposes of an application for designation of assured water supply under outlined rules adopted by ADWR.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: land divisions; disclosure affidavit; recording
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the requirements for and contents of an affidavit of disclosure (affidavit) for the sale of parcels of land in an unincorporated area.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subdivided lands; violations; civil penalties
rollCalls.summary: Specifies that the civil penalty for a subdivider or agent who engages in unlawful practice with respect to the sale or lease of subdivided lands applies to each lot where a violation occurs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: real estate; definition of contiguous
rollCalls.summary: Modifies the definition for contiguous relating to subdivision requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; Colorado River Compact; defense
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $1,000,000 in FY 2026 from the state General Fund (state GF) to the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to initiate or defend litigation, and to protect and enforce Arizona's allocation of Colorado River water under the Colorado River Compact of 1922 (Compact), against any claim by any upper basin state or the United States.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: write-in candidates; filings; ballots
rollCalls.summary: Modifies elections procedures relating to special district mail ballot elections, hand count audits, inactive voters on the active early voting list (AEVL), valid justice precinct designations for certain justice of the peace and constable candidates and the circumstances relating to the cure period which require the county recorder or city or town clerk's office to be open during the weekend before and after the election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: individualized education programs; dyslexia diagnosis
rollCalls.summary: Requires a child with a specific learning disability's Individualized Education Program (IEP) to indicate whether the child has been diagnosed with dyslexia.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: parent training; schools; K-8 students
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Child Safety (DCS) to develop and maintain a webpage for group home training programs and resources relating to child sex trafficking. Appropriates $100,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to DCS to develop and maintain a webpage for group home training programs.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: appropriation; address confidentiality program fund
rollCalls.summary: Appropriates $400,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Address Confidentiality Program Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: marijuana; advertising; restrictions
rollCalls.summary: Establishes guidelines and restrictions for the advertising of marijuana, marijuana products and paraphernalia. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: captive insurers; certificate of dormancy
rollCalls.summary: Establishes certification requirements for dormant captive insurers who may not transact insurance business or issue insurance policies while dormant. Modifies administrative requirements for captive insurers.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: child sex trafficking; juvenile defendants
rollCalls.summary: Requires a person that is convicted of a class 2 felony for child sex trafficking to be at least 18 years old to be sentenced to imprisonment for natural life. Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: legal document preparers; license requirements
rollCalls.summary: Adds legal document preparers to the licensees who, when earning continuing education credit towards a state agency license renewal, must also earn credit towards the licensee's annual continuing legal education (CLE) activity requirement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: loan agreements; escrow
rollCalls.summary: Prescribes exceptions to an escrow agent's authorization to only use monies in an escrow account to make a onetime payment or multiple payments pursuant to a loan agreement.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: pay parity; law enforcement; benchmarks
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Department of Public Safety (DPS) to establish and consider benchmarks based on the average compensation of personnel compared to peer law enforcement agencies, prescribes related reporting requirements and modifies the administration and use of the Parity Compensation Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: emergency response plans; charter schools
rollCalls.summary: Continues, for FYs 2026, 2027 and 2028, the requirement that the Arizona Department of Administration (ADOA) administer a competitive grant program that provides a single company that licenses an interoperability software technology solution to support acute care for rural hospitals, health care providers and trauma centers with resources to further treatment and care coordination with a focus on reducing public and private health care costs and unnecessary transportation costs. Appropriates $6,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to ADOA for the grant program.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school elections; county administration; recorder
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, requires school elections to be conducted by the county recorder and county officer in charge of elections in the same manner as prescribed for county elections.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: timeshare salespersons; licensure
rollCalls.summary: Establishes requirements and qualifications for a timeshare salesperson license.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: manufactured housing; certification; compliance
rollCalls.summary: Modifies certification requirements relating to manufactured housing.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internal revenue code; conformity.
rollCalls.summary: Conforms Arizona tax statutes to the U.S. Internal Revenue Code (U.S. IRC) as of January 1, 2025, to reflect changes adopted by the U.S. Congress during 2024.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registration cards; mailing limitation
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits the county recorder from providing an initial or updated voter registration card to anyone whose mailing address is outside of Arizona, with outlined exceptions.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sex-based terms; laws; rules; regulations
rollCalls.summary: Requires any policy, program, rule or law that prohibits sex discrimination to prohibit the unfair treatment of a female or male in relation to a similarly situated member of the opposite sex. Provides statutory definitions for boy , father , female , girl , male , man , mother and sex .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subsequent AMA; voters; removal
rollCalls.summary: Allows, beginning 10 years after the designation of a subsequent active management area (AMA), 10 percent of the registered voters who reside within the boundaries of the subsequent AMA to file an outlined petition to remove the subsequent AMA designation. Outlines requirements for the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to examine the groundwater condition in the basin and file an order in the county recorder's office declaring whether or not the AMA is necessary.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: acting in concert; evidence; exceptions
rollCalls.summary: Outlines exemptions to unlawful acting in concert for the purpose of the sale or lease of subdivision lots or parcels of land.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: internet pornography; minors; age verification
rollCalls.summary: Subjects a commercial entity to civil liability for damages if the entity intentionally and knowingly publishes or distributes sexual material that is harmful to minors on the internet without performing a reasonable age verification.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: sexual conduct; minor; classification; sentence
rollCalls.summary: Increases the penalty for sexual conduct with a minor who is at least 15 years old from a class 6 felony to a class 4 felony, if the defendant is more than 60 months older than the victim and is at least 21 years old at the time of the offense.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: income tax; subtraction; adoption expenses
rollCalls.summary: Increases, for taxable years beginning January 1, 2026, the individual income tax subtraction for unreimbursed adoption expenses from $3,000 to $5,000 for a single individual or head of household and $10,000 for a married couple filing jointly or separately.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subsequent AMA; previously nonirrigated land
rollCalls.summary: Allows a person in a subsequent Active Management Area (AMA), on the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources' (ADWR's) determination of Irrigation Grandfathered Rights (IGFR), to irrigate land that was not previously subject to irrigation if outlined conditions apply.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: historical water use; subsequent AMA
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to August 30, 2022, modifies the time frames, from 5 years to 10 years, prior to a designation of a subsequent active management area (AMA) or an AMA, that are used to determine the amount of groundwater a person has the right to withdraw for irrigation and non-irrigation groundwater rights.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: law enforcement; defunding; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a city or town (municipality) from reducing the annual operating budget for a law enforcement agency by any amount below the previous year's budget. Outlines requirements for the State Treasurer to withhold state shared monies from a municipality upon notification of an operating budget reduction. Declares that the regulation of funding of a municipality's law enforcement agency is a matter of statewide concern.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: justices of the peace; online signature
rollCalls.summary: Adds justice of the peace and constable to the list of offices for which the Secretary of State (SOS) must provide the means for qualified electors to electronically sign nomination petitions by using the online signature collection system (E-Qual).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: early voting; tabulation; ballot deadlines
rollCalls.summary: Requires a voted early ballot that is deposited at a voting location to be received by the voting location not later than 7:00 p.m. on the Friday before election day in order to be counted and valid. Allows county recorders to provide for on-site tabulation of early ballots at any time during the period of early voting, rather than only on election day. Eliminates emergency voting that occurs between 7:00 p.m. on the Friday before election day and 5:00 p.m. on the Monday before election day.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting centers ban; precinct size
rollCalls.summary: Removes the ability of the county board of supervisors (county BOS) and the county recorder to establish voting centers and on-site early voting locations. Limits an election precinct to a maximum of 1,000 registered voters.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: private universities; Arizona teachers academy
rollCalls.summary: Authorizes an Arizona degree-granting private postsecondary educational institution (degree-granting private institution) that offers postbaccalaureate teacher preparation programs that lead to teacher certification to participate in the Arizona Teachers Academy (Teachers Academy), subject to a specified cap on an individual scholarship. Appropriates $10,000,000 from the state General Fund (state GF) in FY 2026 to the Teachers Academy Fund (Fund).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: impersonation; veteran; armed forces
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the criminal classification of impersonating a veteran , which a person commits by knowingly pretending to be a veteran and engaging in specified acts with intent to induce another to submit to the person's pretended authority or rely on the person's pretended official acts.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: subsequent AMA; director; removal
rollCalls.summary: Requires the Director of Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR) to periodically review all areas that are included within a subsequent AMA to determine whether the areas continue to meet the statutorily outlined criteria for inclusion in an AMA. Allows the Director of ADWR, if the Director of ADWR determines that an area no longer meets the criteria for inclusion as a subsequent AMA, to remove the subsequent AMA designation. Outlines public hearing and notification requirements for the removal of a subsequent AMA designation.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: flags; public property; prohibition
rollCalls.summary: Limits flags that may be displayed on public property by a person who is elected, appointed or employed by the state or a political subdivision of the state.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting locations; political party observers
rollCalls.summary: Adds on-site and emergency early voting locations, and other early voting locations, to the voting locations at which a county party chairperson may designate persons to act as challengers. Requires, rather than allows, persons designated by the county chairperson to act as challenger for that party.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: truth in taxation; bonds; notices
rollCalls.summary: Adds the tax rate and estimated cost associated with each proposed capital improvement for a single-family home valued at $400,000 to the information required to be included in an informational pamphlet for certain budget override and bond elections. Adds the estimated tax impact of an increase in property taxes on a home valued at $400,000 to the information required to be included in a statutorily required Truth in Taxation hearing notice of tax increase (TNT notice).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: grandfathered right; Willcox AMA; extension
rollCalls.summary: Retroactive to January 8, 2025, extends the time period, from no later than 15 months to no later than 21 months after the date of the designation of the Willcox Active Management Area (AMA), in which a person claiming the right to withdraw or receive and use groundwater in the Willcox AMA pursuant to a grandfathered right must apply for a certificate of grandfathered right with the Arizona Department of Water Resources (ADWR).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: temporary non-expansion area
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the process for the designation of a temporary non-expansion area (TNA) in any location that is not included in an active management area (AMA) or an irrigation non-expansion area (INA) by an outlined petition to the Director of the Arizona Department of Water Resources by at least one-half of the number of irrigation users and at least 10 percent of the registered voters residing within the boundaries of the groundwater basin or subbasin specified in the petition. Outlines groundwater rights for people within the TNA.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voting centers; precinct voting
rollCalls.summary: Subject to voter approval, statutorily removes the ability of the county board of supervisors (county BOS) and the county recorder to establish voting centers and on-site early voting locations. Limits an election precinct to a maximum of 1,000 registered voters.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: reinstatement; WIFA monies
rollCalls.summary: Expresses the Legislature's commitment to long-term water security and to reinstating the full appropriation envisioned for the Water Infrastructure Finance Authority (WIFA).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: income tax; subtraction; tipped wages
rollCalls.summary: Establishes, for taxable years beginning January 1, 2025, an individual income tax subtraction for tips received during the taxable year that are reported to the employer.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: communications from inmate; victims' right
rollCalls.summary: Expands the prohibition against an inmate sending correspondence to a victim to include any written, verbal or nonverbal communication, rather than just mail, if the victim has requested to not receive such correspondence.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: county candidates; clean elections pamphlet
rollCalls.summary: Adds candidates for countywide offices to the list of names that must be included in the Voter Education Guide published by the Citizens Clean Elections Commission (Commission). Contains requirements for enactment for initiatives and referendums (Proposition 105).
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: election mailings; third-party disclosures
rollCalls.summary: Requires the words "not from a government agency" to appear on the outside of an election-related document that is mailed or hand delivered by any nongovernmental person or entity.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: voter registrations; payment prohibited
rollCalls.summary: Prohibits a person from paying or receiving anything of value based on the number of voter registration forms collected, completed or submitted.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: notary public; requirements
rollCalls.summary: Modifies certain statutory requirements related to a notary public.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: schools; water safety; information; resources
rollCalls.summary: Requires, before the 2025-2026 school year, the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) to compile and post on ADE's website information regarding water safety courses and swimming lessons and local providers of such courses and lessons. Directs each school district and charter school to provide the webpage address to each parent upon initial enrollment of a child.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; service; definition
rollCalls.summary: Requires municipalities and counties, by January 1, 2027, to adopt an online instant permitting process for home power installations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: audits; precincts; voting centers
rollCalls.summary: Adds voting centers to the random pool of precincts within a county from which the ballots for the hand count audit must be selected and requires the hand count audit to begin immediately after the selection of precincts or voting centers, except as outlined for the early ballot hand count.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: provisional ballots; cure data
rollCalls.summary: Adds provisional ballot voters to the list of voters whose signatures require curing that the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections must send to the political parties on a daily basis through the end of the signature cure period.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: DIFI; financial enterprises; insurance; compact
rollCalls.summary: Requires a homeowners insurer to file with the Director of the Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions (DIFI) specified policy information relating to fire loss and wildfire risk. Establishes the Fire Insurance Review Task Force (Task Force) and outlines Task Force membership and duties. Modifies the license renewal deadline for consumer lenders, debt management companies, escrow agents, advance fee loan brokers and sales finance companies.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: counties; indigent deceased persons; cremation
rollCalls.summary: Expands the services a medical examiner or an alternate medical examiner can provide to an indigent person's remains, clarifies the application process for counties applying for a crematory license and expands who can supervise autopsies done for training purposes.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: life insurance; illustrations
rollCalls.summary: Effective January 1, 2026, prescribes requirements for life insurance policy forms and illustrations.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: workers' compensation; assigned risk plan
rollCalls.summary: Outlines the factors that exclude an employer who is refused workers' compensation coverage from placement in the assigned risk plan.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: ballot order; names; parties; rotation
rollCalls.summary: Modifies, beginning in 2027, requirements for the rotation of political party candidates on the ballot for a general election.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: observing nude minor; sexual gratification
rollCalls.summary: Deems that a person commits sexual exploitation of a minor by knowingly observing a nude minor for the purpose of engaging in sexual conduct for the person's sexual gratification and outlines defenses to a prosecution for sexual exploitation of a minor .
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school safety; employee certification; policies
rollCalls.summary: Establishes the Save Our Children School Safety Program (Program) within the Arizona Department of Education (ADE) and authorizes school employees at eligible schools who are certified through the Program to possess and carry firearms on school grounds. Requires the Arizona Peace Officer Standards and Training Board (AZPOST) to work in consultation with ADE to develop uniform standards and training for school employees.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school facilities oversight board; continuation
rollCalls.summary: Allows each member of a school district governing board (governing board) to access all information and records that are maintained by a school district for the purpose of carrying out the governing board's official functions and duties. Outlines requirements for an administrator, official or records custodian of a school district relating to the provision of information and records to a governing board member.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: instructional time models; posting requirements
rollCalls.summary: Directs a school district or charter school to submit adopted instructional time models (ITM) to the Arizona Department of Education (ADE). Requires ADE to post the ITMs on its website.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading

rollCalls.title: school safety; proposals; assessments; plans
rollCalls.summary: Expands the School Safety Program (Program) to support the costs of placing school safety officers (SSOs) and by establishing an alternative Program proposal process to support the costs of purchasing safety equipment and infrastructure improvements as specified. Requires each school district and charter school to train officers how to interact with children with disabilities and each school that receives Program monies to develop an emergency response plan as outlined. Exempts school building blueprints and floor plans from public record requirements.
rollCalls.question: Third Reading
